title: Ta walka to nasza sprawa – pikieta solidarnościowa z protestującymi we Francji
content:
Jeśli jesteście zainteresowani i zainteresowane tym co dzieje się obecnie we Francji i innych krajach Europy zachęcamy Was żeby „przystanąć” na chwilę i zastanowić się nad sytuacją w obecnej Europie późnego kapitalizmu.


21 września w liceum pod Paryżem młodzież zaczęła swoje pierwsze strajki. Były to pojedyńcze blokady licealistów, które finalnie rozlały się na cały kraj.


Postulaty dotyczyły fatalnych warunków szkolnictwa publicznego we Francji. Niszczejąca infrastruktura, spadająca liczba nauczycieli, która prowadziła do tego, że uczniowie szkół publicznych w ogóle nie mieli zajęć z języka francuskiego czy geografii, które potem musieli zdawać na maturze. W sondzie ministerstwa edukacji we Francji 55% nauczycieli szkół publicznych – licea, wskazało że nie jest w stanie wykonywać należycie swoich obowiązków ze względu na złą izolację termiczną szkół.


Dlatego młodzież zaczęła protestować. Do protestów zaczęli przyłączać się studenci a następnie nauczyciele i rodzice. Protesty zaczęły być masowe – ruch narodził się i zyskał dynamikę w uboższych i marginalizowanych dzielnicach Francji a jego motywacją była frustracja związana z gorszymi warunkami życia i dyskryminacją.


Tymczasem jaki obraz protestów dostajemy w Polsce? Bełkot skrajnej prawicy o tym, że protesty związane są z kontekstem narodowościowym czy rasowym. Zdjęcia na których widać osoby o innym niż biały kolor skóry, budowanie narracji o obcych, którzy wzniecają zamieszki. Tymczasem relacje młodzieży z protestów, które są obecne na mediach społecznościowych pokazują zróżnicowaną i solidaryzującą się grupę dla której kluczem był wiek, status społeczny a co za tym idzie uczestnictwo w publicznym systemie edukacji –

PIERWSZE KŁAMSTWO JAKIM KARMIĄ NAS MEDIA


Ruch we Francji stał się masowy – młodzież domagała się lepszych warunków edukacji, domagała się sprawiedliwości społecznej i bycia wysłuchanym. We Francji bunt ma szczególne znaczenie, jest częścią historii tego społeczeństwa. Trudno więc się dziwić, że kiedy wieloletnie wołanie o pomoc przez ludzi tworzących system szkolnictwa publicznego we Francji było ignorowane, kolejne pokolenie francuzów wyszło na ulice traktując protest jako formę uczestnictwa w życiu publicznym. Protest to coś więcej niż opór, konfrontacja z rządem czy policją. To dowód na samoorganizację i pomoc wzajemną gdzie nauczyciele, związki zawodowe i uczniowie ramie w ramie żądali spełnienia swoich postulatów. Osoby podjęły walkę o odzyskanie prawa do organizowania się i oddolnego decydowania o swoim miejscu nauki czy pracy. Jednak nie możemy zapominać, że każdy skuteczny protest dla władzy jest tylko kolejnymi zamieszkami. Aparat władzy pozwala na publiczne protesty tak długo jak pozostają one w akceptowalnych granicach. Kiedy ludzie samoorganizują sie bez czekania na pozwolenie dochodzi do zachwiania fundamentów władzy. Francja protestowała przez prawie miesiąc, a rząd zamiast potraktować ich postulaty poważnie, uznał że dzieciaki trzeba zgnoić i zastraszyć. Uznał że pokaże im miejsce w szeregu. Przed 17 października (czyli przed datą największej fali protestów) zostało aresztowanych 7 tysięcy nieletnich protestujących osób – nieletnich! A co my widzieliśmy w mediach? Czy mówiono o postulatach, czy pokazywano warunki, w których nikt nie chciałby żeby jego dziecko, rodzina czy przyjaciel spędzali po kilka godzin dziennie pięć dni w tygodniu? Niestety nic z tego do nas nie dociera – palące się śmietniki, barykady uliczne i zapętlające się rolki pokazujące te same zamieszki – mają lepszą klikalność –

DRUGIE KŁAMSTWO JAKIM KARMIĄ NAS MEDIA.


I teraz najważniejsza rzecz, o której nie usłyszysz praktycznie w żadnych populistycznych kanałach informacyjnych – przemoc policji.


Francuska policja słynie z ogromnej brutalności. Prawo jest tam tak skonstruowane, że policja w dowolnym momencie protestu może w pełni arbitralnie, bez żadnego ostrzeżenia użyć siły. I takiej siły używali wobec nieletnich i wobec protestujących na ulicach Francji. Udokumentowane są przypadki chłopaka który stracił mowę ponieważ policjant celując w głowę strzelił do niego z wyrzutni granatów łzawiących. Wyrzutnia powinna być używana pod kątem, bo w przeciwnym razie zagraża życiu i zdrowiu gdyż nabój z kostkami łzawiącymi musi zdążyć się otworzyć.


Mimo to policja stosuje wyrzutnie jako broń celując nimi prosto w tłum protestujących. Policja francuska używa również broni na gumowe kule celując z niej w ludzi.

author: infolibre
title: Δίκη για το δολοφονικό βασανισμό του Βασίλειου Μάγγου, Παρασκευή 30/10, στις 09.00, στα Δικαστήρια Καρδίτσας
content:
Την Παρασκευή 30/10, στις 09.00, στα Δικαστήρια Καρδίτσας, συνεχίζεται η δίκη των δολοφόνων – βασανιστών του Βασιλείου Μάγγου με τις αγορεύσεις των συνηγόρων. Μετά τη πρόταση της εισαγγελέως για ενοχή όλων για κακουργηματικά βασανιστήριαμ, παράνομη έκθεση, επικίνδυνη σωματική βλαβη, η δίκη συνεχίζεται και πρωτοβουλίες και συλλογικότητες καλούν σε συγκέντρωση απαιτώντας την καταδίκη των ένστολων βασανιστών του Βασίλη Μάγγου.


Καλέσματα:


Δίκτυο αλληλεγγύης και αγώνα Καρδίτσας – Για υγεία, ζωή και ελευθερία


ΟΛΟΙ ΚΑΙ ΟΛΕΣ ΣΤΑ ΔΙΚΑΣΤΗΡΙΑ ΚΑΡΔΙΤΣΑΣ ΤΗ ΠΕΜΠΤΗ 29/10 ΣΤΙΣ 09:00 – ΝΑ ΚΑΤΑΔΙΚΑΣΤΟΥΝ ΟΙ ΒΑΣΑΝΙΣΤΕΣ ΤΟΥ ΒΑΣΙΛΗ


Η πανελλαδικώς γνωστή δίκη για το δολοφονικό βασανισμό του Βασίλειου Μάγγου από έξι (6) υπαλλήλους του κράτους (αστυνομικούς) οδεύει προς το τέλος της. Στην επόμενη δικάσιμο στο Μικτό Ορκωτό Δικαστήριο Καρδίτσας, θα γίνει η πρόταση της εισαγγελέως. Στις επόμενες ακολουθούν οι αγορεύσεις των συνηγόρων υπεράσπισης, ενώ μετά από αυτές θα οριστεί η ημέρα της απόφασης. Αυτό είναι ένα ακόμη κάλεσμα στους Καρδιτσιώτες πολίτες να συνεχίσουν να δίνουν το παρόν και να δυναμώσουν την μέχρι τώρα παρουσία τους σε αυτόν τον τεράστιο αγώνα που δίνεται.


Έχουμε να κάνουμε με ακόμα μια περίπτωση όπου η αστική δικαιοσύνη, οι κρατικοί μηχανισμοί και οι υποτακτικοί τους επιστρατεύουν όλα τα δυνατά τεχνάσματα για την εξουθένωση των συγγενών και των αλληλέγγυων, για τον επηρεασμό της κοινής γνώμης, την προστασία των θεσμών και των θεματοφυλάκων τους και για να επισφραγίσουν το αίσθημα ότι όποιος αντιστέκεται θα βρίσκει απέναντι του ένα γραφειοκρατικό θηρίο. Σε αυτή τη δίκη οι οικογένεια δεν έχει δικαίωμα υπεράσπισης επειδή ο νεκρός δεν πρόλαβε να καταθέσει μήνυση (!), ενώ έχει διακοπεί 21 φορές με δικαστικά τερτίπια των συνηγόρων υπεράσπισης σε μια προσπάθεια να κατευθύνουν τη διαδικασία και να ελέγξουν τις εντυπώσεις. Η δικηγορική αλητεία συνεχίζεται μέσα στην αίθουσα σε μια προσπάθεια να δολοφονήσουν το Βασίλειο για δεύτερη φορά, προσπαθώντας να ποινικοποιήσουν τις απόψεις του και τον τρόπο ζωής του, χειραγωγώντας την διαδικασία με τεχνικότητες, ψέματα και συναισθηματισμούς, θέλοντας να κρύψουν την αλήθεια. Οι κατηγορούμενοι δε μετανοούν, γιατί αυτή είναι η δουλειά τους.


Η αλήθεια είναι ότι ο Βασίλειος ήταν ένα ευαίσθητος, καλλιεργημένος νέος και αγωνιστής. Ξυλοκοπήθηκε εκδικητικά, αρχικά έξω από τα δικαστήρια Βόλου πηγαίνοντας σε συγκέντρωση αλληλεγγύης προς τους συλληφθέντες της μεγαλειώδους πορείας ενάντια στην καύση σκουπιδιών στο Βόλο τον Ιούνιο του 2020, στη συνέχεια στο αυτοκίνητο που τον μετέφερε στην Ασφάλεια Μαγνησίας και τέλος βασανίστηκε ξανά και χλευάστηκε μέσα στην Ασφάλεια. Όλα αυτά γιατί δεν άντεξε να είναι συνένοχος σε αυτό τον κόσμο που προστατεύουν με λύσσα οι 6 “κρατικοί υπάλληλοι”, οι δικηγόροι τους και η “δικαιοσύνη” που αναγκάζει την οικογένεια του να υπομένει αυτή τη λοιδορία και να αναγκάζεται να είναι δυνατότερη των περιστάσεων για να φτάσει αυτή η υπόθεση εδώ που έφτασε.


Η περίπτωση του Βασίλη, αν και δεν είναι η μόνη, έγινε συνώνυμη με την αστυνομική βία, τον κρατικό ρεβανσισμό και την αγωνιστική ηθική. Ο Βασίλης με το σώμα του στάθηκε απέναντι σε ένα σύστημα το οποίο θέλει το κεφάλαιο ρυθμιστή των ζωών μας, όπου πόλεις γεμίζουν καρκίνο από τα σκουπίδια, τα βουνά και τα ποτάμια ισοπεδώνονται στο όνομα της “πράσινης ανάπτυξης”, οι λαϊκές ανάγκες τζογάρονται στα χρηματιστήρια, οι εργοδοτικές δολοφονίες και η επισφάλεια καλπάζουν, οι φτωχοδιάβολοι των πολέμων πνίγονται στις θάλασσες της Ευρώπης, γινόμαστε μάρτυρες εν εξελίξει γενοκτονίας, το κράτος στήνει σκευωρίες σε αγωνιστές και ανασύρει από τα συρτάρια του τους νοσταλγούς του Χίτλερ και στο αποκορύφωμα του το ίδιο εκτελεί τους πολίτες του. Ποια δικαιοσύνη περιμένουμε λοιπόν να δικαιώσει τον Βασίλη? Σίγουρα όχι τη δική τους. Στη λαϊκή συνείδηση και αυτοί οι μπάτσοι είναι ένοχοι. Ο Βασίλης δικαιώθηκε ήδη τη μέρα που έτρεξε να είναι στο πλάι τον συναγωνιστών του. Δεν έχουμε αυταπάτες, ούτε για το ρόλο των δικαστηρίων, ούτε για το ρόλο της αστυνομίας σε όλη αυτή τη διαδικασία. Το κύμα αλληλεγγύης που έχει σηκωθεί σε όλο αυτό το διάστημα θα συνεχίσει να είναι εκεί και σας καλούμε να γίνουμε περισσότεροι.


ΔΕΝ ΞΕΧΝΑΜΕ, ΔΕΝ ΣΥΓΧΩΡΟΥΜΕ ΤΗΝ ΚΡΑΤΙΚΗ ΔΟΛΟΦΟΝΙΑ ΤΟΥ ΒΑΣΙΛΕΙΟΥ ΜΑΓΓΟΥ

author: Αντώνιος Δημόπουλος και Λουκάς Σταμέλλος
title: Ενοχή των αστυνομικών για κακουργηματικά βασανιστήρια στον Β. Μάγγο πρότεινε η εισαγγελέας
content:
Σύνδεσμος δημοσίευσης:

Ενοχή των αστυνομικών για κακουργηματικά βασανιστήρια στον Β. Μάγγο πρότεινε η εισαγγελέας


Την ενοχή των κατηγορούμενων αστυνομικών για τα βασανιστήρια σε βάρος του Βασίλη Μάγγου στο Αστυνομικό Μέγαρο Βόλου, καθώς και για το αδίκημα της έκθεσης, πρότεινε η εισαγγελέας του Μικτού Ορκωτού Δικαστηρίου Καρδίτσας, κατά την 21η δικάσιμο, την Πέμπτη 29 Οκτωβρίου 2026.


Η εισαγγελέας έκρινε ότι οι σοβαρές σωματικές βλάβες του Βασίλη Μάγγου, μεταξύ των οποίων έξι κατάγματα πλευρών και κάκωση στο ήπαρ, προκλήθηκαν από τη βία που υπέστη κατά τη μεταφορά του και την παραμονή του στην Αστυνομική Διεύθυνση, μετά τον ξυλοδαρμό του έξω από τα δικαστήρια του Βόλου στις 14 Ιουνίου 2020.


Επικαλούμενη τις ιατρικές γνωματεύσεις και τις μαρτυρικές καταθέσεις, απέρριψε τους ισχυρισμούς ότι οι κακώσεις προϋπήρχαν ή είχαν προκληθεί αποκλειστικά από τα χτυπήματα έξω από τα δικαστήρια.


Ως προς τη στοιχειοθέτηση των βασανιστηρίων κατά το άρθρο 137Α του Ποινικού Κώδικα, υποστήριξε ότι αποδείχθηκε και ο ειδικός σκοπός της τιμωρίας του Μάγγου. Συνέδεσε τη βία με το ιδιαίτερα πολωμένο κλίμα που είχε διαμορφωθεί μετά τη μεγάλη κινητοποίηση κατά της καύσης απορριμμάτων στην ΑΓΕΤ, την προηγούμενη ημέρα, και με την αντίληψη των αστυνομικών ότι είχε πληγεί το γόητρο της αστυνομίας.


Ιδιαίτερη αναφορά έκανε στον εξευτελισμό που περιέγραψε ότι υπέστη ο Μάγγος, ως στοιχεία της πρόκλησης όχι μόνο σωματικού αλλά και ψυχικού πόνου.


Διαβάστε επίσης:


Η υπεράσπιση ενός βασανισμού


Για την επικίνδυνη σωματική βλάβη κατά τη μεταφορά με το αστυνομικό όχημα, πρότεινε την ενοχή των δύο αστυνομικών που βρίσκονταν δίπλα του και την αθώωση του συνοδηγού για τη συγκεκριμένη πράξη. Για τη βία εντός του Αστυνομικού Μεγάρου πρότεινε την ενοχή όλων των αντίστοιχων κατηγορουμένων.


Για το αδίκημα της έκθεσης, επισήμανε ότι η σοβαρή κατάσταση της υγείας του ήταν εμφανής στους αστυνομικούς, οι οποίοι τον άφησαν αβοήθητο παρά το αίτημά του να μεταφερθεί στο νοσοκομείο.


Τέλος, πρότεινε την αθώωση των κατηγορουμένων για την παράνομη κατακράτηση, θεωρώντας ότι η σχετική αρμοδιότητα ανήκε στον αξιωματικό υπηρεσίας.


Η δίκη συνεχίζεται με τις αγορεύσεις των συνηγόρων.

Ακολουθεί ολόκληρη η αγόρευση της Εισαγγελέα:


Προτού ξεκινήσω να παραθέτω τι προέκυψε κατά την κρίση μου, οφείλω να αναφερθώ στο κλίμα την περίοδο που λάμβαναν χώρα τα περιστατικά. Ο Βόλος είναι βεβαρημένος περιβαλλοντικά […] έχουμε διαδηλώσεις, ψηφίσματα, τοποθετήσεις συλλογικά και ατομικά πολιτών.


Στις 13/6/2020 έχουμε μια μεγάλη διαδήλωση έξω από το εργοστάσιο της ΑΓΕΤ Ηρακλής. Διαμαρτύρονται για τη μόλυνση της ατμόσφαιρας. Στην πορεία αυτή δημιουργούνται εντάσεις. Έχουμε σίγουρα μια κακή εκτίμηση από την πλευρά της αστυνομίας. Τραυματίζονται 5 αστυνομικοί […] κάποιοι εξ αυτών νοσηλεύονται στο Γενικό Νοσοκομείο Βόλου. Πρωτοφανές και όχι σύνηθες γενικά να τραυματίζεται κόσμος και δη αστυνομικοί σε μια επαρχιακή πόλη. Έγιναν κάποιες συλλήψεις, μετά από διώξεις από μελέτη οπτικού υλικού, και είχαμε δύο συλληφθέντες. Ένας ο κ. Θ.Σ. [σ.σ.: μάρτυρας στη δίκη εδώ] και μια γυναίκα. Γίνεται συγκέντρωση στις 13/6 το βράδυ. Κλίμα πολωμένο.


Τη 14η Ιουνίου [2020] προσέρχονται στον εισαγγελέα οι συλληφθέντες […] Κυριακή, δεν συνεδριάζει το δικαστήριο […] και ο συλληφθείς επιστρέφει στο αστυνομικό μέγαρο. Έξω από το δικαστικό μέγαρο έχει συγκεντρωθεί ένα πλήθος κόσμου για διαμαρτυρία και συμπαράσταση στους συλληφθέντες. Υπάρχει και αστυνομική δύναμη. Ο Θ.Σ. εξέρχεται από το δικαστικό μέγαρο για να μεταχθεί στο αστυνομικό τμήμα. Με το που εξέρχεται –και αυτά τα λέμε με σχετική ασφάλεια γιατί έχουμε εικόνα [βίντεο]– ο Βασίλης Μάγγος έρχεται, δεν είναι στο πλήθος των συγκεντρωμένων, έχει αφήσει το μηχανάκι του και είναι στη μέση και διαμαρτύρεται φωνασκώντας έντονα και σηκώνοντας τα χέρια του προς τη μεριά των αστυνομικών. Ο 6ος κατηγορούμενος, κ. Παζαράς, υποδεικνύει τον κ. Μάγγο και κινούνται αστυνομικοί εναντίον του. Ο κ. Μάγγος οπισθοχωρεί… Είναι οι 3 πρώτοι κατηγορούμενοι που καταφέρουν τα χτυπήματα… Ο κ. Μάγγος κάνει κάποιες κινήσεις αποτρεπτικές και όχι επιθετικές. Γονατίζει και χειροπεδείται. Οδηγείται σε όχημα. Μέσα είναι ο 4ος κατηγορούμενος, κ. Μόναχος, και συνοδηγός ο κ. Σκρίμπας και πίσω οι 3ος και 4ος κατηγορούμενοι, Μπακογιάννης και Μπαλαμώτης. Οι ενέργειες των αστυνομικών είναι επιθετικές και άγριες. Αντιδρά ο κ. Μάγγος αλλά αντιδρά και άλλος κόσμος. Επικαλούμαι την κατάθεση του μάρτυρα Ταταριώτη… και της κυρίας που ήταν κατηγορούμενη… Αντιδρούσαν ακόμα και οι ταξιτζήδες …

author: EDRi
title: Draconian access block orders in Turkey
content:
Court orders to block access to X accounts in Turkey reached an unprecedented number in September 2026. In this blog, EDRi-member Alternatif Bilisim detail the crackdown on civil rights defenders and independent media in the country, and call on public authorities to reconsider block orders and protect fundamental rights.

By Alternatif Bilisim (guest author) · October 29, 2026

Court orders to block access to X accounts in Turkey reached an unprecedented number in September 2026, followed by the closure of T24, an independent news website. According to data from the EngelliWeb project of the Freedom of Expression Association (İFÖD), X blocked at least 1,270 accounts. In comparison, a total of 995 accounts were blocked in the entire year of 2025. In fact, the website of EngelliWeb, which tracks and documents online censorship in Turkey, was also blocked on 1 October 2026. Authoritarian measures and alarming levels of censorship in the country are increasingly eroding freedom of expression.

The common factor in all decisions related to access block orders is Article 8/A of Law No. 5651. This article allows the right of life, the safety of life and property of the persons, the protection of national security and public order, the prevention of crime or the protection of the internet contents or the prevention of access to the internet content. Several restrictions on access blocks in September cited grounds such as national security or protection of public order under 8/A.

Article 8/A was introduced by the government as an arrangement that was supposed to be implemented in exceptional cases, but its use has been gradually expanding. The use of this article is also being combined with the new provisions on family values under the so-called “My Family is Safe” investigations, which have led to a brutal crackdown on LGBTQ+ and HIV advocacy groups in Turkey.

EDRi-member Alternatif Bilisim condemns this act by the Turkish authorities and the complicity of X on the shadow bans. Turkey is increasingly witnessing an ideological surge on critical opinion and its clear consequences for the journalism landscape as well as digital spaces at large.

According to Engelliweb, in September 2026, many different accounts – from LGBTQ+ organisations and activists to journalists, academics to economists, from women’s organisations to individual users – were impacted by the access blocks. A few examples of note are the accounts of Evrensel, a socialist newspaper; Amnesty International Turkey; Academics for Peace; and the Media and Law Studies Association.

In the second half of September, social media posts on capital markets have also a key focus of blocks due to alleged cause of fear and panic in the society. A major capital-markets scandal in Turkey involved widespread market manipulation by asset managers who allegedly inflated fund values using worthless “junk stocks,” leading to the liquidation of 131 funds and affecting about 455,000 investors. Authorities arrested over 114 people and froze assets as part of the investigation into fraud and criminal organization charges.

A more recent disproportionate measure has been the closure of a prominent independent news website T24 and its social media accounts after the justice ministry reported that they had published 118 items during the previous year which the court classified as “LGBTQ propaganda”. The X accounts of Independent News Network Bianet, as well as several of its reporters have also been banned due to court orders citing national security and protection of public order.

Court decisions on access to an account does not mean that the account will automatically become invisible in X from Turkey. The decision must also be implemented by the platform. X did not implement all the decisions. According to the IFÖD’s findings, 1,139 of the at least 1,270 accounts (around 90 percent) that were blocked in September were made invisible from Turkey by X. According to X’s official policy, the company can only block access to certain content or accounts in the respective country when it receives a valid and appropriate legal request from an competent authority. The account is not closed globally in this case. author: Paige Collings
title: Tech Tips for Parents this Digital Parenting Week
content:
In today’s digital world, the internet is an

essential resource

 for young people to access information, explore community, and find themselves. But we know that this often comes alongside fears of experiencing online harms like doxxing, grooming, or bullying.


Trying to protect your family from everything all the time is impractical and exhausting, but some thoughtful planning can help families devise a workable plan that meets their needs and addresses their concerns.


That’s why this Digital Parent Week, we’re sharing easy tips on how parents and their children can work together to co-curate a digital safety plan that helps all members of the family enjoy the benefits of technology while protecting their online privacy and safety. 


Start with Open Conversations


Online safety begins with communication, not just restrictions. Talk with a young person about how they use the internet: their favourite apps, games, and social media platforms for example. Creating a supportive environment helps young people feel comfortable asking for help if something goes wrong online.


Together, you can think about:


What do we want to protect?

e.g., I want to protect a young person’s privacy and mental health when they’re playing Roblox. They love Roblox and use it to communicate and hang out with their best friend, so we’d like to find a way to make it as safe as possible.


Who do we want to protect it from?

 e.g., messages from strangers, staying up too late playing, wasting money on pointless digital junk in games.


How bad are the consequences if we fail?

e.g, losing some money on a scam or having creepy conversations with strangers that could escalate into something more nefarious or dangerous.


How likely is it that we will need to protect it?

e.g., I don’t know the likelihood of a stranger messaging you on Roblox because I’m not sure how communication works on the platform, but I’ve heard from their friends that strangers message them all the time in some games.


How much trouble are we willing to go through to try to prevent potential consequences?

e.g., I’m willing to learn from my child how the game works, play the game with my child, and learn how to work the parental controls. 


Who are our allies?

 e.g., my partner, our parents, as well as a young person’s best friends and their parents.


It's easy to think of a young person's experience on the internet as being totally disconnected and different from your own. But now is a great time to also interrogate your own internet habits, like the sorts of sites you engage with, tools you use, and privacy settings you've set. These questions are as valuable to help you as a parent as they are just an internet user.


Sometimes even just figuring out what conversations are worth having can take some effort, we've put together some ideas to get you started in

our guide

.


Make Privacy a Family Priority


Digital security training can feel overwhelming but this is why a

community-oriented approach

 helps. In speaking with your family and friends, you can build out digital security practices that work for you. This makes it more likely that your privacy practices will become second nature to you and your loved ones.


Use secure messaging services for every communication:

 Choosing a secure service ensures that your privacy is protected from government and corporate surveillance. If you can convince your family to get on board, options like Signal provide the most extensive privacy protections out of the box through its use of end-to-end encryption and limited data collection. But we understand that sometimes it's easier to stick with whatever the family already uses for a group chat, like WhatsApp, Apple's iMessage, or Google Messages, so take the time to familiarize yourself with the

limits of WhatsApp

 and

RCS encryption

.


Consider the content posted online:

It's easy to accidentally share personal information through photos, messages, and other content.


Children and adults may unknowingly share personal information through photos, messages, location settings and app permissions. Take time together to review privacy settings, check which apps can access the camera or location, and discuss why personal details should be shared carefully. Make sure you have family agreement about when and where to post photos of each other or your home.


Create incident response plans:

Developing a plan for if or when something bad happens is a good practice …

author: EDRi
title: EDRi-gram, 29 October 2026
content:
What has the EDRi network been up to over the past few weeks? Find out the latest digital rights news in our regular newsletter. In this edition: Celebrating end-to-end encryption, and the digital justice community in Europe and beyond

We’re still riding the high from October milestones showcasing the strength of our community. We had the pleasure of greeting many of you in person and online for #PrivacyCamp26 two weeks ago to discuss the origins of technology and how to pivot from conversations around “sovereignty” to meaningful, community-led self-determination. If you weren’t able to make it but you’re curious about the conversations, you can rewatch the livestream of some of the panel discussions.

Then, on October 21, we celebrated Global Encryption Day, highlighting end-to-end encryption as a crucial foundation to our right to safe and secure communication online and to life as we know it. Thanks to our members and partners, our message of protecting encryption was visible across several European capitals – from the metro trains of Prague to key landmarks in Berlin, Paris and Dublin with mobile “encryption trucks”. We also worked with European Sex Workers Alliance and Féministes contre le cyberharcèlement to raise awareness on the importance of safe and secure communications for sex workers as well as womens’ rights. You can read more about the action in this edition, and stay tuned for more updates coming soon on our social platforms.

Yet another win for digital rights this month came with the news of Norway’s data protection authority imposing a fine of 92 million Norwegian crowns (roughly EUR 8.8 million) on Microsoft’s adtech unit Xandr for unlawfully sharing ​Grindr users’ sensitive data with thousands of advertisers.

While we’re bolstered from the wins and community spirit, there’s a lot more to resist and much work to be done. We are still reeling from the EU governments’ final position on the Digital Omnibus on Data, which amongst other unsavoury things, will to allow companies to use our data to develop or use their AI systems if it serves a ‘legitimate interest’ – without us knowing or accepting. This is a blank cheque for tech corporations to indulge in outrageous data grabs and exploit potentially sensitive information about us.

Earlier this week, the European Commission also announced a revamp of Frontex, EU’s border agency, that is set to double its budget and expand its role in deportations and surveillance. Not only will this turn Frontex into EU’s ICE equivalent, the new Regulation also wants to allow Frontex to be able to monitor social media for information that may forecast people’s movements at EU borders. Let alone leading with solidarity and care, the EU seems intent on violating people’s freedom to move and to express themselves. Keep your eyes out for an analysis of the new proposal from the Protect Not Surveil coalition.

author: Kodao Productions
title: The risks journalists face (2)
content:
The “secret” complainant in the cyberlibel case against tabloid columnist Philip Lustre Jr. — who was arrested on Saturday, Oct. 24, 2026, right at the venue of the Saturday News Forum at Dapo Restaurant in Quezon City – turned out to be Atty. Mans Carpio, the once-proud stockholder of Cale88 Food, which was exporting banana chips to Hong Kong, China and other countries. Atty. Carpio was apparently erased from the ownership structure of Cale88 in July 2026, just as the impeachment trial of his wife, Sara Zimmerman Duterte Carpio, commenced at the Senate.


Based on the court documents, the complaint stemmed from Lustre’s March 6, 2026 Facebook post which alleged that Carpio “spent” P300-million to finance the operation of the 18 Marines who claimed to have delivered billions of pesos from flood control projects to lawmakers. The post read:

“SUMUKA si Mans Carpio ng P300-M sa operasyon ng Marines: P150-M kay Mike; P50-M kay Levi; at P5-M sa bawat isa sa 18 Marines?”

 (Did Mans Carpio cough up P300 million for the Marines’ operation: P150 million to Mike, P50 million to Levi, and P5 million each to the 18 Marines?)

[Mike probably referred to former Congressman and Secretary Michael Defensor and Levi to Atty. Levi Baligod—ed.]


Since what Lustre posted was a question to which Carpio could respond on Facebook, it is doubtful whether the Davao City prosecutor considered the difference between a categorical statement accusing Carpio of bribery and a question that seeks corroboration or denial. Thus, Lustre’s counsel, Atty. Dino de Leon, might as well question why he or she gave short shrift to the respondent. However, based on the Davao City prosecutor’s reading, the written online statement “taken in its plain, natural, and ordinary meaning, directly imputes upon Atty. Manases R. Carpio.”


De Leon noted that Lustre was never informed about the complaint that was given due course in March 2026. In eight months, the Davao City prosecutors failed to know Lustre’s residence and thus could not serve him with subpoenae to compel him to contest Carpio’s allegations. Too convenient for Mans to have all the chances to pursue a case against Lustre without the benefit of a reply. Everything was ex parte and such proceedings would normally warrant dismissal in other jurisdictions. Miffed by the tactics of the other party, de Leon said: “We will confront this case properly and we reserve our client’s right to file the appropriate counter-charges.”


For posing a question, Davao City prosecutors now want Lustre to be on the dock to answer charges that he had willfully and maliciously imputed a criminal act on Carpio in violation of Sec. (4C) 4 of the Cybercrime Prevention Act of 2012, also known as Republic Act No. 10175. Lustre was in the dark about the identity of the complainant, telling reporters that he suspected it was either Mans or Rep. Pulong Duterte. It was only a copy of the information was sent to de Leon that they finally pinpointed Mans, who is still grieving after his father, Atty. Lucas Carpio, died.


Journalists are mourning, too, over the conduct of the Lustre arrest and the dubious process that led to the Oct. 24, 2026 apprehension at a Quezon City news forum. With the information kept in some black hole, there was no way for the accused to reply and demolish the allegations lodged against him. Such puerile tactics as “failing” to determine the address of Lustre and merely listing his “residence” as the editorial offices of a Makati-based newspaper, are part of the scheme to make it hard for him to prepare his defense.


Moreover, Judge Retrina Espe Fuentes of Regional Trial Court (RTC) Branch 10 in Davao City, who signed the arrest warrant for Lustre, was the same judge who issued the arrest warrant for Davao Death Squad (DDS) whistleblower Arturo Lascañas in 2017 after he turned his back on Rodrigo Duterte, who was sitting as president then. Lascañas tagged Duterte as the architect of the “tokhang” murders. Eventually, Lascañas fled the country and revealed everything he knew about the slaughter of 30,000 people during the anti-drug war as well as the murders of the enemies of the Duterte political dynasty. In 2022, Fuentes also signed the arrest warrant for Walden Bello for the cyberlibel case filed against him by Sara Duterte’s cherished staff member Jefry Tupas.

title: La bande à « Balance ton Claude »
content:
Nous avons déjà longuement abordé les ressorts de l'« affaire Thélyson Orélien » dans nos pages (nous renvoyons, entre autres, à

cet excellent texte de Jean Claude Noel

). L'enquête qui suit porte sur ses délateurs, la bande à « Balance ton Claude » du nom du compte X à l'origine de la polémique. On y découvre que l'affaire Thélyson Orélien, est un double écran de fumée qui masque une convergence d'intérêts, financiers, idéologiques et géopolitiques, entre l'industrie de l'IA, les libertariens de la Silicon Valley, les christo-fascistes de l'administration Trump, et leurs imitateurs bien-de-chez-nous.


« Démarche complètement apolitique », « lanceur d'alerte », anonymat nécessaire pour éviter les attaques

ad hominem

… Toutes ces auto-justifications offertes par la bande à « Balance ton Claude », qui est derrière la polémique Thélyson Orélien, servent à ripoliner une opération idéologique, menée par un groupe de jeunes « libéraux-conservateurs » (doux euphémisme), très actifs dans l'espace médiatique, depuis les colonnes du Figaro, et les fabriques à propagande du projet Périclès. En outre, ces alarmes hypocrites s'inscrivent dans les récits

IApocalyptiques

 déployés par l'industrie pour faire gonfler investissements publics et privés. Une bulle profitant surtout aux nouveaux technoligarques, qui sont prêts à jeter la démocratie et l'humanité entière dans le chaudron de la valorisation et de la domination sans partage.


Les problèmes posés par la rédaction

I

A

ssistée

cachent une autre forme d'imposture : les allégations de neutralité politique répétées par la bande à « Balance ton Claude ». Une fine équipe, composée de cinq membres, d'après le premier accusateur anonyme sorti du bois

 [

1

]

, et qui n'a pas eu droit à la même attention que Thélyson Orélien.


«

Notre démarche était complètement apolitique

 [

2

]


 »

, déclarait ainsi Samuel Fitoussi dans

Le Point

, après avoir tombé le masque. Pourtant, le profil de nos Claudettes risque d'affoler votre détecteur à

bullshit

. Pas besoin du logiciel Pangram, vous allez voir, pour confondre ces immenses tartufes, présentés comme des «

lanceurs d'alerte

ayant

 l'amour de la vérité chevillé au coeur

et dénonçant les impostures intellectuelles

 [

3

]

 ».


Samuel Fitoussi


Commençons par vous donner une idée de l'honnêteté intellectuelle de M. Fitoussi. Quelques heures après avoir lancé la polémique sur le livre de Thélyson Orélien depuis le compte X « Balance ton Claude » (encore anonyme à ce moment-là), le chroniqueur du

Figaro

 intervient sur Radio J, où il déclare : «

comme aujourd'hui, le RN n'est pas un parti particulièrement violent ou antisémite ou quoi que ce soit, [renvoyer dos à dos les extrêmes] c'est en fait banaliser la dangerosité de cette gauche pro-Hamas...

 »


La journaliste lui fait alors remarquer que l'extrême-droite est quand même «

très proche de l'AfD, un parti néo-nazi

 ». Réponse de Samuel Fitoussi : «

J'ai beaucoup de critiques à l'égard de ces partis. Pour le RN, par exemple, je les trouve étatistes, socialistes, relativement incompétents

 […]

mais je pense qu'il faut reconnaître que les choses ont évolué, que le RN n'est plus le RN d'il y a 30 ans, et c'est même plus le RN d'il y a dix ans, qui voulait sortir de l'Union européenne, et c'est plus le RN antisémite

 [

4

]

 ».

L

'amour de la vérité chevillé au cœur

, on vous dit.


Par ailleurs, l'intérêt de M. Fitoussi pour les implications de l'IA générative n'est pas pure curiosité, étant donné qu'il travaille pour le fonds d'investissement FRST CAPITAL, spécialisé dans l'industrie naissante du

machine learning

(un des domaines informatiques que l'on trouve derrière la formule générique « IA », et dont les avancées ont notamment permis le développement des « grands modèles de langage » – ou

LLM

 – comme le célèbre ChatGPT).


Incidemment, FRST CAPITAL est une ancienne filiale d'OTIUM CAPITAL, la holding de Pierre-Edouard Stérin, milliardaire christo-libertarien qui utilise ses gains pour financer un projet de conquête politique par l'extrême-droite, baptisé « Périclès » (pour Patriotes, Enracinés, Résistants, Identitaires, Chrétiens, Libéraux, Européens, Souverainistes), et doté d'un budget de 150 millions d'euros

 [

5

]

.

title: Terminal Kadıköy’ün reklam ekranı hack’lendi: “Bu bina kent suçudur”
content:
İstanbul'un Kadıköy Söğütlüçeşme’deki Terminal Kadıköy’de bulunan bir reklam ekranı, “BU BİNA KENT SUÇUDUR” yazısıyla hack’lendi. Kent hakkı savunucuları, deprem toplanma alanı ve yeşil alanın alışveriş merkezine (AVM) dönüştürülmesine tepki göstererek kentlerin her alanının kâr maksimizasyonuna göre planlandığını vurguladı.


ETHA’daki habere göre, Söğütlüçeşme Tren İstasyonu’nun viyadük altındaki alanında kurulan Terminal Kadıköy, Nisan 2025’ten bu yana işletiliyor. Açıldığı günden bu yana onlarca dükkânın faaliyet gösterdiği alan, yeni bir tüketim merkezine dönüştü.


Kent hakkı savunucuları, ekoloji örgütleri ve Kadıköylüler, projeye karşı yıllardır itirazlarını sürdürüyor. Haydarpaşa Dayanışması, projeyi “soylulaştırma merkezi” olarak nitelendirerek “Kamusal alanlar ticarileşiyor, bu bir kent suçudur” açıklamasını yapmıştı.


Savunucular, AVM’ye dönüştürülen alanın geçmişte sokakta yaşayan hayvanların kent sakinleri tarafından beslendiği geniş bir yeşil alan olduğunu belirtiyor. Bölgenin yıllarca “izbe bir alan, güvensiz bir yer” olarak tanımlandığını aktaran kent hakkı savunucuları, bu söylemle projeye toplumsal rıza oluşturulmaya çalışıldığını ifade ediyor.


500’den fazla ağaç kesildi


Proje kapsamında bölgede 500’den fazla ağaç kesildi. Kent hakkı savunucuları, Söğütlüçeşme’deki alanın deprem toplanma alanı niteliği taşıdığını ve projenin bu işlevi fiilen ortadan kaldırdığını belirtiyor.


Savunucular, “Hem bir deprem toplanma alanı hem kentsel bir yeşil alanın tümü, bir avuç AVM’ye kurban edildi” diyerek kamusal alanın sermayeye peşkeş çekilmesine tepki göstermişti.


Çevre, Şehircilik ve İklim Değişikliği Bakanlığı ise proje için “ÇED Gerekli Değildir” kararı vermişti.


Terminal Kadıköy sonrası Kadıköy’de artan yoğunluk ve trafik baskısı

author: Blanca Missé
title: As More Unions Oppose ICE and Israel, the Right Is Cracking Down
content:
The right is trying to gain access to labor unions’ minutes, membership lists, and Zoom chats.

Honest, paywall-free news is rare. Please support our boldly independent journalism with a donation of any size.

On September 22, The Free Press attacked the California Faculty Association (CFA), which represents about 29,000 faculty, librarians, counselors, and coaches across the California State University (CSU) system. Drawing on private discussions about a proposed Jewish caucus, including communications from a union Zoom meeting, the article accused CFA of antisemitism. How those communications reached the publication remains unclear. Two days later, the Jewish Journal amplified those allegations, urging Gov. Gavin Newsom to consider them as he weighed California Assembly Bill (AB) 2551, CFA-sponsored legislation challenging campus protest restrictions imposed after the 2024 Palestine solidarity encampments. Less than a week after The Free Press story was published, Newsom vetoed the bill.

Pro-Israel and Jewish advocacy organizations had already campaigned against AB 2551 before the union’s internal deliberations were targeted, arguing that greater scrutiny would weaken rules needed to protect Jewish students from harassment and intimidation. Newsom’s veto does not prove coordination, but the campaign portraying CFA as hostile to Jewish students had become entangled with the union’s fight against campus protest restrictions.

The CSU’s systemwide policy prohibits encampments, overnight demonstrations, and unauthorized structures. The CSU Academic Senate immediately condemned the restrictions as undermining academic freedom when it was instituted in 2024, while CFA warned that vague definitions of disruption threatened constitutionally protected speech, assembly, protest, and future strike activity. A major 2026 ACLU-Amnesty study, investigating 80 campuses over two years, documented sweeping repression of Palestine solidarity protests. As the report found, universities “have imposed sweeping restrictions on student speech, initiated disciplinary actions against students, and imposed severe punishments, including expulsions and suspensions.” The ACLU has insisted that even legitimate time, place, and manner restrictions “must leave ample room for students to express themselves.”

The controversy reaches beyond CFA and CSU. Unions and rank-and-file organizations committed to Palestine solidarity have been forced to relitigate, again and again, whether anti-Zionism and solidarity with Palestinians constitute antisemitism — and whether such organizing should be systematically policed, investigated, or surveilled. At stake is a more fundamental right of the exploited: Can workers democratically connect economic struggles with Palestine solidarity, resistance to anti-immigrant and anti-Black racism, and the defense of civil liberties without exposing their organizing and deliberations to external pressure or repression?

We already have a word for the use of legal process as a political weapon: lawfare. You do not necessarily have to win. Investigation, expense, compelled disclosure, and possible sanctions can exact their own price.

Call its media counterpart pressfare: leaked material, selective or doctored quotations, and public identification can turn people into political targets and invite pressure on employers, universities, or government agencies.

The leaked CFA meeting should not be adjudicated through fragments selected for publication, especially when CFA’s statewide record contradicts the portrayal of a union indifferent to antisemitism. During the 2024 encampments, CFA opposed antisemitism and Islamophobia “in all forms” while supporting the encampments. Amid a 2025 federal antisemitism investigation, it stated that “as CFA members, we are united against antisemitism; it has no place in our communities,” while defending members’ academic freedom. CFA’s Palestine, Arab, and Muslim Caucus likewise defines its mission as confronting racism “in all its manifestations,” explicitly including antisemitism. The Free Press story — a clear example of pressfare — sought to overwrite this legacy with weaponized accusations, undermining the trust that workers place in the sanctity of their union spaces and processes.

Antisemitism demands to be taken seriously — which is why accusations of anti-Jewish discrimination should not be instrumentalized. Kenneth Stern, director of the Bard Center for the Study of Hate, has …

title: Bosna Hersek'te EUFOR'a ait helikopter düştü: 4 İtalya askeri hayatını kaybetti
content:
Fotoğraf: Gian Marco Anzellotti from Roma, Italia/Wikimedia Commons CC BY-SA 2.0

Bosna Hersek'in kuzeyindeki Brcko'da, Avrupa Birliği (AB) Barış Gücü Misyonuna (EUFOR) ait askeri helikopterin düşmesi sonucu 4 kişi hayatını kaybetti, 11 kişi yaralandı.

EUFOR'dan yapılan açıklamada, Brcko bölgesinde rutin bir operasyon sırasında hava araçlarından birinin düştüğü belirtildi.

Kaza yerine Brcko polisi, itfaiye ve acil sağlık ekipleri sevk edildi. Bölge güvenlik altına alınırken, yerel basında yayımlanan görüntülerde helikopterin tamamen parçalandığı görüldü.

Helikopterde kaç kişinin bulunduğu henüz resmi olarak açıklanmazken, askerlerin tamamının İtalyan olduğu öğrenildi.

İtalya Başbakanı Giorgia Meloni, Bosna Hersek'te EUFOR'a ait bir İtalyan helikopterinin karıştığı trajik kaza haberinin derin bir acı kaynağı olduğunu belirtti.

"Düşüncelerinin, hayatını kaybedenler, onların aileleri ve bölgede barış ve istikrar misyonunda görev yaparken bu saatleri endişe içinde geçiren herkesle birlikte olduğunu" söyleyen Meloni, "Kendilerine en içten yakınlığımı ve İtalyan hükümetinin dayanışmasını iletiyorum" ifadesini kullandı.

title: European dockers to strike against war (Socialist Worker-UK)
content:
Workers are ‘calling for an end to war, austerity and to threats to trade union freedoms’

Dockers strike comes as revolts spread across Europe (Photo: sicobas.lavoratoriautorganizzati.9/Facebook)

Ports across the Mediterranean will shut down this Friday as workers at over 100 in 17 countries go on strike.

For years, military cargo used to ravage Palestine has gone through civilian ports across the world.

These workers are uniting their demands over pay and conditions with the fightback against war and genocide.

Giorgos Gogos, president of the Dockworkers’ Union of Piraeus Port Authority in Greece, spoke to Socialist Worker about the action.

He said, “We have called a global day of action against the militarisation of ports and war. We are calling for an end to austerity and to threats to trade unions’ freedoms.

“Across the world, armed conflicts are increasing instability and insecurity,” he said. “People are bleeding for the profits of imperialists and capitalists.

“Plans for militarisation like the European Union’s ReArm Europe project affect all European ports, states, societies and citizens,” he said.

“There is international dialogue between dockers in the European Dockworkers Council and many others.

“Dockworkers have a tradition of international cooperation. We have struggled and won together many times.”

The strike comes as revolts are spreading across Europe. In Italy a general strike has been called for the same day.

Giorgos said, “We think that every struggle from below has to link with others and in unity for social rights and trade union rights.

“Many social struggles are spreading with shared demands. Our action is following the young people and students in France, Albania, Belgium, Spain.

“We want to connect with them because we face similar problems. People are fed up with decisions from elites.

“Our militant answer to these attacks is going to be more effective if they are coordinated across Europe.

“We are asking British workers to support us practically and participate in the struggle for peace and prosperity. We are demanding welfare not warfare.”

30 October, International day of action in support of dock and port workers. Go to stopwar.org.uk

title: Senator Briefed on Trump’s Iran War Plans Warns of “Devastating Escalation”
content:
Sen. Chris Murphy said the plans would lead to the “destruction of our commitment to the rule of law” if carried out.

Honest, paywall-free news is rare. Please support our boldly independent journalism with a donation of any size.

A senator who was briefed on President Donald Trump’s plans to launch intense strikes on Iran after the midterm elections has warned that the attacks are slated to be so horrific that they will lead to the “destruction” of the U.S.’s “commitment to the rule of law.”

At an event hosted by the Middle East Institute on Wednesday, Sen. Chris Murphy (D-Connecticut), a member of the Senate Foreign Relations Committee, said that he was recently in a “fairly detailed” briefing with Pentagon officials about the war plan.

“I will just say this: Their plan … will lead to devastating escalation and the likely destruction of our commitment to the rule of law,” Murphy said.

“The plan that they have developed will lead, in my view, to a prolonged escalation of this war that will be devastating for our security interests,” he went on, adding that it would also put the lives of U.S. soldiers at risk when Iran retaliates.

Murphy said that he couldn’t share details of the plan, but, when asked to elaborate, he pointed to recent reporting on the campaigns that the Pentagon has drawn up on behalf of President Donald Trump and Secretary of Defense Pete Hegseth.

On Tuesday, The Wall Street Journal reported that the U.S. has informed Gulf countries that it is prepared for a “short, intense military campaign” after the election next week. The Pentagon has created plans to strike a wide variety of targets, reports have said, including Iran’s nuclear energy facilities.

Trump has reportedly explicitly ordered the military to target a large amount of energy infrastructure — largely considered to be civilian in nature. One plan prepared by the military, CNN reported, is for the U.S. to drop the “Mother of All Bombs,” the largest conventional weapon by weight in existence, a 21,000-pound bomb with the ability to destroy everything within its massive blast radius.

The plans, if carried out, may “use tactics that are even more provocative and dangerous, and potentially violative of international law,” Murphy said — worsening tactics that the senator acknowledged have already violated the international war guardrails.

“Every first year law student could tell you that this war is illegal” in the domestic sense, Murphy said. “But it is also clearly in contravention of international law and commitments that we have made to the rule of law to deliberately target civilians and to use the harm or potential harm of civilians as leverage in war.”

Murphy’s comments suggest that Trump is slated to go even further in the illegal war that has already had devastating consequences for Iran’s civilians and economy.

According to an analysis by the National Iranian American Council, U.S.-Israeli strikes have already destroyed or damaged nearly 1,300 schools, 80 energy facilities, and scores of transportation facilities and sites like airports and bridges. The harsh sanctions regime has also ravaged the economy, with over 1 million jobs lost and massive inflation for basic goods like food, even as the value of the rial hits record lows.

The opening strikes of this war also involved the U.S. bombing an elementary school in Minab, Iran, killing over 160 people, including 123 children under 13 years old.

Trump and his cabinet have repeatedly stoked concerns that they may commit even more heinous war crimes against civilians with the president’s repeated genocidal threats to “annihilate” Iran. In his speech to the UN general assembly last month, Trump mused about whether he should “drive [Iran] into hell with no chance of survival and no hope of future greatness or generations.”

Adding to concerns of the administration’s wanton disregard for military procedures and briefings to Congress is the Pentagon’s secrecy regarding its ever-shifting operations.

Murphy noted that, on top of never having sought congressional approval for the war, Pentagon officials have been guarded in private briefings about the war. He said that he gets the sense that, internally, Pentagon officials believe more strikes won’t be effective in achieving the U.S.’s goals — as previous reports have said — but that they have become more reluctant to voice their disagreements with the military’s top brass under Hegseth when speaking with Congress.

title: „War Resisters Welcome!“ Mitmachen bei Adbusting-Aktion?
content:
Am 10. Dezember ist der Internationale Tag der Menschenrechte. Dieses Datum wollen wir nutzen, um in vielen Städten mit selbst gebastelten Plakaten für Asyl für Kriegsdienstverweiger*innen zu protestieren. Dazu haben wir mit Farbe und Papier selber Plakate erstellt. Diese sind grün wie Notausgangsschilder. Sie haben auch die typische weiße Tür, den Pfeil und das menschliche Piktogramm. Doch das Piktogramm hat einen Stahlhelm und ein Gewehr vor dem Notausgang fallen gelassen. Dazu steht auf dem Poster weiß auf Grün der Slogan „War Resisters Welcome!“ Wie Du mitmachen kannst, erfährst Du hier:


Asyl für Kriegsdienstverweigerer*innen


Ohne Soldat*innen können Diktaturen keine Kriege führen. Deswegen ist Asyl für Kriegsdienstverweiger*innen und Deserteur*innen so wichtig. Aber entgegen vollmundiger Ankündigungen will die Bundesregierung diese Leute aus Russland und Belarus lieber schnell wieder los sein. Nur etwas weniger als 100 russische Deserteur*innen, Kriegsdienstverweiger*innen und vor der Einberufung Geflüchtete hat die Bundesregierung bisher anerkannt!


Aufmerksamkeit schaffen mit Adbusting


Adbusting, also das Kapern von Werbevitrinen, ist eine sehr gute Möglichkeit, um einem politischem Thema Raum in der Öffentlichkeit zu verschaffen. Und das ist nicht einmal verboten: Die Staatsanwaltschaft Berlin findet, dass das Öffnen und Hineinhängen eigener Poster nicht strafbar sei. Wir wollen mit selbst gebastelten Postern in Werbevitrinen im öffentlichen Raum Asyl für Kriegsdienstverweiger*innen fordern.


Mitmachen?


Du und deine Gruppe wollen gerne mitmachen, habt aber noch keine Erfahrung mit Adbusting? Keine Bange, dann könnt ihr das bei uns lernen! Denn wir haben das Skillshare „Bundeswehr-Werbung busten!“ vorbereitet. Es findet in Berlin vom Freitag, den 4. bis Sonntag, den 6. Dezember statt. Das genaue Programm findet ihr hier:


https://antimil-aktionsnetzwerk.site36.net/2026/10/27/skillshare-bundeswehr-werbung-busten-berlin-4-6-12-2026/


Schon Erfahrung?


Ihr habt schon Erfahrung mit Adbusting? Super, schreibt uns an antimil_aktionsnetzwerk@riseup.net Dann können wir gemeinsam Absprachen treffen, wie die Poster zu euch kommen. Bitte sendet uns nach der Aktion schicke Bilder der Poster in den gekaperten Werbevitrinen in eurer Stadt zu. Macht die Fotos bitte in einem horizontalen Format. Bitte fotografiert die Bilder so, dass man die Slogans lesen kann. Und bitte gerne vor einem Gebäude oder einer Straßenszene, die symbolisch für eure Stadt ist. Bitte überlegt auch, ob ihr nicht an unserem Skillshare „Bundeswehr-Werbung busten“!“ in Berlin vom Freitag, den 4. Dezember bis Sonntag, den 6. Dezember teilnehmen möchtet. Eure Erfahrung und euer Wissen ist sicher wertvoll! Das genaue Programm findet ihr hier:


https://antimil-aktionsnetzwerk.site36.net/2026/10/27/skillshare-bundeswehr-werbung-busten-berlin-4-6-12-2026/


Repression?


Doch, Adbusting gibt Ärger. Es hat sich in den letzten zehn Jahren dank wehrhafter Soli-Arbeit zwar einiges getan. Damals beschäfftigte sich das Terrorabwehrzentrum GETZ vier Mal mit Adbusting, der Bundesverfassungsschutz warnte in seinem jährlichen Bericht für 2018 vor Adbusting als Gefahr für die Republik und die Berliner Cops traten 2017 und 2018 verzweifelt allem und jedem, den sie mit Adbusting in Verbindung bringen konnten, die Tür ein. Das hat sich geändert: Das Bundesverfassungsgericht erklärte 2023 Hausdurchsuchungen wegen Adbusting für illegal. In Berlin werden Verfahren wegen Adbusting seit 2020 eingestellt, wenn beim Aufhängen eigener selbst produzierter Plakate nichts geklaut oder kaputt gemacht wurde. Das Ordnungsamt Tübingen versuchte es 2025 erfolglos mit der Behauptung einer Ordnungswidrigkeit. In Schwerin gab es 2026 sogar einen Freispruch.


Oldenburg?


Doch In Oldenburg ging die Staatsanwaltschaft gerade mit einer Hausdurchsuchung gegen selbst gedruckte Adbustings vor. Auf Urteile aus Karlsruhe scheißen sei dort „übliches Vorgehen“, sagt die Staatsanwaltschaft.


Guten Chancen


Wir denken, dass man angesichts der juristischen Lage gute Chancen hat, auch in Oldenburg aus Ärger wieder rauszukommen, wenn wir uns anschließend gemeinsam kollektiv angemessen gegen Repression wehren. Aber klar: Erfolgreicher Protest führt im demokratischen Rechtstaat erstmal zu Repression und viel Arbeit; das muss jedem klar sein, der/die sich auf diese Weise politisch engagiert. author: webdev@democracynow.org (Democracy Now!)
title: Nobel Peace Laureate Navi Pillay on ICC, Gaza, Rape as War Crime, Her South African Roots & Mandela
content:
We speak with the acclaimed South African human rights lawyer and international jurist Navi Pillay, who was awarded this year’s Nobel Peace Prize. Pillay has been the United Nations high commissioner for human rights and a judge at both the International Criminal Court and at an international tribunal investigating the 1994 genocide in Rwanda. Most recently, she led the U.N. Independent International Commission of Inquiry that concluded Israel had committed genocide in Gaza. Hours after Pillay was announced as winner of the Nobel Prize, the United States imposed sweeping new sanctions against the International Criminal Court.


“It’s extremely shocking to me, totally unacceptable, that the United States administration can today impose sanctions against the International Criminal Court,” says Pillay, speaking to

Democracy Now!

 from The Hague.


Navi Pillay is now 85 years old. She was born into an Indian Tamil family in apartheid South Africa in 1941. The first woman to start a law practice in Natal, South Africa, in 1967, Pillay began her legal career defending anti-apartheid activists including Nelson Mandela, exposing torture, and helping establish key rights for prisoners on Robben Island. Mandela, as president, later appointed Pillay to the High Court of South Africa, making her the first woman of color on that bench.

title: ABD ara seçimleri: Yenilgiye yürüyen Trump, Kongre'yle savaşa hazırlanıyor
content:
ABD Başkanı Donald Trump, 24 Ekim'de Georgia eyaletinde düzenlenen Cumhuriyetçi Parti seçim mitinginde İran savaşının Amerikan petrol şirketlerine nasıl büyük paralar kazandırdığından söz ederken danışmanlarının, bu konulara girmemesi için kendisini uyardığını anlattı.


Danışmanları, Başkana, halk benzin istasyonlarında durmadan yükselen fiyatlarla boğuşurken petrol şirketlerinin kazancıyla övünmesinin tepki çekeceğini hatırlatmıştı. Trump, bunlara hiç aldırmadan konuşmayı sürdüreceğini söyledi:


“Zerre kadar umurumda değil. Söyleyeceğim. Deli gibi servet kazanıyoruz." 


Trump, yükselen petrol fiyatları sayesinde ABD'nin zenginleştiğini savundu; fiyatların yakında düşeceğini vaat etti. Ancak Trump'ın petrol şirketleri açısından kazanç saydığı gelişme, milyonlarca Amerikalı için geçim sıkıntısının başlıca nedenlerinden biri olmaya devam ediyor ve pompada benzin fiyatı düşmüyor.


Amerikan Otomobil Birliğinin (AAA) 28 Ekim verilerine göre benzinin litresi ortalama 1,12 dolar. İran savaşından önce yüzde 40 daha düşüktü. Dizelin litresi ise 1,68 dolara ulaştı. Bu fiyatlar muazzam vergi yüküyle oluşan Türkiye'deki karşılıklarının altındaysa da, iki yakasını bir araya getirmekte zorlanan ABD tüketicileri açısından giderleri üzerine binen katlanılmaz bir yük halini alıyor. 


Yüksek akaryakıt fiyatları yalnızca otomobil sahiplerinin ulaşım masraflarını değil, nakliyeyi, tarımsal üretimi ve tüketim mallarının fiyatlarını da etkiliyor.


Demokratlar anketlerde önde, Kongre'nin geleceği belirsiz


Gelecek hafta, 3 Kasım Salı günü Temsilciler Meclisi'nin 435 sandalyesinin tamamı ve Senato'daki 35 sandalye için seçim yapılacak. Cumhuriyetçiler her iki meclisteki çoğunluklarını korumaya, Demokratlar ise Trump yönetimi üzerinde etkili bir Kongre denetimi kurmaya çalışıyor.


26 Ekim'de tamamlanan Reuters/Ipsos araştırmasında Trump'ın görevini onaylayanların oranı yüzde 32. Kayıtlı seçmenlerin yüzde 47'si Demokrat, yüzde 36'sı Cumhuriyetçi Kongre adaylarına oy vereceğini belirtiyor.


Ancak ülke çapındaki toplam oy üstünlüğü doğrudan Kongre'ye gönderilecek temsilci çoğunluğuna denk gelmiyor. ABD Temsilciler Meclisi'ne gidecek üyeler seçim bölgelerinin sınırlarına bağlı, her seçim bölgesi aynı sayıda seçmen barındırmıyor. Senatoda ise yalnızca belirli eyaletlerde seçim yapılması sonuçlar üzerinde belirleyici olabiliyor. 


Cumhuriyetçiler halen 100 üyeli Senato'da 53'e karşı 47 ile çoğunlukta. Demokratların bu mecliste çoğunluğu ele geçirmesi için net 4 sandalye daha kazanması gerekiyor.


Partiler özellikle Maine, Kuzey Carolina, Ohio, Iowa ve Teksas gibi kritik eyaletlerde yoğun kampanyalar yürütüyor. Seçim gözlemcileri, Temsilciler Meclisi'nde Demokratların kazanımlar elde edebileceği bir ortamın varlığından söz ederken Senato yarışlarının sonucuna ilişkin belirsizlik sürüyor.


İran savaşının 47 milyar dolarlık faturası


Cumhuriyetçilerin karşı karşıya olduğu en önemli sorunlardan başında, ABD ve İsrail'in 28 Şubat'ta İran'a saldırmasıyla başlayan savaşın ekonomik ve siyasi sonuçları geliyor. 


Reuters'ın 28 Ekim'de açıkladığı Pentagon hesaplarına göre savaşın doğrudan askerî maliyeti 47 milyar doları aştı. Bunun 29 milyar dolarından fazlası, kullanılan mühimmatın yenilenmesi ve 6 milyar dolardan fazlası, kaybedilen veya hasar gören askerî araçların yerine konması için gerekli. 


Bu hesaba savaşın küresel enerji piyasalarında yol açtığı fiyat artışları dahil değil.


Nisanda varılan ateşkes, kalıcı bir barış anlaşmasına dönüşmedi. ABD'nin İran'a uyguladığı deniz ablukası sürerken, Trump yönetimi yeni bir askerî operasyon olasılığını da gündemde tutuyor.


Trump, 8 Ekim'de, seçimlerden önce yeni bir saldırı düzenlemeyeceğini açıklamıştı. Ancak 28 Ekim'de bu seçim sonrasında İran'a yeniden saldırılıp saldırılmayacağı sorulduğunda “Her şey mümkün” yanıtını verdi.


Bu koşullar altında ABD seçmenleri, süre giden savaşın sonuçlanmadığı ve yeniden tırmanma olasılığının ortadan kalkmadığı bir dönemde sandığa gidiyor olacak.


ABD Çalışma İstatistikleri Bürosuna göre eylülde yıllık tüketici enflasyonu yüzde 3,7'ye ulaştı. Enerji fiyatları bir yıl içinde yüzde 20,4, benzin fiyatları ise yüzde 34,2 arttı.


İran savaşı böylece dış politika tartışmalarını aşarak Amerikalı ailelerinin günlük harcamalarına ve seçim tercihlerine doğrudan yansıyor.


Rusya'yla uzlaşmanın arkasındaki enerji hesabı


İran savaşının enerji piyasalarına etkisi, Trump'ın Ukrayna savaşına ilişkin girişimlerinde de hissediliyor.

title: The AKP cannot function without war
content:
It is becoming increasingly clear with each passing day that the process initiated by Kurdish leader Abdullah Öcalan through his February 27, 2025 Call for Peace and Democratic Society amounts, in a sense, to a disruption of the established game. To the domestic and international powers that divided Kurdistan into four parts, imposed genocide on the Kurds, and have benefited from the Kurdish question and the contradictions and conflicts it has generated, the message was effectively: “I will not play the game you want and impose on me. I will play my own game.” In this way, Öcalan has challenged the politics of war and moved toward adopting a politics of peace.


This new strategy and policy developed by Abdullah Öcalan has undoubtedly shocked and bewildered the forces that have tied themselves to, and benefited from, the strategy of conflict arising from the Kurdish question. It appears that the AKP is among those most taken aback. Indeed, under present conditions, when Turkey’s interests and democratic future lie in a politics of peace, the AKP remains unable to break away from its entrenched politics of war and militarization. It has failed to respond positively as required to the peace process initiated by Öcalan. The steadily increasing violence, judicial repression, and police pressure across all areas of life in Kurdistan and Turkey are manifestations of this. By sending military equipment to Saudi Arabia for use against the Houthis in Yemen, preparing to deploy troops, and developing new military alliances in the region, the AKP demonstrates that it cannot function without war and is unable to abandon its politics of war.


As of October 29, the Republic of Turkey will have completed its 103rd year since its founding and will be entering its 104th year. If the period that began with the fascist military coup of September 12, 1980, is to be defined as the “Second Republic,” then the AKP’s quarter-century in power undoubtedly constitutes the central ruling force of this period. It could also be put this way: The “Second Republic” process initiated by the military junta headed by Kenan Evren found its true ruling power under Tayyip Erdoğan’s leadership. In other words, the “Second Republic” was shaped by the mentality of Kenan Evren and Tayyip Erdoğan. Its only difference from the First Republic was the incorporation of political Islam, which had previously been excluded from the state under the label of “reactionism,” into the state apparatus. Thus, the “Second Republic” continued and intensified its hostility toward the Kurds and communism.


Let us look back and recall this recent history. The Evren–Özal alliance, which laid the foundations of the September 12 regime, became the driving force behind this transformation of the Republic. It was primarily Turgut Özal who carried this forward, developing the political line inherited from Menderes and Demirel, albeit with cautious and hesitant steps. When the same Turgut Özal sought to pursue a similar approach toward the Kurds, however, that intention cost him his life. Necmettin Erbakan attempted to advance the process initiated by the Evren–Özal alliance, but his approach to the Kurdish question was also deemed unacceptable, and he was pushed aside. Having drawn the necessary lessons from all these developments, Tayyip Erdoğan became the most skillful and thorough practitioner of the mentality and policies of September 12.


Tayyip Erdoğan’s nearly quarter-century in power should also be examined in two distinct periods. During the first period, when he was still engaged in a fierce power struggle with the secularist forces of the Republic, he was compelled to forge both covert and overt alliances to consolidate his strength. To succeed in this struggle, he pursued a policy of presenting himself as generally “pro-peace.” Indeed, during this period, whenever elections approached, he requested a ceasefire from the PKK and secured electoral victories by ensuring that elections were held in an atmosphere of ceasefire. In the second period, after neutralizing the secularist forces within the Republic, he fully aligned himself with the Turkish Republic’s deeply entrenched anti-Kurdish and militaristic policies. He donned a military uniform and sought to fulfill the role of commander-in-chief. During this period, he undoubtedly adopted a strategy of winning elections by escalating both domestic and external conflicts.

author: James Crump
title: Dockworkers From 100 Ports to Disrupt Military and Energy Supplies to Israel
content:
Dock and port workers from 17 countries will disrupt and block exports to Israel on Friday, with workers joining from countries including Italy, Mexico, Turkey, the US, Morocco and India.


Representatives from more than 100 ports will participate in the international day of action on 30 October, calling for an end to Israel’s genocide against Palestinians and “US-Israeli wars of aggression”.


The Palestinian BDS National Committee (BNC)


announced on X

 that workers will take action by “peacefully disrupting and blocking the transfer of military, energy and other dual-use supplies to Israel, including by refusing to handle such supplies”.


Workers will also pressure governments to impose a full military embargo on Israel and end “trade, economic and academic relations serving its illegal occupation and apartheid”.


Explaining the day of action, the BNC said that Israel’s “criminal wars” are “exacerbating the cost of living and economic crises worldwide”.


“Military budgets are swelling in the colonial West, while families and workers struggle with the cost of health, housing, transportation, and education. Our struggles are interlinked,” it stated.


A further 17 Palestinian trade unions and federations have endorsed the action, stating: “Our struggle for justice in Palestine is inseparable from the global struggle against systemic racism, militarisation, exploitation, climate devastation and all forms of oppression.”


The day of action comes a year after dockworkers in Italy

blocked the ports

 of Genoa and Livorno, with unions closing schools and stopping transportation as part of an Italy-wide general strike in response to Israel preventing the

Global Sumud Flotilla

 from reaching Gaza in 2025.


The flotilla was the largest ever naval mission to attempt to deliver humanitarian supplies to Gaza, with around 20 vessels carrying delegates from at least 44 countries.


The flotilla was subject to drone attacks before being illegally intercepted by Israel in international waters. Those on board were detained and have accused Israeli forces of subjecting them to human rights abuses including assault, degrading treatment, and the withholding of medical care.

author: PETA-Team
title: Tierpark Neumünster: PETA kritisiert halbherzige Neuausrichtung mit heimischen Wildtieren
content:
Update vom 29. Oktober 2026


Künftig weniger

 „

exotische Tiere

”

im Tierpark Neumünster


Laut Medienberichten will der Tierpark Neumünster in Zukunft vor allem heimische Wildtiere zur Schau stellen. Viele der dort gehaltenen „exotischen“ Tiere, darunter der 26-jährige Eisbär Vitus, sollen künftig andernorts untergebracht werden.


Wir von PETA Deutschland begrüßen die geplante Abgabe exotischer Tiere als Schritt in die richtige Richtung, da wir die schlechten Haltungsbedingungen im Tierpark seit Jahren kritisieren. Damit die Tiere eine Chance auf ein besseres Leben haben, muss bei der Vermittlung der Tiere sichergestellt werden, dass sie nicht in ungeeignete Privathaltungen oder andere fragwürdige Einrichtungen gelangen.


Allerdings sollten auch heimische Wildtiere wie Elche, Wisente und Luchse nicht in Gefangenschaft leben müssen – selbst weitläufige Waldgehege können ihren komplexen Bedürfnissen nicht gerecht werden.


Wir fordern deshalb, dass der Tierpark künftig ausschließlich als Auffangstation für beschlagnahmte und aus schlechter Haltung gerettete Tiere dient.


Update vom 13. Juli 2026


Eisbärin Larissa ist eingeschläfert worden


Die Eisbärin Larissa wurde am 10. Juli 2026 im Tierpark Neumünster getötet, da sich ihr gesundheitlicher Zustand altersbedingt verschlechtert hat. Mit 36 Jahren galt sie laut dem Tierpark als die älteste Eisbärin der Welt. Larissa zeigte, wie viele Eisbären in Zoos, deutliche Verhaltensstörungen. Wir von PETA Deutschland hatten bereits 2022 ein Video veröffentlicht, in dem zu sehen ist, wie sie über längere Zeit immer wieder dieselben wenigen Meter am Beckenrand auf und ab lief.


Aufgrund ihrer traurigen Lebensgeschichte fordern wir erneut ein Ende der Eisbärenhaltung in Zoos und setzen uns mit einer Petition an das Bundeslandwirtschaftsministerium dafür ein, die Zucht der Tiere auslaufen zu lassen.


Originalbeitrag vom 22. Juni 2023


Video: Erschreckendes Tierleid im Tierpark Neumünster


Seit Jahren erhalten wir bei PETA Deutschland regelmäßig Hinweise von Whistleblower:innen auf Tierleid im Tierpark Neumünster. Im April 2023 dokumentierten wir daraufhin selbst vor Ort schlechte Haltungsbedingungen und

Verhaltensstörungen

 bei mehreren Tieren im

Zoo

, die nach unserer Einschätzung auf seelisches Leid hinweisen. Wir haben daher Strafanzeige gegen den Tierpark erstattet.


Verhaltensgestört: Eisbären laufen immer hin und her


In einem Video ist zu sehen, wie die

Eisbärin

 Larissa am Beckenrand immer wieder ziellos wenige Meter auf und ab läuft. Auch ihr Partner Vitus schwimmt die immer gleichen kleinen Kreise. Larissa und Vitus sind beide seit April 2017 in dem winzigen, heruntergekommenen Gehege in Neumünster eingesperrt. Die Verhaltensstörungen der beiden Eisbären sind seit Jahren bekannt und wurden uns seit 2018 wiederholt gemeldet, teilweise auch mit Videomaterial.


„Das Eisbärenpaar zeigt sehr auffällige Verhaltensstörungen. Einer läuft hin und her […] und der andere schwimmt im Pool in einem kleinen Radius im Kreis stundenlang.“

Whistleblower-Meldung vom Juli 2022


„ […] wir haben heute den Tierpark in Neumünster besucht und sind nachhaltig schockiert, unter welchen Bedingungen die Tiere dort gehalten werden. Die Eisbären […] laufen in einem sehr kleinen Gehege immer wieder verstört denselben Weg und wirken höchst apathisch. Das Gehege ist verwildert, verschmutzt und das Wasser im Schwimmbecken der Tiere ist so grün, dass man nicht hine[i]n sehen kann.“

Whistleblower-Meldung vom August 2018


Das Eisbären-Gehege ist beengt und heruntergekommen.


Die ausgeprägten Verhaltensstörungen der Eisbären werden heruntergespielt und „besondere Gerüche“ und ein angeblicher „Hormonüberschuss“ dafür verantwortlich gemacht.


Namhafte Fachleute sind überzeugt, dass Eisbären in Gefangenschaft nicht artgerecht gehalten werden können, da die Diskrepanz zwischen den Bedingungen in ihrem natürlichen Lebensraum und denen im Zoo zu groß ist. [1, 2] Obwohl die Folgen der viel zu kleinen Gehege in Zoos bekannt sind, werden die Tiere weiterhin in diese Leid verursachende Umgebung hineingezüchtet. In freier Natur wandern Eisbären jedes Jahr Hunderte bis Tausende Kilometer. Können sie sich nicht artgemäß bewegen, entwickeln sie auffällige Verhaltensstereotypien, die sich in sich ständig wiederholenden Bewegungsabläufen zeigen. Schon mehrfach veröffentlichte PETA

Videomaterial

, das schwere Zwangsstörungen bei den Tieren belegt.

author: L214
title: Enquête abattoir Cooperl
content:
L214 publie une enquête sur l’étourdissement des cochons au CO₂ dans l’un des plus gros abattoirs de France : l’abattoir Cooperl de Montfort-sur-Meu, en Ille-et-Vilaine (Bretagne).

Les images, commentées par l'écrivaine Marie Darrieussecq, montrent la cruauté de cette méthode d'étourdissement dont les instances scientifiques ont établi qu’elle est source de peur, de détresse et de souffrance.

Plus de trente vétérinaires signent un appel publié ce jour pour demander l’interdiction du gazage au CO₂ des cochons. L214 se joint à cette demande et entame un recours contre l’État pour faire interdire cette pratique. L’enseigne de supermarchés Carrefour fait fabriquer par son partenaire Cooperl ses produits à base de viande de porc sous ses marques distributeurs, notamment sa marque Filière Qualité Carrefour. L’association demande à Carrefour de refuser le gazage des cochons et de signer le Plant Protein Pact.

Le musicien Moby apporte son soutien et appelle à signer la pétition.

Chaque heure d’abattage, plus de 800 cochons sont gazés au CO₂ à l’abattoir Cooperl de Montfort-sur-Meu, en Bretagne. Plongés dans une fosse à haute concentration en CO₂, les cochons ont la sensation de se noyer : ils hurlent, paniquent, cherchent désespérément à fuir. Il leur faut entre 21 et 60 secondes pour perdre conscience…

Ce n’est ni instantané, ni sans souffrance. Les instances scientifiques européenne (EFSA) et britannique (AWC) l’affirment depuis 20 ans : cette méthode provoque douleur, peur et détresse respiratoire. Le Royaume-Uni envisage même d’y renoncer, et plus de trente vétérinaires demandent son interdiction.

Pourtant, l’abattoir Cooperl de Montfort-sur-Meu a investi en 2024 environ 5 millions d'euros dans cet équipement qui permet d’abattre un nombre gigantesque d’animaux, de conquérir de nouveaux marchés, d’augmenter les cadences et la productivité. L’enseigne Carrefour fait fabriquer par son partenaire Cooperl des produits à base de cochons gazés sous ses marques, dont la Filière Qualité Carrefour, tout en se disant « pionnier sur le bien-être animal »…

À l’État français : interdire le gazage au CO₂ des cochons ;

À Carrefour : ne plus s’approvisionner en produits issus de cochons gazés et participer à un changement collectif en s'engageant dans le Plant Protein Pact, pour prendre part à une réduction de moitié du nombre d’animaux tués d’ici 2030.

Plus nous serons nombreux et nombreuses, plus il sera difficile pour les responsables de fermer les yeux. Signez et partagez : les cochons ne peuvent pas parler pour eux-mêmes, mais nous, oui.

title: QUORN HUNT TRAINING HOUNDS TO KILL: WRITE TO YOUR MP
content:
The Hunt Saboteurs Association is asking our supporters to contact their MPs following the release of horrific drone footage involving the Quorn Hunt in Leicestershire.


Members of the Quorn Hunt use the fox’s body to encourage hounds to tear it apart.

Image: Northants Hunt Saboteurs


On Friday 16 October 2026, Northants Hunt Saboteurs filmed an incident near Kirby Bellars in which a fox was killed by hounds during a Quorn Hunt cubbing meet.


Hounds converge on the fox as hunt staff look on. Image:

Northants Hunt Saboteurs


The footage shows hounds seizing and tearing at the fox while hunt staff intervene to repeatedly encourage the hounds to attack. A hunting horn can be seen being blown over the hounds to reinforce the association between the horn call and the kill!


Take action: Contact your MP


Don’t let this disturbing footage go unnoticed.


Write to your MP, ask them to watch the video and to support robust legislation to strengthen the Hunting Act. 


Template letter below:


Organised Hunts hunting as usual – Famous Quorn Hunt filmed killing a fox


Dear [MP]


The 1st November will see the official start of the foxhunting season, but hunts have been out since August training their hounds to hunt and kill. This is called autumn hunting by them and cub hunting by the rest of us. 


This is illustrated by the film we obtained taken from a drone showing the Quorn Hunt killing a fox. This is ‘trail hunting’ in its bloody reality, and it happened just a few days ago, on the eve of the BHSA’s National Trail Hunting Day.


The full video can be viewed here:

https://www.huntsabs.org.uk/smokescreen-saturday-exposed/


Cub hunting is not some isolated activity. It is the preparation for the hunting season ahead. Throughout the autumn, young hounds are taught what to chase, what to kill and how to respond to the huntsman’s commands. What they learn – or fail to learn – during these crucial weeks sets the tone for the entire season.


This is what makes the Quorn Hunt footage so damning. It shows hounds being deliberately encouraged to seize and tear at a fox, with hunt staff repeatedly intervening to reinforce that behaviour.


As the British Hound Sports Association (BHSA) and the Countryside Alliance prepared to showcase so-called ‘trail hunting’ on National Trail Hunting Day – aka Smokescreen Saturday – the Quorn Hunt provided a horrifying glimpse of the reality behind the myth of trail laying.


The BHSA and defenders of so-called trail hunting want the public to believe the same hounds will spend the season following scent trails. Yet here they are, being trained on foxes, and of course, killing to the delight of the hunters.


The footage strikes at the very heart of the trail hunting smokescreen.


We need parliament to finish the consultation and push through a real hunting ban in the next parliament term as promised in the manifesto.


Regards


[Name]


[Address]


Find contact details for your MP here
