author: Alan Robinson
title: Overcoming Schizophrenia and Transforming Psychiatry: An Interview with Dr. Daniel Fisher
content:
Editor’s Note: This Mad in the World report features an interview with eCPR founder Dr. Daniel Fisher, interviewed by Locura en Argentina founder Alan Robinson.


D

r. Daniel Fisher is an international pioneer in the mental health recovery movement who helped transform psychiatric care by demonstrating that full recovery from severe mental health conditions is possible. After personally overcoming a diagnosis of schizophrenia, he earned his medical degree from Harvard Medical School to reform the mental health system from within as a psychiatrist. A former member of the White House Commission on Mental Health and co-developer of Emotional CPR (eCPR), Dr. Fisher’s work has shifted international policy toward human connection and peer-led empowerment rather than forced treatment and lifelong institutionalization. He is also the author of

Heartbeats of Hope: The Empowerment Way to Recover Your Life

, which is being translated into Spanish.


Alan Robinson: Welcome, Dr. Daniel Fisher. In the early 1970s and 1980s, the Mental Patients Liberation Front (MPLF) was rooted in radical resistance. What was your first interaction with them like, and how did working with them shape your vision for peer-run alternatives?


Daniel Fisher:

 I first learned about the Mental Patients Liberation Front by reading a radical mental health newsletter called

Madness Network News

, which was published by a group in San Francisco starting in the early 1970s. At the time, I was completing my medical school training and discovered that the MPLF was located in Boston. When choosing where to do my psychiatric residency, I specifically sought a Harvard teaching hospital in Boston because the MPLF was there—not primarily because of Harvard itself. I instinctively felt that my best education would come from people with lived experience in the mental health system.


Prior to that, I had been hospitalized three times—twice before medical school and once during. Those experiences taught me that the mental health system desperately needed major reform, as the treatment was barbaric. I believed I could change the system from within by becoming a psychiatrist.


Daniel Fisher. Photo by Kermit Cole.


In 1976, I wrote to the MPLF asking to join. They sent back a postcard stating I could join as an ex-patient, but not as a psychiatrist. When I arrived in Boston and began my residency on an inpatient unit, a couple of hospitalized clients whispered to me that they knew who I was, as I had to keep my history quiet due to the severe stigma attached to a schizophrenia diagnosis. Eventually, they formed a group called “Friends of MPLF” for professionals with lived experience. Through that group, I met Judy Chamberlin, author of

On Our Own

, who became my lifelong mentor starting in 1976.


Later, another member blurted out to her psychiatrist—who happened to be Dr. Lee Mock, the head of my psychiatry department—that I was in the group. When I approached Dr. Mock, he called my lived experience a “great asset,” though he advised keeping it secret from other psychiatrists who would not understand.


Robinson:

 How did you handle the potential confusion or conflict of being both a former patient on one hand and a practicing doctor on the other?


Fisher:

 Bridging those two worlds has been a lifelong task. Initially, I coped by leading two separate lives and keeping my lived experience secret for three years, sharing it only with the head of the department. Over time, I earned the trust of survivor advocates. Judy Chamberlin used to joke that I was one of only three psychiatrists in the U.S. whom advocates accepted—the other two being Peter Breggin, author of

Toxic Psychiatry

, and Peter Stastny.


I waited until I finished my three-year residency before publicly disclosing my history. At the end of my residency, I was invited onto a television talk show,

People Are Talking

, to debate forced treatment. I invited my former supervisor to debate me. Right before we walked onto the stage, I told him I was going to reveal my past hospitalization. He sarcastically responded, “It’s very fashionable these days to have been hospitalized”.


Robinson:


Both you and Dr. Pat Deegan received diagnoses of schizophrenia, were told you would never recover, and went on to earn doctorates. Did you feel living proof that the system’s prognosis was completely wrong?

title: روش‌های سازمان‌یابی کمونیستی
content:
This essay is the second part of The Dislocation of Vendémiaire, following Part I, “The Disruptors of the 21st Century and the Ideological Collusion.” While Part I interprets the 2026 France-centered student-led protest wave as a politically dislocated movement—one misread by mainstream discourse as a multi-class coalition when it is in fact an expression of fragmentation within the proletariat—Part II develops the theoretical argument behind that claim. Drawing on Marx’s thesis of society’s polarization into two hostile camps, it distinguishes between “property” and “proletarianization” in the sense of national economics and in the sense of political economy. The essay argues that class should be analyzed through the actual control over the production of labor-power, and that digital capitalism increasingly enables capital to dominate labor-power directly, beyond the mediation of formal ownership of physical means of production. On this basis, it explains why many who appear as middle-class or petty-producer subjects in national-economic terms—scholars, franchise shopkeepers, senior programmers, platform creators—are in political-economic terms being proletarianized, while carrying petty-bourgeois habits of political compromise, individualism, hostility to centralized discipline, and identity- or interest-based linkage. The result is a form of struggle that is radical in appearance but conservative and spontaneous in its core: it completes the first step of linkage through identity and affinity, but fails to return to the common ground of class interests and to connect with the broader industrial working class.

Mussolini continues to tower above and parliament crawls at his feet more than ever.

Full powers have been granted with the care of servants who compete with each other in degradation. Mussolini had said, “give them to me or I’ll take them”, and no one had the dignity to answer, take them from us, but don’t force us to play the part in a comedy of the bosses, when we are servants and are pleased to be so.

The socialists themselves have not understood that they cannot remain with dignity in an assembly that functions under the terror of the baton, or of dissolution, and where opposition can only be a farce.

Dictatorship triumphs: a dictatorship of adventurers without scruples or ideals, which came to power and remains there due to the disorientation of the proletarian masses and the anxious avarice of the bourgeois class in search of a saviour. But everyone feels that the situation is such that it cannot last, and the most enlightened conservatives, while paying due homage to the masters of the hour and revealing with every word the fear that dominates them, demand the restoration of the “liberal state”, that is, a return to constitutional deception.

The method by which Mussolini came to power does not allow deception, and this is what torments the innocent souls of the conservatives.

Mussolini, if he manages to consolidate his power, will do no more and no less than any other minister would: he will serve the interests of the privileged class, and will charge for his services. But he won’t make anyone believe that he arrived in government by the will of the people. His tyranny is too recent for him to be able to hide its origin: perhaps for this reason his murky conscience advises him to appeal to God!

We do not want to deal with the new government’s plans and intentions, whether new or old, sincere or otherwise. It’s always the same habitual rehashing of old lies, the old attempt to repair a collapsing house with a coat of paint.

For us, the only important change is this: we were enemies of government because government is no more than the armed defender of all social injustices, the creator of new injustices, the enemy of freedom, the material obstacle along the path of civilization. And we were enemies of fascism because it is a movement intended to defend bourgeois privileges, to impede the ascent of the proletariat, to choke out any aspiration towards a society more just and free; and it used brutal, ferocious and vile means to achieve its goals.

Now government and fascism have become the same thing, and are made up of the same personnel: there is therefore no longer the possibility of hesitation as there was when those two forces of oppression seemed to oppose each other.

Simplified situation: so much the better. So much the better if this can serve to reunite all the forces of progress in the struggle against triumphant barbarism.

title: Эррико Малатеста - Наконец-то! Что такое "диктатура пролетариата"
content:
Автор

: Эррико Малатеста

Название

: Наконец-то! Что такое "диктатура пролетариата"

Дата

: 28 сентября 1920

Источник

: Umanità Nova, год 1-й, №187


НАКОНЕЦ-ТО!

Что такое "диктатура пролетариата"


 Наконец-то появился тот, кто говорит ясно!


 До сих пор, когда мы говорили, что то, что социалисты называют

диктатурой пролетариата

, на самом деле есть не что иное, как диктатура некоторых людей, которые с поддержкой партии становятся над пролетариатом и навязывают себя ему, нас за это называли чуть ли не клеветниками.


 Вопреки всякой вероятности и всем установленным фактам утверждалось, что в России разрешена та квадратура круга, которой было бы правительство, действительно представляющее интересы и волю управляемых.


 Соответственно, Москва стала Меккой пролетариата: оттуда исходил свет, а вместе со светом – и категорические приказы относительно идей, которых должны придерживаться, и линии поведения, которой должны держаться те, кто с разрешения вышестоящих хотел называть себя коммунистами.


 Вследствие этого изумительного открытия, сделанного в России, – правительства, созданного по образу народа и для блага народа (или пролетариата, как угодно называть), – всё, что приходило из России, казалось обладающим чудотворной силой; и достаточно было назвать по-русски

советом

 любое собрание или комитет, чтобы он был возведён в верховный фактор революции.


 Но вот очарование разрушено.


 На этот раз не мы раскрываем секрет: мы, анархисты, злоязычные и непочтительные по убеждению. На этот раз это официальная газета Итальянской социалистической партии, до сих пор наиболее авторитетный орган московского слова.


 Это

Avanti!

 от 20-го числа текущего месяца, которая говорит:


 «....

В России при советском режиме Партия действительно направляет всю политику Государства, и вся общественная деятельность как отдельных лиц, так и коллективов подчинена решениям Партии, так что

 В САМОМ ДЕЛЕ ДИКТАТУРА ПРОЛЕТАРИАТА ЕСТЬ ДИКТАТУРА ПАРТИИ И, СЛЕДОВАТЕЛЬНО, САМОГО ЦЕНТРАЛЬНОГО КОМИТЕТА».


 Итак, теперь мы знаем, чего нам следует ожидать: диктатуры Руководящего органа Социалистической партии, или диктатуры нарождающейся Коммунистической партии, или даже диктатуры Д'Арагона и компании!


 Но руководители Социалистической партии, претендующие ввести Диктатуру, должны понять, что это, по крайней мере в Италии, невозможно: невозможно, потому что есть мы, анархисты и синдикалисты.


 Если бы мы находились в том же соотношении сил с социалистами, в каком, возможно, оказались наши товарищи в России, дело было бы простым: диктаторы избавились бы от нас средствами, дорогими всем диктатурам, – виселицами и тюрьмами, – и шли бы вперёд, пока не были бы свергнуты революцией или реакцией.


 Но мы уже сила, с которой необходимо считаться, и мы быстро развиваемся, чему благоприятствуют обстоятельства и то, что

Avanti!

 называет

необузданным темпераментом трудящихся масс

. И мы твёрдо решили не подчиняться.


 Не то чтобы мы верили, что массы всегда правы и что мы хотим всегда следовать за массами в их изменчивых настроениях. У нас есть программа, идеал, который мы хотим привести к победе, и поэтому мы отличаемся от массы, – мы люди определенного направления. Мы хотим воздействовать на массу, подталкивать её по пути, который считаем лучшим; но поскольку наша цель – освобождение, а не господство, мы хотим приучать массы к свободной инициативе и свободному действию.


 Мы верим, что свобода учит свободе и солидарности, и поэтому питаем отвращение к любому авторитарному устройству – как в обществе в целом, так и в любой отдельной партии или объединении.


 Социалисты хотели бы подготовить народ к свободе посредством власти.


 Но если бы, по предположению, которое мы отвергаем, было верно, что для торжества революции и устройства нового общества необходимо сосредоточить в немногих руках государственную власть, если бы было верно, что кто-то обязательно должен командовать, – тогда, пусть социалисты хорошенько поймут, – командовать хотели бы мы и не подчинились бы, разве что силой, командованию того, кто, по нашему мнению, заблуждается.


 Следствием чего было бы то, что революция, совершённая по авторитарным меркам и с диктаторскими целями, неизбежно привела бы в Италии к войне между одними революционерами и другими.


 Этого не хотели бы мы; этого не должны хотеть социалисты.


 Поэтому, оставив в стороне теории и судя о вещах реалистично, социалистам следовало бы отказаться от всяких диктаторских притязаний и принять либертарную …

¿QUÉ es el patriotismo? ¿Es el amor por el lugar donde uno nació, el lugar de los recuerdos y las esperanzas de la infancia, de los sueños y las aspiraciones? ¿Es el lugar donde, con ingenuidad infantil, contemplábamos las nubes fugaces y nos preguntábamos por qué nosotros tampoco podíamos correr tan rápido? ¿El lugar donde contábamos los miles de millones de estrellas centelleantes, aterrorizados ante la idea de que cada una de ellas fuera «un ojo» que traspasara lo más profundo de nuestras pequeñas almas? ¿Es el lugar donde escuchábamos el canto de los pájaros y anhelábamos tener alas para volar, como ellos, hacia tierras lejanas? ¿O el lugar donde nos sentábamos a los pies de nuestra madre, embelesados por maravillosos relatos de grandes hazañas y conquistas? En resumen, ¿es el amor por ese lugar, donde cada pulgada representa recuerdos queridos y preciosos de una infancia feliz, alegre y juguetona?

Si eso fuera patriotismo, pocos hombres estadounidenses de hoy en día podrían considerarse patriotas, ya que el lugar de juego se ha convertido en fábrica, molino y mina, mientras que los sonidos ensordecedores de la maquinaria han sustituido a la música de los pájaros. Tampoco podemos ya escuchar las historias de grandes hazañas, pues las que cuentan hoy nuestras madres no son más que historias de dolor, lágrimas y aflicción.

¿Qué es, entonces, el patriotismo? «El patriotismo, señor, es el último recurso de los sinvergüenzas», dijo el Dr. Johnson. León Tolstói, el mayor antipatriota de nuestro tiempo, define el patriotismo como el principio que justifica la formación de asesinos en masa; un oficio que requiere mejor equipamiento para el ejercicio del asesinato que para la fabricación de artículos de primera necesidad como zapatos, ropa y viviendas; un oficio que garantiza mejores beneficios y mayor gloria que el del trabajador medio.

Gustave Hervé [1], otro gran antipatriota, califica acertadamente el patriotismo de superstición —una mucho más perjudicial, brutal e inhumana que la religión—. La superstición de la religión tuvo su origen en la incapacidad del hombre para explicar los fenómenos naturales. Es decir, cuando el hombre primitivo oía un trueno o veía un relámpago, no podía dar una explicación a ninguno de ellos y, por lo tanto, concluía que detrás de ellos debía de haber una fuerza mayor que él mismo. Del mismo modo, veía una fuerza sobrenatural en la lluvia y en los diversos cambios que se producen en la naturaleza. El patriotismo, por el contrario, es una superstición creada artificialmente y mantenida a través de una red de mentiras y falsedades; una superstición que despoja al hombre de su autoestima y dignidad, y aumenta su arrogancia y vanidad.

De hecho, la vanidad, la arrogancia y el egoísmo son los elementos esenciales del patriotismo. Permítanme ilustrarlo. El patriotismo parte de la base de que nuestro planeta está dividido en pequeños rincones, cada uno rodeado por una verja de hierro. Quienes han tenido la suerte de nacer en un rincón concreto se consideran mejores, más nobles, más grandiosos y más inteligentes que los seres vivos que habitan en cualquier otro rincón. Por lo tanto, es deber de todo aquel que vive en ese rincón elegido luchar, matar y morir en el intento de imponer su superioridad sobre todos los demás.

I den ungsocialistiska pressen hade så tidigt som år 1907 agitation förts för syndikalismen. I majnumret år 1910 av den fackliga tidningen Bageriarbetaren gjorde bagarnas förtroendeman, Anders Sjöstedt, som var redaktör för nämnda tidning, ett försök att hindra syndikalismens spridning bland bagarna, vilka i stort antal gripits av den syndikalistiska agitationen. Då skrev undertecknad ett genmäle mot den mäktiga förbundschefens angrepp under rubriken: **.."Man säger... Genmäle på artikeln i majnumret."*

"Man säger, att bagarna skola vara med då det gäller att upplösa förbunden och bilda Lokala Samorganisationer", inledde vår förtroendeman Anders Sjöstedt, och tillade sedan: "Tack för erbjudandet, men skall man då behandla bagarna på samma sätt som man vill göra nu, tycker vi synd om bagarna." På detta sätt vill jag svara att aggressiva kommer arbetsgivarna alltid att vara oavsett vilken organisationsform arbetarna har, tills dess de får så kraftigt mothugg så de lugnar sina rovdjurskänslor. Och då behövs det sannerligen syndikalistiskt försvarskraft. Därför kan inte en förtroendeman, om än med stor vilja, uträtta något ensamt - utan en vaken, handlingsfull och slagkraftig organisation.

Lusten att krossa arbetarnas organisationer har icke saknats av de privata arbetsgivarna - ej ens från styrelser och föreståndare för kooperativa bagerier i södra Sverge. Närmare angivet Skåne. Där har till och med öppna strider utbrutit.

Alla arbetsgivare vill ha utgifterna så små som möjligt. Men inkomsterna så stora som möjligt. Detta får ju främst arbetarna, producenterna, lida för.

Vidare hade Sjöstedt skrivit: "Lyssna på styrelserna för 'Föreningsbagerierna' och och för en del kooperativa bagerier vilka diskutera om bagarna på ett utmanande sätt, när det gäller deras avtal."

För min del tyckte jag att bagarna icke skulle bry sig om vad dessa konservativa styrelsemedlemmar pladdrar om. Och är det någon underhandling de ej vill bry sig om och önskar de icke vara med om någon överenskommelse som vi vet att de kan gå med på, behöver vi icke kompromissa och springa och berusa dessa herrar i all evighet, och tigga om rätt till mänsklig existens. Vi ha förmåga att slå till! Vi äro de starka! Gör slut på fegheten! Det är vi som är producenter!

Därför behöva att omändra organisationerna till kampduglighet och smidig anpassningsförmåga efter de förhållanden som kan uppstå. Vad de Lokala Samorganisationerna angår så äro de mest praktiska, och kan med heder avlösa de gamla tungrodda byråkratiska fackföreningarna, som äro i majoritet i detta land.

Att inte organisationsfrågan är ett aktuellt spörsmål just nu, bland bagarna, är en lögn av stort mått. Den är aktuell och skall bliva det ännu mer när tiden är mogen. Trots vad Sjöstedt skriver! Och hans ångest som så tydligt märks!

Allt sedan de reformistiska organisationernas början har i regel "förts de korslagda armarnas strid", som de gamla ledana är så förtjusta i - till borgardömets fromma!

Detta har visat sig odugligt. Vi har ju bagerier, som är bojkottade ända sedan den tid som "Svenska Bageri- och Konditoriarbetareförbundet" startades. Och det var inte i går!

Vi har exempel på detta i Göteborg och i Uddevalla, ja lite varstans i detta land.

Det skulle taga allt för stort utrymme i anspråk att räkna upp alla. Och när uppgörelse kommer att träffas vet ingen! Och ingen gör något för att ändring skall ske. Ingen delar ut så mycket som en bojkottslapp för att upplysa allmänheten om förhållandet, att konflikt råder. Därför behövs det pigga organisationer i vilka medlemmarna äro socialistiskt skolade och nyktra. Då kan vi marschera framåt och vinna något, trots det att arbetsgivarna göra allt för att slå ned vår frammarsch. Detta få ingen glömma!

Man skriver så ofta och påstår att folk är så egoistiska, att de ej vill betala avgifterna till föreningarna …

author: 张皓翔
title: The Dislocation of Vendémiaire (II): The Illusion of National Economics and the Polarization of Political Economy【葡⽉的错位 （⼆）国⺠经济学的幻象与政治经济学的极化】【A commentary on the French riots between September and October】
content: This essay is the second part of The Dislocation of Vendémiaire, following Part I, “The Disruptors of the 21st Century and the Ideological Collusion.” While Part I interprets the 2026 France-centered student-led protest wave as a politically dislocated movement—one misread by mainstream discourse as a multi-class coalition when it is in fact an expression of fragmentation within the proletariat—Part II develops the theoretical argument behind that claim. Drawing on Marx’s thesis of society’s polarization into two hostile camps, it distinguishes between “property” and “proletarianization” in the sense of national economics and in the sense of political economy. The essay argues that class should be analyzed through the actual control over the production of labor-power, and that digital capitalism increasingly enables capital to dominate labor-power directly, beyond the mediation of formal ownership of physical means of production. On this basis, it explains why many who appear as middle-class or petty-producer subjects in national-economic terms—scholars, franchise shopkeepers, senior programmers, platform creators—are in political-economic terms being proletarianized, while carrying petty-bourgeois habits of political compromise, individualism, hostility to centralized discipline, and identity- or interest-based linkage. The result is a form of struggle that is radical in appearance but conservative and spontaneous in its core: it completes the first step of linkage through identity and affinity, but fails to return to the common ground of class interests and to connect with the broader industrial working class.

author: Unknown
title: Sara Blum - Martyr Culture
content:
Author

: Sara Blum

Title

: Martyr Culture

Subtitle

: Revolutionary Culture in Rojava

Date

: June 2025

Notes

: This essay was written by Sara Blum, and internationalist who spent several years with the YPJ in Rojava, to accompany and contextualize

Orso: Wartime Journals of an Anarchist

,

 published in July 2025.

Source

: retrieved on 10/27/2026 from https://www.tangledwilderness.org/features/martyr-culture


I remain committed, until the end, to the struggle for liberation

and to the beauty and love it creates.


Abdullah Öcalan


 Kurdish friends, upon meeting an internationalist, often ask about our decision to come to their homeland in Rojava, Kurdistan. When they’d ask how I first came into contact with the friends, I felt a bit embarrassed to say that, honestly, the first friends of the movement I met were those who helped me after I actually arrived in Mesopotamia. (Editor’s note: “The friends” is a colloquialism stemming from the literal translation of the word “heval” which has historically been used by members of the Kurdish liberation movement to refer to each other.) I told them I learned about the movement by reading articles on a few different anarchist websites and contacted the friends by email. In fact, I knew so little about the movement that I first emailed YPG (People’s Protection Units) instead of YPJ (Women’s Protection Units). The friends were often amazed at this, and in their generosity considered it some kind of bravery or indication of the depth of my belief in the revolution and the people, rather than of naivety or impulsivity. It’s a common story among internationalists from the so-called USA, because the Kurdish Freedom Movement doesn’t have a presence here like it does in many parts of Europe, where there is a bigger Kurdish diaspora. When I initially went, I planned to stay for six months or a year. I ended up staying for several years, and for most of that time I was with the autonomous women’s military defense forces, YPJ.


 I decided to go in late 2018, and at that time it was hard to find much information about what to expect. Not much has changed in that regard. My dad told me to bring extra socks, and that before going I must read Che Guevara’s

On Guerrilla Warfare

. Other than that, most of the practical information about what to bring I received from an internationalist fighter whom I reached through an online message board. He said to bring all sorts of supplies, sent a packing list, and told me to bring a bunch of US dollars. He emphasized that I should bring water for border crossing across the mountains, which he said would be long and difficult, but to not share my water because the Kurdish comrades would pass it down the line until there was none left, and then I wouldn’t have water. The YPJ friend I was corresponding with told me I didn’t need much, and if it came to be that I needed something when I got there or along the way, comrades would sort it out then. This seemed to me rather casual at the time. I felt frustrated at the vagueness.


 Packing and repacking my bag, researching the weather conditions, trying to prepare as much as possible for what could be the rest of my short little life, I wanted all the information I could find and there wasn’t much. I didn’t realize then that I was encountering the first contrast of revolutionary and capitalist culture: different modes of being. The internationalist from the message board, with his best intentions, showed me one way to go about struggle, while the YPJ comrade showed me another way of joining the revolution. Preparing myself as an individual by making sure I had all the right specific things on the one hand, and on the other, preparing myself to take on the same circumstances as whomever I end up with and to sort all my needs within the context of our collective needs. As an internationalist from the West, the tension between these tendencies has long lived in me. I find that it still does, but I have also found that being out of water together always seems to be better than having water while the person next to me doesn’t.


 Before I left, I tried many times to write letters to my family, close friends, and comrades, which I would leave in the hands of a trusted friend so that, in the event of my death, they could be sent. I was determined to leave loved ones with some words of strength—I didn’t want to die, but since it was a distinct possibility, it was important to ensure that my death …

author: Unknown
title: Рикардо Флорес Магон - Революция
content:
Автор

: Рикардо Флорес Магон

Название

: Революция

Дата

: 19 ноября 1910

Источник

: Regeneración


 Вот-вот упадёт вполне созревший плод внутреннего мятежа; плод горький для всех, кто возгордился положением, которое приносит почести, богатства и награды тем, кто основывает свои наслаждения на страдании и рабстве человечества; но плод сладкий и отрадный для всех, кто так или иначе ощутил на своём достоинстве копыта тех зверей, которые в одну ночь, длившуюся тридцать четыре года, крали, насиловали, убивали, обманывали, предавали, скрывая свои преступления под покровом закона и уклоняясь от кары под сенью официальной власти.


 Кто боится Революции? Те же самые, кто её вызвал; те, кто своим гнётом или своей эксплуатацией народных масс довёл до того, что отчаяние овладело жертвами их подлостей; те, кто несправедливостью и грабежом возмутил совесть и заставил бледнеть от негодования честных людей земли.


 Революция вот-вот разразится. Мы, столько лет следившие за всеми событиями общественной и политической жизни мексиканского народа, не можем обманываться. Симптомы грозного катаклизма не оставляют места сомнению в том, что нечто вот-вот возникнет и нечто вот-вот рухнет, что нечто воспрянет и нечто вот-вот падёт. Наконец, после тридцати четырёх лет позора, поднимет голову мексиканский народ, и наконец, после этой долгой ночи, обратится в развалины чёрное здание, чья тяжесть нас душила.


 Сейчас уместно снова сказать то, что мы говорили так часто: нужно сделать так, чтобы это движение, вызванное отчаянием, не стало слепым движением того, кто делает усилие, чтобы сбросить с себя вес огромной ноши, – движением, в котором инстинкт почти полностью господствует над разумом. Мы, либертарии, должны позаботиться о том, чтобы это движение приняло направление, которое указывает Наука. Если этого не сделать, поднимающаяся Революция послужит лишь тому, чтобы заменить одного Президента другим Президентом, или, что то же самое, одного хозяина другим хозяином. Мы должны помнить, что нужно, чтобы у народа был хлеб, было жильё, была земля для обработки; мы должны помнить, что никакое Правительство, сколь бы честным оно ни было, не может декретировать отмену нищеты. Именно сам народ, именно голодные, именно обездоленные должны отменить нищету, в первую очередь вступив во владение землёй, которая по естественному праву не может быть прибрана к рукам несколькими, но является собственностью всякого человеческого существа. Невозможно предсказать, до какого предела дойдёт дело восстановления прав в грядущей Революции; но если мы, борцы доброй воли, несём намерение продвинуться по этому пути как можно дальше; если, берясь за винчестер, мы идём решительно не к возвышению очередного хозяина, но к восстановлению прав пролетариата; если мы несём на поле вооружённой борьбы стремление завоевать экономическую свободу, которая есть основа всех свобод, которая есть условие, без которого нет никакой свободы; если мы несём это намерение, мы направим грядущее народное движение по пути, достойному этой эпохи; но если из желания легко победить; если из стремления поскорее закончить борьбу мы уберём из наших устремлений тот радикализм, который делает их несовместимыми с устремлениями чисто буржуазных и консервативных партий, тогда мы совершим дело разбойников и убийц, ибо пролитая кровь послужит лишь тому, чтобы придать больше силы буржуазии, то есть касте, владеющей богатством, которая после победы снова наденет цепь на пролетариат, чьей кровью, чьей жертвой, чьим мученичеством она завоевала власть.


 Итак, необходимо, пролетарии; необходимо, обездоленные, чтобы вы не обманывались. Консервативные и буржуазные партии говорят вам о свободе, о справедливости, о законе, о честном правительстве и говорят вам, что, если народ сменит людей, стоящих у Власти, на других, у вас будет свобода, будет справедливость, будет закон, будет честное правительство. Не давайте себя обмануть. Вам нужно, чтобы вам обеспечили довольство ваших семей и хлеб насущный; довольство семей не сможет дать вам никакое Правительство. author: 张皓翔
title: The Dislocation of Vendémiaire (Part I): The 21st-Century Breakthrough Actors and Ideological Collusion【A commentary on the French riots between September and October】
content: This article takes the French student-led protests and unrest between September and October 2026 as its point of departure. It rejects the mainstream interpretation of the movement as a broad multi-class alliance of diverse demands, and instead argues that it reflects a deep internal differentiation and fragmentation of the proletariat under digital capitalism. While affirming the student group’s role as a “quasi-proletariat” and an early outpost of struggle, the article contends that the movement remained at a pre-Marxist spontaneous stage because it lacked a scientific program and the integration of an advanced party. It proposes “actual control over the production of labor power” as the core criterion for class analysis and describes the movement as a “dislocated” struggle shaped by an ideological collusion between bourgeois narratives and the movement’s own political weaknesses.

content:
Title

: Democratic Socialists of America & Libertarian Socialism

Subtitle

Date

Notes

ideas & action

 on whether or not anarcho-syndicalists and libertarian socialists should participate in the Democratic Socialists of America (DSA).

Source

ideas & action

 Retrieved on 10-27-2026 from

libcom.org/article/democratic-socialists-america-libertarian-socialism


Editors’ Note/Introduction:

Bureaucratic Utopianism?

,

by Tom Wetzel


The last few years have been a discouraging period for those in the U. S. who want fundamental change in the direction of freedom and equality. Though struggle against the powers-that-be goes on, as always, struggles in the last few years have tended to be episodic and isolated. It’s hard to find signs of a widespread willingness to fight the bosses and the government. This lack of movement among the mainstream of the population is, in all likelihood, the root cause of the general political drift to the right and, as well, the evolution towards social-democracy among so many leftists whose radicalism had been spawned by the movements of the late 60s and early

 ’70s.

One evidence of this latter trend was the evolution of the New American Movement (NAM) away from the revolutionary New Left politics of its origin, culminating in its merger last year with Michael Harrington’s Democratic Socialist Organizing Committee

 (

DSOC) — a tiny social-democratic sect that had emerged from the break-up of the old Socialist Party in 1972. That split-up had been itself a reflection of the Vietnam War, since the Socialist Party of the 1960s had been firmly in the hands of the “State Department socialists” who thought the Communists were such a threat that it merited allying themselves with U.S. bosses, by supporting the U.S. government’s imperialist foreign policy. This fit in with the practice of cooperation with the bosses which characterized the union chiefs who controlled the Socialist Party in those days. The split in the SP created three groups

 —

the majority formed the Social Democrats USA, made up of such class-collaborationist union leaders as Lloyd McBride of the United Steelworkers and Albert Shanker of the American Federation of Teachers. They had no compunction about supporting U.S. imperialism in Indo-China (and anywhere else) right to the bitter end. In 1981, for example, Shanker’s AFT ran a major spread in the “American Teacher” supporting U.S. policy in El Salvador as a struggle for “democracy” (even while members of the Salvadoran teachers union were being tortured or hunted down by forces of the local dictatorship). Another outfit that came out of the break-up of the old SP was the group headed by ex-Milwaukee mayor Frank Zeidler which resurrected the name “Socialist Party “ for itself. This group opposed the Vietnam war but more on the basis of liberal pacifist than class-struggle grounds. And finally, the third fragment from the old SP was Harrington’s liberal group who had no consistently anti-militarist or anti-imperialist position (for example, they have supported U.S. military aid to Israel until just recently) but who simply followed the evolution of the liberal mainstream in its belated opposition to the Vietnam War. Democratic Socialists of America (DSA) is the organization which resulted from the absorption of NAM by Harrington’s DSOC. Chris Nielsen, whose piece on “DSA and Libertarian Socialists” we are printing here, recommends the “democratic socialist” milieu — and specifically DSA — as an appropriate area for participation by anti-authoritarian socialists or anarchists. Though we disagree with Chris’ conclusion, we think he raises a number of issues worth discussing. Social democratic ideas are on the rise, and the sort of position Chris argues for is one that needs to be answered by libertarian socialists.


What is “social-democracy’’? Social-democracy is not unique in pursuing or supporting short-range changes to benefit working people — the revolutionary libertarian unions of the early decades of this century, such as the IWW in this country, used militant tactics for goals short of class emancipation. Social-democratic politics is typified by a reliance on electoral politics with the union bureaucracy providing the major base of support. Social-democratic tactics have traditionally led to a statist conception of what socialism is all about — …

Мак-Кинли, глава североамериканской олигархии, орудие и защитник крупных капиталистов, предатель кубинцев и филиппинцев, человек, санкционировавший расправу над бастующими в Хэзлтоне, пытки шахтёров Айдахо и тысячу гнусностей, ежедневно совершаемых против рабочих в «образцовой республике», тот, кто воплощал милитаристскую, завоевательную, империалистическую политику, в которую ринулась американская буржуазия, пал жертвой револьвера анархиста.

О чём вы хотите, чтобы мы скорбели, если не о судьбе, уготованной великодушному человеку, который – уместно или неуместно, с хорошей или плохой тактикой – принёс себя в жертву делу равенства и свободы?

Повторим это и в данном случае, как и во всех аналогичных: поскольку мы находимся в обществе волков, где насилие окружает нас и разит со всех сторон, мы, продолжая спокойно бороться за то, чтобы прекратилась эта ужасная необходимость отвечать на насилие насилием, – хотя и желая, чтобы скорее наступил день, когда антагонизмы интересов и страстей между людьми можно будет разрешать человеческими и цивилизованными средствами, – бережём свои слёзы и свои цветы для других жертв, а не для этих людей, которые, становясь во главе эксплуататорских и угнетательских классов, берут на себя ответственность и идут на риск, связанный с их положением.

И всё же нашлись анархисты, которые сочли полезным и прекрасным оскорблять угнетённого, который восстаёт, не имея ни слова осуждения для угнетателя, понёсшего кару за преступления, которые он совершил или позволил совершить!

Это извращение, это нездоровое желание получить одобрение противников, или же неосмотрительная ловкость, которая хотела бы завоевать свободу пропаганды своих идей, добровольно отказываясь от права выражать истинное и глубокое чувство души, – более того, искажая это чувство, притворяясь не тем, что есть?

Я делаю это с сожалением, но не могу не выразить боль и возмущение, которые вызвали во мне и во всех товарищах, каких мне довелось видеть в эти дни, необдуманные слова, посвящённые Agitazione покушению в Буффало.

Чолгош – несознательный человек! Но знают ли они его? Его поступок – обычное преступление, не имеющее ни одного из признаков, необходимых для того, чтобы подобный акт мог считаться политическим!

Полагаю, что ни один государственный обвинитель – королевский или республиканский – не осмелился бы утверждать нечто подобное. В самом деле, есть ли хоть какой-нибудь повод судить о Чолгоше как о человеке, движимом личными интересами или личной злобой? Разве не ясно, что он действовал по мотивам общественного порядка и намеревался – с основанием или без основания, но, несомненно, искренне и самоотверженно – принести себя в жертву ради дела? И разве не эти элементы придают факту наиболее яркий характер политико-социального покушения?

Впрочем, неправильно говорить о преступлении в подобных случаях. Кодекс это делает, но кодекс создан против нас, против угнетённых, и не может служить критерием для наших суждений.

Эти факты – акты войны; и если война есть преступление, то она преступление для тех, кто в ней стоит на стороне несправедливости и угнетения. Преступниками могут быть, являются английские захватчики Трансвааля; ими не являются буры, когда защищают свою свободу, даже если защита была бы безнадёжной.

Поступок Чолгоша (могла бы ответить Agitazione) нисколько не продвинул дело пролетариата и революции: Вместо Мак-Кинли придет Рузвельт, такой же, как и он, и всё останется как прежде, разве что положение анархистов станет немного труднее. И, возможно, Agitazione была бы права; более того, в американской среде, насколько я её знаю, мне это кажется вероятным.

Это значит, что на войне есть ходы удачные и ошибочные, есть бойцы осмотрительные и есть те, кто …

author: Chris Walker
title: Republicans’ Final Pitch to Midterm Voters: Outright Christian Nationalism
content:
Republicans are invoking Christianity to mobilize voters and attack the legitimacy of Muslim candidates.

Speaker of the House Mike Johnson (R-Louisiana) and other Republicans are including Christian nationalist themes in their messaging and campaign rhetoric in the final days before the midterm elections.

This past weekend, Johnson appeared on “The Week on Capitol Hill,” a right-wing Christian program hosted by Tony Perkins. Perkins asked Johnson what advice he’d give to conservatives “who are considering sitting this election out.”

Johnson responded by chiding such individuals, saying they’d be “derelict in [their] duty” if they didn’t participate in the elections.

“God calls us to be engaged, to be salt and light in our culture, to advance and stand for his principles, and they are under assault right now,” he claimed.

Johnson then said that conservatives should only vote for candidates that share his and other far right leaders’ Christian nationalist vision.

“We have to be engaged in that process to make sure that the righteous are ruling. … To put it bluntly, you cannot allow these radical elements to take over your country,” Johnson said.

Christian nationalism is a white supremacist political ideology that asserts that the country should only be run by lawmakers who champion right-wing “Christian values.” Adherents of the idea wrongly claim that the U.S. was founded as a Christian nation, and that it was God’s intention to have Christians govern.

Johnson has frequently cited his Christian nationalist beliefs to justify his support of the U.S.’s war on Iran, claiming it is in part a fight against Islam, which he described as a “misguided religion” earlier this year.

Johnson’s backing of Christian nationalist principles has been well-documented. According to a 2024 report from the Congressional Freethought Caucus, Johnson has spent much of his career “working to deny, reject, and undermine the constitutional separation of church and state, including trafficking in fake histories about our nation’s founding.” He also worked alongside groups aligned with the New Apostolic Reformation movement, which aims for Christians to “conquer” and “take dominion” over “key mountains of society,” such as business realms, local and national governments, and more.

Other Republicans have targeted non-Christian Democratic candidates by claiming their beliefs are inherently un-American, another tenet of Christian nationalism. During a political rally this week in Ohio, Sen. Bernie Moreno (R) told his audience that Michigan Senate candidate Abdul El-Sayed (D) should be disqualified from running due to his Muslim faith.

“This character, Abdul El-Sayed, can be nowhere near Washington, D.C.,” Moreno said. “Do you think he understands that concept, that our rights come from God Almighty? That Jesus came here for our salvation?”

Notably, Moreno made the remark at a rally in support of Republican candidate for Ohio governor Vivek Ramaswamy, who is a practicing Hindu.

Moreno’s statements contradict the country’s founding documents. According to Article VI of the U.S. Constitution, “no religious test shall ever be required as a qualification to any office or public trust under the United States.” The Declaration of Independence does make mention of “Nature’s God” entitling freedom and equality to the people, but that phrase is largely understood by scholars to be a term deists, like the document’s author Thomas Jefferson, used at the time to refer to whatever force created the universe, not necessarily a specific deity.

title: Karayılan commemorates fallen guerrillas from Shengal
content:
Murat Karayılan, a member of the Central Headquarters of the People’s Defense Forces (HPG), has issued a statement commemorating seven fallen Kurdish guerrilla fighters from Shengal. He paid tribute to their contribution to defending the Yazidi population against the terrorist organization Islamic State (ISIS) and to establishing independent self-defense structures in Shengal. Karayılan also commented on the talks between the Iraqi government and the leadership of the Shengal Resistance Units (YBŞ). He welcomed the prospect of integrating the YBŞ into the Iraqi army, provided that the units retain their local character and remain permanently responsible for protecting the population.


In his statement, Karayılan recalled the genocide perpetrated by ISIS against the Yazidis in August 2014, which the Yazidi community refers to as the 74th Ferman, as well as the role of the Kurdish guerrillas in defending Shengal. He regards the YBŞ and YJŞ forces established during that period as a crucial achievement in the struggle to prevent another genocide.

The full statement reads as follows:


“With our greetings and respect to our people in Shengal!


Seven of the fallen fighters whose deaths we are announcing and whom we wish to commemorate came from Shengal. In honor of them all, we remember our comrades Agir Botan and Çiçek Öcalan with respect and gratitude, and bow before their memory. We renew our pledge to our fallen comrades to remain faithful to the path of our common cause until the very end.


On behalf of the leadership of the Kurdish movement and the HPG Central Headquarters, I extend my condolences to the families of our martyrs and to the entire population of Shengal, particularly the Yazidi and Arab peoples. I hope that our people will duly recognize the significance of these martyrs. We firmly believe that they will follow in their footsteps, preserve their memory, and give them a dignified welcome.


“The 74th campaign of extermination did not go unpunished”


Dear Families!


Our Yazidi people have been subjected to 74 fermans throughout their history. Each of these campaigns of extermination involved massacres and genocide. Yet not a single one was ever brought to justice. Whoever committed these crimes went unpunished.


However, we know that the 74th campaign of extermination did not go unpunished, thanks to the ideas and philosophy of Rêber Apo [Leader Abdullah Öcalan] and the awareness he instilled in us. Once again, massacres took place. More than 12,000 of our people were killed or taken captive. ISIS had a far-reaching objective: it sought to completely eradicate the Yazidi faith. But the guerrillas of the Kurdish freedom movement, acting in accordance with Rêber Apo’s vision, could not stand by and watch. As soon as they learned of the attacks, they decided to intervene and immediately mobilized.


As is well known, attempts were made to prevent this intervention. But that was not all. At the time, no one was able to stand up to ISIS. Even states fled in the face of its advance. The intervention and resistance in Shengal gave courage to many other forces. ISIS continued its attacks because it could not tolerate being met with resistance. However, it had no experience in mountain warfare and was unable to prevail against our guerrillas. It failed to occupy the mountains.


By contrast, ISIS had experience in urban warfare. It therefore considered Kobanê our weakest point and attacked the city in an attempt to take revenge. Our movement responded to both the attacks on Shengal and those on Kobanê. Even at that time, it was declared that these crimes would have far-reaching consequences—not only in Shengal and Kobanê, but everywhere.


The crimes committed against Kurdish and Yazidi women and the victims of the campaign of extermination did not go unpunished. ISIS’s system of rule was dismantled. The fighters of the Apoist movement pursued ISIS all the way to Baghuz and brought an end to its system of rule.

title: Pisa: IL 30 OTTOBRE SCIOPERO GENERALE – Insieme possiamo bloccare tutto
content:
Lo sciopero generale del 30 ottobre, proclamato da USB e sostenuto da tanti sindacati di base, è l’occasione per reagire a una crisi che pesa ogni giorno sulle nostre vite.


Di seguito ripubblichiamo l’indizione di

MULTI – Sindacato Sociale

 che aderisce allo sciopero e sarà

 

nei luoghi di lavoro, di studio e nei quartieri per costruire questa

 

giornata.

 In allegato l’adesione allo sciopero da parte dei lavoratori di Amazon.


Non possiamo andare avanti così: lavorare costa sempre di più, gli stipendi non bastano e gli affitti sono impossibili. Imprese e istituzioni scaricano i costi della crisi su chi lavora, attraverso part-time involontari, ore non pagate e contratti precari. Gli ospedali non garantiscono cure adeguate, scuole e servizi si impoveriscono, mentre aumentano le risorse destinate al riarmo.


Scioperare è un sacrificio, soprattutto per chi ha già pochi soldi. Ma dobbiamo

 

ribellarci a una normalità che ci impoverisce e ci toglie autonomia e

 

futuro. Fermarci insieme significa trasformare la fatica e la rabbia individuali in

 una forza capace di cambiare i rapporti di potere.


In tutta Europa crescono le proteste. Autotrasportatori e agricoltori si mobilitano contro l’aumento dei costi e l’indebitamento; giovani delle periferie e studenti occupano scuole e piazze, stanchi di essere criminalizzati e privati di 

opportunità. Conflitti diversi, una domanda comune: perché dobbiamo

 

essere sempre noi a pagare?


Dalla Palestina all’Ucraina, le guerre devastano popolazioni e territori mentre si spendono soldi pubblici per produrre e acquistare armi. Banche, industrie militari, imprese energetiche, grandi supermercati, case farmaceutiche, multinazionali della logistica e fondi immobiliari continuano ad accumulare 

profitti. Noi, invece, veniamo derubati della ricchezza che produciamo:

 

con salari insufficienti, affitti insostenibili, prezzi sempre più alti e

 

servizi pubblici impoveriti. Il nostro lavoro fa ricco lo Stato e le grandi

 

aziende, ma a noi restano sacrifici e rinunce. Ora basta.


Da Amazon a Carrefour, da Dussmann agli appalti pubblici, fino alla Scuola Superiore Sant’Anna, alla Scuola Normale e alle scuole, dobbiamo far sentire la voce di chi manda avanti la società con il proprio lavoro e la propria cura. Vogliamo salari più alti, contratti stabili, la fine del lavoro gratuito e del part-

time imposto, case accessibili e servizi pubblici funzionanti. Le risorse

 

collettive devono servire la vita, non la guerra e i profitti di pochi.


Per questo dobbiamo portare lo sciopero ovunque, collegare le vertenze e fermare i flussi di lavoro e di ricchezza che noi stessi produciamo. Non basta indignarsi: 

dobbiamo organizzarci e ribellarci insieme per conquistare

 

ciò che ci viene negato.


Il 30 ottobre, dalla mattina presto, saremo con 

picchetti nei luoghi di

 

lavoro, di studio e nei quartieri per promuovere lo sciopero

. Dalle ore 9 ci muoveremo in corteo verso il Comune di Pisa.


Per aderire, segnalare la partecipazione o costruire iniziative, contattate MULTI – Sindacato Sociale:

info@multisindacatosociale.org


30-ottobre_261027_152501

Download


Dal magazzino Amazon di Montacchiello (PISA) : per lo sciopero di domani 30 ottobre assemblea sindacale e presidio alle 8.30!

Carichi di lavoro inaccettabili, pressioni psicologiche e fisiche, sfruttamento fino alla malattia e alla distruzione

É IL MOMENTO DI FARCI SENTIRE!

Basta essere trattati come lavoratori usa e getta! Basta avere paura, insieme lottiamo contro lo sfruttamento! Le lavoratrici e i lavoratori vogliono rispetto!


Insieme siamo forti!

title: Torino verso lo sciopero generale
content:
Riprendiamo indizione della mobilitazione da parte dei coordinamenti cittadini di

Torino per Gaza

 e

Torino contro il riarmo

 in vista della mobilitazione dello sciopero del 30 ottobre. In allegato anche un registrato delle voci del 24 ottobre a cura di

Radio Blackout

.


BLOCCHIAMO L’ITALIA SCIOPERO GENERALE

Domani scendiamo in piazza ancora una volta per ribadire che siamo contro il riarmo, contro il carovita e contro ogni forma di guerra.

Sono settimane che vediamo l’Italia intera scendere in piazza per dire che non ce la fa più, che arrivare alla fine del mese è diventato un lusso sempre più riservato a pochi, che non è più possibile accettare un presente fatto di precarietà e impoverimento. Di fronte a tutto questo, le risposte del governo italiano sono sempre più orientate alla repressione. Attraverso abusi di polizia e limitazioni al diritto di manifestare, si tenta di restringere sempre di più gli spazi del dissenso, obbligando le persone a lasciare il centro delle città e relegando le proteste nelle periferie, lontano dagli occhi di chi governa e di chi vorrebbe continuare a fare finta di niente. Ci chiediamo allora: queste fantomatiche vetrine valgono forse più della vita di milioni di persone che non riescono ad arrivare alla fine del mese? Vale più la tutela delle vetrine del diritto di esprimere il proprio dissenso, di protestare contro le guerre e di rivendicare condizioni di vita dignitose?

Ancora una volta, la domanda non dovrebbe essere perché le persone scendano in piazza, perché giovani e studenti si mobilitino collettivamente, perché un’intera generazione rifiuti di accettare le condizioni che le vengono imposte. La vera domanda è perché, di fronte a queste rivendicazioni, la risposta delle istituzioni continui a tradursi nella violenza e nella repressione.

Scendere in piazza è quindi sempre di più una necessità, un dovere collettivo. Perché non possiamo accettare che la guerra diventi normalità mentre le nostre condizioni di vita peggiorano, che miliardi vengano destinati al riarmo mentre milioni di persone sono costrette a scegliere tra pagare le bollette, fare la spesa e arrivare alla fine del mese. Vediamo un vento di rivolta e rivoluzione arrivare dal mondo intero, da paesi molto vicini al nostro; Francia, Spagna, Albania, paesi nei quali le settimane di mobilitazione hanno messo in crisi i propri governi. Un solo grido ci attraversa tutti: No alla guerra e sì per una vita dignitosa.

Come Coordinamento Torino per Gaza, sappiamo bene, guardando alla resistenza palestinese, cosa significhi lottare, cosa significhi resistere e cosa significhi non arrendersi di fronte alla violenza. Sappiamo che le lotte non sono separate, che ciò che accade in Palestina non è distante da ciò che viviamo qui. La guerra e il genocidio in Palestina si inseriscono in un sistema di dominio e di violenza che si alimenta anche attraverso il riarmo, l’economia di guerra e politiche che scaricano il costo delle proprie scelte sulle vite di chi lavora, studia e vive in condizioni di crescente precarietà.

Con la stessa forza e determinazione che abbiamo mostrato lo scorso anno con Blocchiamo tutto, vogliamo tornare a bloccare. Bloccare questo sistema, fermare la macchina della guerra, opporci a un modello politico ed economico che ci vuole sempre più sfruttati, sempre più impoveriti, sempre più disposti a chinare la testa.

Vogliamo bloccare l’Italia per l’Italia stessa, per la nostra liberazione, per costruire un futuro in cui le risorse siano destinate alla vita e non alla guerra, ai diritti e non al riarmo, alla dignità delle persone e non ai profitti di pochi.

Domani scendiamo in piazza per scioperare, per bloccare, per opporci alla repressione e per mettere un punto a tutto questo.

Contro il riarmo. Contro il carovita. Contro ogni guerra. Per la Palestina, per la nostra liberazione.


Alcune voci dal corteo del 24 ottobre a Torino contro guerra, riarmo e carovita.

title: Broad support for resistance against solar project in Arzoxlî
content:
Resistance against the controversial Zenkar-2 solar energy project in the Arzoxlî village of Amed (Turkish: Diyarbakır), is gaining further support. On the eighth day of the vigil against the development of communal grazing lands, a delegation from the Democratic Institutions Platform visited the protest camp in the village. Following a joint march from the village square to the vigil tent, representatives of political parties and environmental organizations called for the complete cancellation of the project.


Ruçem Vefa Elyakut, co-chair of the DBP’s provincial branch in Amed, praised the local community’s struggle. “The people of Arzoxlî have been putting up dignified resistance for days,” she said. She placed the conflict within a long history of displacement and economic exploitation of Kurdish lands. “The mentality that sought to dominate this land has tried to drive its people away. Today, it wants to plunder this land using the same methods. We will never accept that.”


Construction work resumes despite ongoing court proceedings


At the center of the dispute is the “ZENKAR-2 Solar Power Plant and Energy Storage Facility” project developed by the company Zenkar. The company was granted a 49-year electricity generation license for two planned solar power plants equipped with energy storage systems. The facilities are to be built on land that is essential to the local population’s agricultural and livestock activities. Legal proceedings are ongoing against the reclassification of communal grazing lands, the zoning plans, and the favorable environmental impact assessment decision for Zenkar-2. A court-appointed panel of experts concluded that implementing the project in its current form would be unsuitable.


Violent clashes had erupted in March when the company first attempted to enter the site. Five villagers were injured, one of them seriously, during an operation by Turkish police and gendarmerie forces. Fifteen people were temporarily detained. On October 21, the company once again entered the disputed land under the escort of security forces. Since then, residents have been holding a vigil to protest the continuation of construction work and restrictions on their access to communal grazing lands.


“Thousands of years of natural habitats are being sacrificed for profit”


During the solidarity visit, Sabri Kılıç, co-spokesperson of the Amed Ecology Council, criticized the increasing commercialization of natural resources essential to sustaining life. He argued that solar and hydroelectric power plants, mining projects, and oil extraction were part of a broader development trend that increasingly disregarded the needs of local communities. “Land, water, mineral resources, sunlight, and wind are being turned into commodities in the process of capital accumulation,” Kılıç explained. “Mining, oil, hydroelectric, and solar energy projects in our valleys, mountains, and plains are destroying our habitats, which have existed for thousands of years, through policies aimed at maximizing profits.”


Kılıç particularly criticized the role played by the police and military. During the assault in March, he said, they had been deployed not to protect the population but to enforce the company’s interests. “The security forces, whose duty is to protect the people, attacked them as though they were the company’s private security personnel.”


Kılıç pointed out that the planned solar park threatens the agricultural use of the land and, with it, a vital source of livelihood for the village community. He warned of the potential displacement of residents and long-term ecological damage. He also emphasized the historical significance of the area, arguing that it should be officially recognized as a protected cultural heritage site.


Resistance to be expanded


Ruçem Vefa Elyakut stressed that preserving the grazing lands is inseparable from the population’s right to live in their homeland and have a say in its future. “This is our land, our life. We inherited it from our ancestors. We will never allow profiteers and those in power to plunder this land and this heritage,” the DBP politician declared. He vowed that the resistance would continue until the project was stopped.

title: Environmentalists demand projects in Zîlan Valley to be halted immediately’
content:
The Van Ecology Association, the Mesopotamia Ecology Movement, the Van Bar Association, and the DEM Party’s Erciş (Erdîş) district organisation issued a joint press statement opposing work being carried out on the Zîlan Stream under the pretext of an irrigation canal project.


Reading the statement, Rojhat Özgökçe, a representative of the Mesopotamia Ecology Movement, said the works threatened agricultural land, water resources, and biodiversity.


Özgökçe said that disrupting the natural flow of the Zîlan Stream could have irreversible consequences for the Erciş Plain, the Çelebibağ Wetlands, and the habitats of endemic species.


Stating that environmental impact assessment procedures had not been carried out adequately, Özgökçe said: “This ecological siege, stretching from Zilan Valley to the plain and the lake, threatens the living environments not only of today’s generations but also of future generations. Under Article 56 of the Constitution, which guarantees the right to live in a healthy and balanced environment, as well as under relevant international conventions and environmental legislation, we demand that all these projects be halted immediately, that their permits be revoked, and that the existing damage be remedied.”


Gülderen Varlı, a DEM Party MP representing Wan, also stated that the activities in the valley were affecting not only nature but also the region’s collective social memory.


Varlı said: “The valley is home to wildlife such as otters, salamander species, and the Erciş barbel. Blocking the flow of water affects not only aquatic life but also the entire interconnected ecological system. We will not accept this, and we will continue to monitor and challenge the destruction. Our struggle will continue until you take your machinery, your dirty mentality, and your mentality of war away from here.”

title: Criminal complaint filed against tree felling in Gabar and Besta
content:
In a statement issued by the bar associations’ Environment and Urban Affairs Commissions, it was reported that applications had been submitted to the chief public prosecutor’s offices in Siirt (Sêrt) and Şirnak (Şirnex) over tree felling said to have taken place between 20 April and 29 July 2025, and to have continued thereafter.


The complaint called for investigations to be opened and criminal proceedings to be brought against the relevant public officials and those carrying out the felling, over allegations of unlawful tree cutting, the transportation of illegally obtained forest products, and aiding these activities. It also requested on-site inspections of the felling and storage areas to identify and document evidence.


The bar associations called on the authorities to disclose the administrative permits authorising the felling, environmental impact assessment (EIA) decisions, information on the quantities and species of trees cut down, transport documents, and environmental inspection reports. They also urged the authorities to halt the activities.


The statement emphasised that the bar associations would continue to defend forests, wildlife, and citizens’ right to live in a healthy environment.

title: Εκδηλώσεις – συγκεντρώσεις για τα 82 χρόνια από την απελευθέρωση της Θεσσαλονίκης από τους Ναζί, Παρασκευή 30/10
content:
>Εκδήλωση μνήμης και τιμής για την επέτειο απελευθέρωσης της Θεσσαλονίκης από τους Ναζί, στις 17:00 στη μαρμάρινη στήλη για τους απελευθερωτές της πόλης – μαχητές του ΕΛΑΣ, στο πάρκο μεταξύ  Λ. Πύργου και Βασιλικού Θεάτρου, επί της «Λεωφόρου 30ης Οκτωβρίου 1944. 


>Συγκέντρωση για την απελευθέρωση από τον ΕΛΑΣ της πόλης από τη ναζιστική κατοχή, στις 19:00 στην πλατεία Αγ. Σοφίας.


ΕΤΑΙΡΕΙΑ ΔΙΑΣΩΣΗΣ ΙΣΤΟΡΙΚΩΝ ΑΡΧΕΙΩΝ (Ε.Δ.Ι.Α.) ΜΑΚΕΔΟΝΙΑΣ 1940-1974

30-10-1944

, οργανώνει, όπως κάθε χρόνο, η

Ε.Δ.Ι.Α.


Μακεδονίας 1940-1974


την

Παρασκευή 30 0κτωβρίου 2026

,

στις 5.00΄μ.μ.,

 μπροστά στη μαρμάρινη στήλη που  έχει αφιερώσει ο Δήμος Θεσσαλονίκης στους απελευθερωτές της πόλης – μαχητές του

ΕΛΑΣ

, στο πάρκο μεταξύ  Λ. Πύργου και Βασιλικού Θεάτρου, επί της «

Λεωφόρου 30ης Οκτωβρίου 1944».


Η

30

η

 Οκτωβρίου 1944

 είναι μία πολύ σημαντική επέτειος για την πόλη μας, καθώς τη μέρα εκείνη οι αντάρτες της

Ομάδας Μεραρχιών Μακεδονίας του ΕΛΑΣ

 με την είσοδό τους στην Θεσσαλονίκη, μετά από σκληρές μάχες στον περίγυρό της κατά των Γερμανών και με την επέμβασή τους απέτρεψαν την ανατίναξη των βασικών υποδομών της πόλης που είχαν υπονομεύσει με εκρηκτικά οι κατακτητές- όπως τα δύο εργοστάσια ηλεκτρισμού, το υδραγωγείο, ο σιδηροδρομικός σταθμός, ο λιμενοβραχιόνας, οι αλευρόμυλοι «Αλατίνι», κ.ά.


Η επέτειος έχει επανενταχθεί στο

δημοτικό εορτολόγιο

 με απόφαση του

Δ.Σ.Θ.

 στις

3 Νοεμβρίου 2014,

ενώ με το

ΠΔ 50 / ΦΕΚ 81/Α/9-5-2016,

καθιερώθηκε ως ‘

δημόσια εορτή τοπικής σημασίας για τον Δήμο Θεσσαλονίκης’.


Συγκέντρωση: Επέτειος της Απελευθέρωσης της Θεσσαλονίκης από τον ΕΛΑΣ


 Στις 30 Οκτώβρη του 1944, ο ΕΛΑΣ μπαίνει στη Θεσσαλονίκη και η πόλη απελευθερώνεται από τη ναζιστική κατοχή.


Ήταν η κατάληξη ενός σκληρού αγώνα, στον οποίο πρωταγωνίστησε ο ίδιος ο λαός, με το ΕΑΜ και τον ΕΛΑΣ να αποτελούν βασικούς πυλώνες της Εθνικής Αντίστασης. Οι αντάρτες με την ένοπλη δράση τους, οι εργάτες με τις αιματοβαμμένες απεργίες, η νεολαία από τα ξυπόλυτα τάγματα μέχρι τους σπουδαστικους λόχους της ΕΠΟΝ, οι δομές λαϊκής αλληλεγγύης που εσωσαν τον κόσμο από την πείνα, απέδειξαν πως κανένας αντίπαλος δεν είναι ανίκητος όταν βρίσκεται απέναντί του ο οργανωμένος λαός.


 Η απελευθέρωση όμως της πόλης, όπως και του μεγαλύτερου μέρους της χώρας, από τις δυνάμεις του ΕΛΑΣ δεν σήμανε και την δικαίωση όσων και για όσα αγωνίστηκαν. Οι συνεργάτες των ναζί και οι μηχανισμοί της κατοχικής εξουσίας δεν έφυγαν μαζί με τα γερμανικά στρατεύματα. Αντίθετα σημαντικό μέρος τους μαζί με το πολιτικό προσωπικό που είχε εγκαταλείψει την χώρα, συγκρότησαν το μεταπολεμικό αστικό κράτος. Ενώ από την άλλη αυτοί και αυτές που πολέμησαν και ελευθέρωσαν την χώρα ήρθαν αντιμέτωποι με διώξεις, φυλακίσεις, εξορίες και εκτελέσεις. Η πορεία προς τα Δεκεμβριανά και τον Εμφύλιο φανέρωσε πως ο αγώνας για μια ελεύθερη Ελλάδα χωρίς φτώχεια, φασισμό και με τον λαό κυρίαρχο, δεν μπορούσε να αφορά μόνο την σύγκρουση και απελευθέρωση από τον κατακτητή, αλλά και το ποιος θα καθόριζε την επόμενη μέρα.


 Δεν είναι λοιπόν τυχαίο ότι η επέτειος της 30ής Οκτώβρη παραμένει σχετικά άγνωστη, σε αντίθεση με άλλες επετείους που τιμώνται κάθε χρόνο στην πόλη. Η υποβάθμιση της απελευθέρωσης και η αποσιώπηση του ρόλου της Εθνικής Αντίστασης και τον πρωτοπόρο ρόλο των κομμουνιστών σε αυτή, εξυπηρετούν μια ιστορική αφήγηση που θέλει να εξισώσει τα θύματα με τους θύτες και τους προδοτες με τους αντιστασιακούς. Αφηγησεις που δεν μπορούν να δεχτούν τον λαό ως πρωταγωνιστη και όχι απλό θεατή των εξελίξεων.


 Σήμερα 82 χρόνια μετά, η μάχη για την ιστορική μνήμη συναντά τις μάχες του σήμερα. Τον αγώνα ενάντια στον σημερινό πόλεμο, την φτώχεια, τον φασισμό και τον εθνικισμό. Σε μια περίοδο που οι ανταγωνισμοί των ιμπεριαλιστών οξύνονται, οι πολεμικές δαπάνες αυξάνονται και οι λαοί καλούνται να πληρώσουν το κόστος με την εξαθλίωση των ζώων τους και το αίμα τους. Η ιστορική μνήμη δεν είναι απλώς μια μάχη για την αλήθεια του χθες, αλλά μια ζωντανή απόδειξη του τι μπορεί να καταφέρει ο λαός όταν οργανώνεται, αγωνίζεται και παίρνει την υπόθεση της ζωής του στα χέρια του.

The Trump administration’s attempts to discount the votes of tens of thousands of voters it has dubiously deemed ineligible to participate in this year’s midterm elections hit two major roadblocks on Wednesday, as officials in Washington state and a judge’s ruling in California challenged the White House’s reasoning.

In August, the administration issued a report claiming that 24,000 people who took part in the 2020 election were noncitizens. Though many observers noted major flaws in the report, the White House has continued to push its disenfranchisement campaign, sending lists of residents’ names to several states and demanding that officials segregate their ballots.

After the administration sent Washington Secretary of State Steve Hobbs a list of people in his state that they said should be deemed ineligible to vote, a preliminary review of the list by Hobbs’s staff found that many of its claims were erroneous. The list included several names of U.S. citizens, for example.

The list is “not reliable,” Hobbs wrote on Wednesday in an open letter to the administration. “Without individualized proof of ineligibility, it would be both irresponsible and illegal for election officials to decline to process a registered voter’s ballot.”

A “significant number” of the names on the list are people who are simply “not currently registered to vote or are on inactive status,” he said.

Hobbs was emphatic in his refusal to comply with the White House’s demands to segregate ballots.

“State and local election officials in Washington work tirelessly to administer free and fair elections,” Hobbs wrote. “They are truly heroes of democracy. … Rather than distract these dedicated public servants from their important work at this late hour with a meritless lawsuit, I strongly encourage you to revisit the deeply flawed data you provided earlier this week, identify any actual proof, and work collaboratively with my office in the weeks or months to come.”

Also on Wednesday, a federal judge ruled against the administration in a lawsuit it had filed against California. The suit seeks to segregate 20,000 ballots belonging to supposed noncitizens in that state’s upcoming elections. Notably, in paperwork filed with the court earlier this week from Los Angeles, officials discovered that a “high percentage” of the names belong to people born in the United States.

Judge David O. Carter did not mince words in his decision.

“This case is about the right of every American citizen to vote in a free and fair election,” the federal judge wrote. “Never before in American history has the federal government, on the eve of an election, sought to coerce a state and local government to abandon their own Constitutional elections procedures and bend to the will of the Executive Branch.”

“In bringing this lawsuit, the Executive would have this Court believe that it reigns as a sole sovereign. But California and its people are sovereign, too,” Carter added.

The request by the administration to segregate ballots “violates longstanding constitutional principles mandating that states have control over their elections” that could have long-term precedential consequences, Carter said.

Constitutional rights and our democracy are at stake. The public interest favors their protection. Individuals who have met the requirements of California’s voter registration laws must not be deprived of a core right merely because of unfounded allegations stemming from a procedure rife with uncertainty and errors.

“Eroded trust in our democracy is irreparable,” Carter wrote in the conclusion of his ruling. “Once a vote is segregated, lasting harm has occurred. If the Executive can discount votes and threaten an ongoing election due to unproven allegations, then our democracy is in danger. This Court declines to be a party to such process.”

The refusal by Washington state officials to comply with the administration’s demands, as well as the legal ruling from a federal judge, could be challenged by the White House. But with only a few days left before the midterms, it’s unlikely that any action — short of one that is drastic and potentially unlawful — could occur in time for an appeal.

author: Nehaa Bimal
title: Ottawa police seek public’s help finding 14-year-old girl
content:
Ottawa police are asking the public to be on the lookout for a 14-year-old girl who has been reported missing in the city.


Lydia Oyukuluk was last seen at 6 p.m. on Wednesday in the 1000 block of Gladstone Avenue, according to a release Thursday from the Ottawa Police Service.


She was last seen wearing baggy black sweatpants, a black camouflage hoodie and socks of an unknown colour. She was not wearing shoes, the release said.


Police described her as Indigenous, four-foot-nine, with a petite build. She has long black hair that is partially dyed red at the back.


The police asked anyone with information on her whereabouts to call 613-236-1222, extension 2355.
