title: Πανεκπαιδευτική πορεία, την Παρασκευή 30/10, στις 10.30, στη πλατεία Βασ. Γεωργίου, Πάτρα
content:
Αφίσα/Κάλεσμα από το

Ελευθεριακό Σχήμα Πανεπιστημίου Πατρών

:


Η επίθεση που εξαπολύουν το κράτος και το κεφάλαιο απέναντι στο σύνολο των πτυχών της κοινωνικής ζωής είναι εξαιρετικά εντεταμένη και διαμορφώνει μία βάρβαρη καθημερινότητα για τα κατώτερα ταξικά στρώματα. Οι διαγραφές που είδαμε να εφαρμόζονται σε πρώτη φάση ξεπέρασαν τις 300.000 πανελλαδικά, ενώ στο πανεπιστήμιο Πατρών οι φοιτητές που διαγράφησαν έφτασαν σχεδόν τους 20.000. Σε συνέχεια αυτού, έρχονται να προστεθούν και αυτές των πενταετών σχολών, με τις λίστες να αναμένεται να ανακοινωθούν μέχρι το τέλος της χρονιάς. Επιπλέον στην φαρέτρα των νομοσχεδίων του πανεπιστήμιου, έρχεται να προστεθεί το νέο νομοσχέδιο για την ασφάλεια στα πανεπιστήμια, που περιλαμβάνει σχέδια εφαρμογής μέτρων όπως κάμερες και τουρνικέ στους πανεπιστημιακούς χώρους. Το νομοσχέδιο αυτό δεν έρχεται σε κενό χρόνο από το κράτος, έρχεται στοχευμένα να χτυπήσει την οργάνωση και συλλογική δράση των φοιτητών στα πανεπιστήμια και αποσκοπεί στην τρομοκράτηση των φοιτητών, την καταστολή οποιασδήποτε φωνής αντίστασης και ποινικοποίησης των πολιτικών και συνδικαλιστικών δράσεων σε αυτά.


Η αδιάκοπη εκπαιδευτική αναδιάρθρωση που συντελείται όλο και εντονότερα τα τελευταία χρόνια επιβεβαιώνει τον ρόλο που έχει το πανεπιστήμιο, να αναπαράγει δηλαδή το κεφάλαιο με υλικοτεχνικούς όρους και να νομιμοποιεί ιδεολογικά την εκμεταλλευτική φύση του καπιταλιστικού συστήματος στους φοιτητές/μελλοντικούς εργαζόμενους. Από τη μια τους εφοδιάζει με τις απαραίτητες γνώσεις για την αγορά εργασίας και από την άλλη λειτουργεί ως ιδεολογικός μηχανισμός τοποθετώντας τους μέσα σε ένα σκληρό πλαίσιο πειθάρχησης και εντατικοποίησης, σφυρηλατημένους με τις αξίες του ανταγωνισμού, της εξατομίκευσης και του κανιβαλισμού, ώστε να είναι έτοιμοι να πλαισιώσουν την παραγωγή μέσα σε αυτές τις συνθήκες του σύγχρονου εργασιακού μεσαίωνα, της ανασφάλιστης και μαύρης εργασίας και την περαιτέρω κατακρεούργηση των εργατικών κεκτημένων. Νόμοι κομβικής σημασίας για αυτόν τον σχεδιασμό αποτελούν ο νόμος Γαβρόγλου, ο νόμος Κεραμέως-Χρυσοχοΐδη, που περιλαμβάνει την ίδρυση της πανεπιστημιακής αστυνομίας, η ΕΒΕ, οι διαγραφές, τα πειθαρχικά, η εξίσωση πτυχίων μεταξύ ιδιωτικών κολλεγίων και δημοσίων πανεπιστημίων αλλά και ο νόμος Πιερρακάκη, που έχει ανοίξει τον δρόμο για την ίδρυση ιδιωτικών πανεπιστημίων.


Οι διαγραφές αποτελούν χαρακτηριστικό παράδειγμα του σχεδιασμού του κεφαλαίου για τα πανεπιστήμια. Το βασικό αφήγημα το οποίο αναπαράγεται, περί «οικονομικής επιβάρυνσης» των τμημάτων και των πανεπιστημιακών ιδρυμάτων από τους δήθεν «αιώνιους φοιτητές», αναιρείται από την ίδια την πραγματικότητα μιας και είναι ευρέως γνωστό πως μετά το πέρας των ν+2 ετών σπουδών παύουν να ισχύουν τα «προνόμια» των φοιτητών. Παρ’ όλες τις νέες τροποποιήσεις που εισήγαγε το Υπουργείο Παιδείας (παράταση 2 εξαμήνων σε όσους έχουν ολοκληρώσει το 70% των μαθημάτων ή των αντίστοιχων ECTS και αποτελούν ενεργοί φοιτητές ) είναι εμφανέστατη η στόχευση του νομοσχεδίου αυτού. Στην πραγματικότητα, αποσκοπείται η θετική αξιολόγηση του εκάστοτε τμήματος καθώς βασικό κριτήριο αυτής αποτελεί ο αριθμός των εγγεγραμμένων φοιτητών και με βάση αυτή καθορίζεται και η χρηματοδότησή του, μείωση της οποίας θα οδηγήσει είτε σε συγχώνευση ή ακόμα και σε οριστικό κλείσιμο του. Το νομοσχέδιο αυτό παράλληλα παρέχει τη δυνατότητα χορήγησης πιστοποιητικών των συγκεντρωμένων ECTS στους φοιτητές που διαγράφονται, ανοίγοντας έτσι διάπλατα τις πόρτες των δρομολογημένων ιδιωτικών πανεπιστημίων, για να ολοκληρώσουν το εναπομείναν κομμάτι των σπουδών τους, εάν βέβαια μπορούν να καλύψουν τα υπέρογκα κόστη των διδάκτρων. Δημιουργείται ουσιαστικά ένα νέο πελατολόγιο για τα επερχόμενα ιδιωτικά πανεπιστήμια τα οποία η κυβέρνηση επιχειρεί να νομιμοποιήσει με τη συνταγματική αναθεώρηση του άρθρου 16.


Το μέτρο των διαγραφών βλέπουμε επίσης να πηγαίνει χέρι-χέρι με αυτό των πειθαρχικών, σαν μέσο καταστολής των αγώνων που ξεδιπλώνονται μέσα στις σχολές ενάντια στις αντιεκπαιδευτικές πολιτικές κράτους-κεφαλαίου. Επίσης, το κράτος φαίνεται να «επενδύει» στην θωράκιση έναντι των επερχόμενων αγώνων, με ένα επιπλέον αντιδραστικό νομοσχέδιο που περιλαμβάνει μια σειρά αυταρχικών και κατασταλτικών μέτρων, με διατάξεις όπως η συγκρότηση Πειθαρχικών Συμβουλίων μέσα στα πανεπιστήμια, η ελεγχόμενη είσοδος, η άρση της φοιτητικής ιδιότητας όσων συλλαμβάνονται εντός πανεπιστημίων ακόμα και οριστική διαγραφή τους από τα τμήματα στα οποία φοιτούν.


Ταυτόχρονα, χαρακτηριστικό παράδειγμα της απόπειρας του …

author: Dominique Gené - Local Journalism Initiative Reporter
title: Nunavimmiut Futures Fair completes 3-year tour of Nunavik
content:
The Nunavimmiut Futures Fair has completed a three-year tour of Nunavik, bringing employers, educational institutions and other organizations into high schools across the region to introduce students to potential career paths.


This edition of the fair wrapped up in Kuujjuaq on Oct. 27 and 28 at Jaanimmarik School after visiting Puvirnituq, Inukjuak, Quaqtaq and Tasiujaq.


More than 10 organizations were on hand to give presentations to high school students. Evening sessions were also held in the school gym Oct. 28.


Participants included the FCNQ Co-op, Kativik Regional Government, Air Inuit, the Canadian Coast Guard, Ungava Tulattavik Health Center, Sanajiit, Kativik Ilisarniliriniq and Pijunnaqunga.


The goal of this initiative is to introduce the work of different organizations and the opportunities available to them, said Joëlle Fares, project development officer in adult education and vocational training.


“This will guide them in terms of what they can be in the future,” she said.


Fares has co-ordinated the fair, which

launched

 in 2016, for three years. She said students often become more engaged as they attend presentations and learn about the different opportunities available to them.


Some participating organizations also offer part-time employment to young people as young as 16, she said.


Among the organizations participating in the fair was Pijunnaqunga, a Kativik Regional Government employment-readiness program whose name means “I can do it” in Inuktitut.


The program supports Nunavik Inuit in developing workplace skills and gaining experience through office-skills training, professional development workshops, personalized employment advising and internships.


Emaly Saviakjuk, an employment adviser with Pijunnaqunga, said the program offers intensive, one-week training sessions in communities across Nunavik. 


Participants learn to use programs such as Microsoft Word, Excel and Outlook, with training adapted to local needs.


Those who complete the training can receive a certificate and may be connected with internships based on their skills. Some internships can lead to job placements.


Saviakjuk has experienced that pathway herself. She completed the training in 2024 before securing a job placement with the organization.


“It does really help,” Saviakjuk said.


While the Futures Fair focuses on secondary school students, Fares said she has also heard interest from adults who would like access to similar opportunities.


She said a separate event for adults could be considered, although no plan has been confirmed.


The Futures Fairs will continue next year. Organizers will begin planning soon to determine which communities will be visited and how the next edition will be organized.

author: CMI Argentina
title: El gobierno fue denunciado en la Justicia Federal por ayudar a Bolsonaro a fugarse de Brasil
content:
El gobierno nacional fue denunciado ante la Justicia Federal por su participación en un operativo para facilitar la salida de Flávio Bolsonaro hacia Estados Unidos y evitar que responda ante la Justicia de Brasil. Las presentaciones fueron realizadas por la diputada nacional Marcela Pagano en Puerto Iguazú y por el diputado Esteban Paulón y el dirigente del Frente de Izquierda Gabriel Solano en los tribunales de Comodoro Py, en Buenos Aires.


Según las denuncias, el operativo habría involucrado a funcionarios de distintas áreas del Estado, entre ellas seguridad, inteligencia y diplomacia. Buscan que se investigue cómo ingresó Flávio Bolsonaro a la Argentina y las circunstancias en las que un avión privado, con matrícula argentina, habría intentado trasladarlo a Estados Unidos.


La diputada nacional Marcela Pagano presentó una denuncia penal en la Justicia Federal de Puerto Iguazú y pidió preservar las cámaras de seguridad del puente internacional y del aeropuerto, los planes de vuelo, la lista de pasajeros y el contrato del vuelo chárter.


Presenté denuncia penal en la Justicia Federal de Puerto Iguazú. Flávio Bolsonaro tiene prohibido salir de Brasil por orden judicial. Los medios ubican su ingreso clandestino por Iguazú, un jet de matrícula argentina esperándolo para volar a EE.UU. y a la ANAC frenando ese despegue. Mientras tanto, el Gobierno dice que "nunca ingresó".


Si entró, alguien lo dejó entrar. Si lo quisieron sacar por un aeropuerto federal, alguien miró para otro lado.


Pedí preservar las cámaras del puente y del aeropuerto, los planes de vuelo, la lista de pasajeros y el contrato del chárter, e investigar por tráfico de personas en tránsito e incumplimiento de los deberes de funcionario público. La frontera argentina no es un pasillo VIP de nadie. La soberanía no se negocia ni se presta.


Fiel al compromiso de seguir dando testimonio en tiempos difíciles.


— Marcela Pagano (@Marcelampagano)

October 28, 2026


En sus redes sociales, Pagano recordó que Flávio Bolsonaro tenía prohibido salir de Brasil por orden judicial y señaló que distintos medios ubicaron su ingreso clandestino por Iguazú. También afirmó que un avión privado lo esperaba para viajar a Estados Unidos y que la Administración Nacional de Aviación Civil (ANAC) habría frenado el despegue.


“Si entró, alguien lo dejó entrar. Si lo quisieron sacar por un aeropuerto federal, alguien miró para otro lado”, expresó la legisladora, quien pidió investigar posibles delitos vinculados al tránsito de personas y al incumplimiento de los deberes de funcionario público. “La frontera argentina no es un pasillo VIP de nadie. La soberanía no se negocia ni se presta”, agregó.


Por su parte, Gabriel Solano denunció penalmente al presidente Javier Milei y a funcionarios de las áreas de inteligencia, seguridad y diplomacia por presunto encubrimiento agravado, abuso de autoridad, incumplimiento de los deberes de funcionario público y malversación de caudales públicos.


Denuncie penalmente a Milei y sus funcionarios de inteligencia, seguridad y diplomacia por la impunidad otorgada tras la huida de Bolsonaro a EE. UU.


Los acusó penalmente de encubrimiento agravado (Art. 277 CP), abuso de autoridad y violación de los deberes de funcionario público (Art. 248 CP) y peculado (Art. 261 CP), exigiendo el inicio inmediato de la investigación penal preparatoria.


El presidente Milei ha sido parte fundamental de una conspiración internacional dirigida por Trump para asegurarle a Flavio Bolsonaro eludir la investigación de la Justicia de Brasil, usando incluso para ello bienes del propio estado argentino. Ahora sabemos también que su máximo asesor Santiago Caputo, que tiene a su cargo en los hechos la SIDE, se trasladó hasta Puerto Iguazú para dirigir personalmente la fuga. Esta actuación clandestina constituye un hecho de gravedad inusitada.


— Gabriel Solano (@Solanopo)

October 28, 2026


El dirigente del Frente de Izquierda afirmó que se habría utilizado la estructura y los recursos del Estado argentino para organizar un operativo clandestino que permitiera a Flávio Bolsonaro eludir a la Justicia brasileña.


“El presidente Milei ha sido parte fundamental de una conspiración internacional dirigida por Trump para asegurarle a Flávio Bolsonaro eludir la investigación de la Justicia de Brasil, usando incluso para ello bienes del propio Estado argentino”, sostuvo Solano en sus redes sociales.

author: Sharon Zhang
title: US Journalist Detained by Israeli Forces After Being Beaten by Israeli Settlers
content:
The incident came as a UN expert issued a report detailing Israel’s “mediacide” in Gaza and the occupied West Bank.

Honest, paywall-free news is rare. Please support our boldly independent journalism with a donation of any size.

A U.S. journalist was detained by Israeli forces after being beaten by Israeli settlers while documenting attacks on Palestinians amid the olive harvest in the occupied West Bank.

Independent journalist Jasper Nathaniel, along with journalist-activists Russian Adele Shoko and Russian-Israeli Andrey Khrzhanovskiy, were in the village of Umm al-Khair when they were beaten by Israeli settlers. Umm al-Khair, in Masafer Yatta, is one of the most heavily besieged areas in the West Bank by Israeli settlers, and the journalists have been documenting fierce settler raids against Palestinians as they conduct the olive harvest.

Video taken by Shoko shows armed settlers attacking Khzhanovskiy, shoving him to the ground as Nathaniel tries to protect him. According to Shoko, Khzhanovskiy “was severely beaten and lost consciousness several times in front of police,” suffering a concussion. Another video taken by a different activist shows Khzhanovskiy falling to the ground and losing consciousness as a policeman blocks a paramedic from reaching him.

Settlers initially blocked the ambulance from reaching the scene, and Israeli officials denied Khzhanovskiy hospital treatment, instead taking him to the police station.

Shoko says she and Nathaniel were also beaten, and that Nathaniel was pepper sprayed and arrested by Israeli authorities.

"This is what we are willing to die for as Palestinians", Hazem Jbara told us, showing us half a bag of olives—all he managed to harvest in 10 minutes before settlers attacked him. I watched from the rooftop as they came from two sides, trying to trap Hazem and @infinite_jaz… pic.twitter.com/CJo1EgdmbX

Both Nathaniel and Khzhanovskiy were released on Thursday afternoon local time, Shoko said. However, they were banned from the West Bank for 60 days. “This is a clear example of Israel trying to prevent us from covering the terror it commits in the West Bank,” Shoko said.

The incident comes less than two weeks after Israeli settlers threw Washington Post journalist Heidi Levine to the ground and beat her, sending her to the hospital. That attack was documented by Nathaniel and Khzhanovskiy, who accompanied her as she received medical care.

Wearing a cast on her wrist, Levine said in an interview with CNN’s Jake Tapper last week that the violence she faced at the hands of Israeli settlers is just a glimpse into what Palestinians have to deal with on a daily basis.

“I can now really understand what others have gone through, what Palestinian women, children, men have gone through,” she said. “I’ve covered funerals of young people that have been killed by these Jewish settlers. It was always very difficult to meet people — even a man that was sexually abused and tortured in front of his family.”

“I’m an American, I work for the Washington Post, my story is getting a lot of attention around the world, everyone wants to talk to me — but I can’t imagine what it’s like for all the victims that have gone through the same ordeal and are living with the threat of this violence on a daily basis,” Levine went on.

Last week, Democratic House candidate Brad Lander was also detained by the Israeli military during a visit to the West Bank with an international delegation to harvest olives with a Palestinian family.

The attack on Nathaniel and other journalists comes just after UN Special Rapporteur for the occupied Palestinian territories Francesca Albanese presented a report to the UN accusing Israel of “mediacide” in its continued targeting of journalists and media workers in Palestine, especially amid Israel’s genocide in Gaza.

author: Shireen Akram-Boshar
title: Israel’s Election Still in Deadlock After Palestinian Parties’ Surprise Upset
content:
Netanyahu has claimed that the Palestinian parties have “stolen” the election.

Did you know that Truthout is a nonprofit and independently funded by readers like you? If you value what we do, please support our work with a donation.

With the results of Israel’s election on Tuesday finalized on Thursday, the right-wing bloc around current Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has won 53 seats out of the 120 in Israel’s parliament, the Knesset, while the opposition bloc around Gadi Eisenkot has won 48 seats. Both are short of the majority needed to create a ruling coalition government.

The real upset, however, is with the Palestinian parties, after Palestinian citizens of Israel came out in record numbers to vote Tuesday: The Joint List has won 11 seats, and the United Arab List eight seats. This gives the Palestinian parties 19 seats in the Knesset — more than their previous record of 15 — and makes the Joint List, a progressive alliance of three Palestinian-led parties, the third largest party in the Knesset.

Over the coming weeks, party leaders from Eisenkot and Netanyahu’s blocs will negotiate and work to form a ruling coalition. If they cannot form a ruling government, they will face another round of elections.

But in order for Eisenkot’s bloc to form a ruling coalition and oust Netanyahu, it would need to create an alliance with the Palestinian political parties. Eisenkot has stated that he will not work with Arab parties — but this means that his choice is either to hand the victory to Netanyahu, or create a larger opposition coalition with the Palestinian parties.

In 2021, Naftali Bennett and Yair Lapid briefly ousted Netanyahu by creating an alliance with the United Arab List. However, the Joint List, which won more seats than the Arab List in Tuesday’s election, is explicitly anti-Zionist and progressive — making it a scapegoat of the Zionist parties more than a likely coalition partner.

Netanyahu used the fact that the opposition will need to create alliances with Palestinian parties in his fearmongering around the election — his slogan, “Yamin o Falastin,” or “Right Wing or Palestine,” framed the election as a choice between his Likud party or handing power to Palestinians. The Likud Party and its far right allies had also attempted to ban the Palestinian-led parties from participating in the elections entirely — but only managed to force out candidate Sami Abu Shehadeh, chair of the Balad party within the Joint List.

Since Tuesday, Netanyahu has claimed that the Palestinian parties have “stolen” the election, saying there has been interference by “foreign entities” who aim to facilitate “a foreign takeover of the Knesset, [and] the Islamization of Israel.”

Balad’s Abu Shehadeh said the claims that Palestinian parties stole the election amount to a new phase of incitement against Palestinian citizens of Israel, who make up 20 percent of Israel’s citizen population.

Netanyahu has led the right-wing Likud Party for 19 years across six terms. In the course of his sixth term, he has overseen the three-year long genocide in Gaza, and launched calamitous wars on Lebanon and Iran. But while he is wanted by the International Criminal Court for war crimes, his political tenure was challenged inside Israel for different reasons — a longstanding corruption trial, his failures on and after October 7, and resentment over exemptions for Haredi Jews from military service.

The first Israeli election since October 7 and the start of the genocide in Gaza, this election saw former general Gadi Eisenkot position himself as an alternative to Netanyahu. This is because, as political analyst Daniel Levy told Truthout, Eisenkot is new to the political scene, and is “untainted by the corruption and failures of the [Israeli] government, in particular not having been in a leadership position on October 7.”

“In contrast to Netanyahu, who is considered to have put personal considerations over national interest, Eisenkot lost his son and two nephews in the war, and this personal sacrifice has been highlighted in staking out such a difference” in the eyes of the Israeli public, Levy added.

But this does not mean that there are significant policy differences between Eisenkot and Netanyahu. In fact, none of the Israeli “opposition” parties — save the Palestinian-led political parties — oppose Israel’s genocide in Gaza, or apartheid and ethnic cleansing policies across the occupied territories.

title: People who claim international law and human rights are completely useless because big states can…
content:
People who claim international law and human rights are completely useless because big states can violate them and get away with it are kind of lacking the ability to imagine how much worse things could be.

Do you know how much more genocide and torture and nuclear war there would be if everyone could get away with it? Do you know how much more gruesome chemical warfare would be if all states had spend the last century openly perfecting it and companies could openly sell their bio-weapons to the highest bidder?

“Israel is openly committing genocide!” YES! And it took them

75 years

of lobbying and hasbara and normalizing ethnic cleansing and apartheid for them to get to the point where they’re openly doing a genocide, and they

still

feel the need to lie about it.

If nobody gave a shit about not doing genocide, it would have taken Israel 75 days to get here. Do you honestly think David fucking Ben fucking Gurion wouldn’t have loved to do a genocide?

Like, there are lots of very valid critiques of the concepts of international law and human rights, but the idea that they didn’t impact the world at all is completely ahistorical.

author: Unknown
title: Bottom-Up Organizing: How We Got Clean Porta-Johns
content:
The first day I showed up on the Marriott construction site in downtown Detroit, everyone warned me about the state of our bathrooms.


You could smell them halfway across most floors. They were full in 24 hours, urinals were often clogged, and some people had taken to using buckets and hiding them in closets.


Every electrician already had the same idea: we wanted the cleaning schedule changed from twice a week to three times.


I had a long conversation with the steward about what had been tried. The first instinct of a construction worker is to “drag” (quit), drive over to the union hall, and pick up a new job. As expected, there was a steady trickle of drags, but no improvement to conditions.


OSHA had been called and walked the site, only to say that the number of bathrooms was up to their standard. The electrical contractor had been notified, but because the bathrooms were for all the trades, our bosses didn’t feel it was their responsibility to pay for additional cleaning.


Our Electrical Workers (IBEW) Local 58 contract only gestures vaguely to “sanitary facilities,” and protects us explicitly should we leave the site to find a “sanitary” facility. This clause was exercised regularly, but no one could say for sure whether the boss was even aware we were leaving.


A PLAN IS HATCHED


I was asked to fill in for the steward while he was out for a few days. When I walked the job to make sure everyone had my number, more than half the conversations touched on the bathrooms. I then introduced myself to the stewards from other trades, who were all hearing the same from their members.


We hatched the idea to take the issue above our bosses and straight to the general contractor (who hires out each trade and is responsible for the job site at large).


Together we wrote a letter titled “Unacceptable Bathroom Conditions,” which opened politely and assumed the boss was ignorant of the problem. The letter referenced the impact on our work and a widespread feeling that we were not being treated with respect.


We reminded him that many of us had decades of experience and were not new to the idea of using a plastic box as a bathroom, but these conditions were exceptionally bad.


We suggested that the person responsible for scheduling should use our bathrooms for a week to better assess the need for more cleanings, hand sanitizer, and a wash station. We gave one week for a response.


BUT WILL IT WORK?


Every worker who was presented with the letter signed immediately. Most people felt like the bosses would just laugh at our demands, but were interested in the idea of swarming their trailer at lunch and forcing them to read it in front of us.


We fielded many suggestions, from going straight home after delivering the letter to tipping over porta-johns on our way. We told our co-workers that if our response date came and went without change, we would be coming back around “to have a different conversation.”


But first the demand had to be made collectively and clearly. Many of our one-on-one talks were focused on assuring the workers that we would escalate if the letter went ignored: “This is only the beginning.”


We warned people about possible counter-strategies from the boss, and stressed the importance of demonstrating solidarity, especially across the trades. We didn’t invite the officers at the union hall or our reps, though we did inform them. “Every member is a steward” has become sort of a slogan for us.


IT WORKS


In the end we had 105 signatures and roughly 35 folks across four trades who gave up their lunch break to deliver the letter. The contractor read it, was brought outside to look at us, and immediately conceded to our terms.


Maybe they didn’t know how bad the bathrooms were, maybe they didn’t know how widely and deeply felt the issue was on site, or maybe they figured it was fine to ignore.


All we know for sure is, when even a fraction of us came together, with the backing of three times as many signatures, it didn’t matter if we had the union hall behind us. We are the union, the working people who don’t just walk away from a job which doesn’t satisfy us, and our demands have been met.


Kevin Szczesny is a member of IBEW Local 58 (Electrical Workers) in Detroit. A version of this story first appeared in his union newsletter.

author: Sophia Sheera
title: Israel Tries to Poach UK Doctors to Work on Illegally Occupied Land
content:
An Israeli government agency is encouraging doctors in London to emigrate to Israel and the occupied West Bank to compensate for a domestic brain drain amid the ongoing genocide and increased restrictions on the number of Palestinian doctors in its healthcare system. 


A medical fair, MedEx UK, was hosted in London last Sunday by the Israeli Ministry of Aliyah and Integration, alongside Zionist groups Nefesh B’Nefesh and the Jewish Agency for Israel, Middle East Eye reported. 


Attendees were invited to meet Israeli hospital representatives at the event and take on site Hebrew language tests required to obtain Israeli medical licences. 


Leaflets from medical providers Terem and Clalit, which operate in illegal West Bank settlements, were offered to guests. Representatives from Leumit Health Services, which

claims to run 30 establishments

 in the occupied West Bank, were included on a list of attendees seen by Middle East Eye. 


“They had a lot of very eminent professors there. They were only there for the day, and flew back the next day,” said an activist who infiltrated the event. They added that representatives for Clalit told guests: “Truly wherever you want to go in Israel, we can help with accommodation.”


Sunday’s MedEx event was held as part of a years-long drive to bring 2,000 doctors to Israel by 2029 as increasing numbers of its doctors go abroad. Some

1,369 medics left Israel

between 2023 and 2025, marking a fivefold increase over the previous decade.


The drive to recruit British doctors also comes as the Israeli Ministry of Health intensifies its efforts to exclude Palestinian medics. In 2019, the government brought in new restrictions on the number of foreign medical schools whose graduates are allowed to sit Israel’s licensing exams. Students from occupied Palestine cannot enrol in Israeli medical schools, forcing them abroad, whilst Palestinian citizens of Israel face structural barriers to entry. 


At the same time, the Israeli government has introduced financial incentives and streamlined processes aimed at attracting suitable foreign doctors. In 2025, it was announced that doctors with 10 years of experience could waive Israel’s licensing exam, down from 14 years.


The number of Palestinian doctors in Israel has skyrocketed in the last decade, with almost 45% of newly licensed medics categorised as “Arab and Druze” in 2023. But this number is expected to plummet as Palestinian doctors who started studying at foreign medical schools in 2019 are no longer considered eligible to practice in Israel.

author: Anonym
title: Génération Niketout¹
content:
„Uns bleiben noch ein paar Gramm Leben, und wir werden alles geben“

Was lachen wir doch gut in euren tristen Straßen angesichts eurer bestürzten Gesichter beim Anblick unserer Lagerfeuer. Versteht uns nicht falsch, liebe Zuschauer, in unseren Handlungen steckt viel Angst, mehr als Verzweiflung oder Hass. Jeder Ausbruch von Unruhen ist ein Würfelwurf direkt ins Gesicht eurer Republik. Wir wissen, dass es hart werden wird, und wir nehmen den offenen Konflikt in Kauf.

Wir wissen nicht, was die Zukunft bringen wird, und wir ahnen, dass die dunklen Tage nur mehr werden. Wir wissen nicht einmal, gegen was oder wen wir uns aufregen sollen, und eure Bullen sind uns scheißegal.

Die Macht ist unpersönlich, also werden wir alles zerstören, auch wenn wir verstanden haben, dass die Gebäude, die die Bullen schützen, und die gesicherten städtischen Gebiete genau die Orte sind, an die man gehen muss. Wir werden nicht aufhören, solange eure Bullen oder eure Soldaten uns nicht mit Kugeln beschießen … und wir ahnen sehr wohl, dass es bald aus dem Ruder laufen wird – es läuft bereits aus dem Ruder.

Wir wissen nur, dass in eurem beschissenen System etwas nicht stimmt und dass es den Bach runtergeht. Wir haben einfach keine Lust, mit ihm unterzugehen, und wir werden alles geben. Kennst du dieses Gefühl, bei dem sich ein Knoten im Magen bildet und man vor lauter Beklemmung am liebsten aus voller Kehle schreien möchte? Dein Beton? Deine Kameras? Deine Bullen? Deine Anordnungen? Deine Werbung? Deine beschissene Zukunft? Das muss es sein – wir brauchen Luft.

Wir, die Niemande, die kleinen Nervensägen, die Pissköpfe, die Hungerleider, ‘les shlags’ [2], die „Autonomen“, die „Ultra-Linken“, die Randalierer, das Gesindel – an diesen Demonstrationstagen lassen wir all diese Frustration raus.

An Tagen, an denen es nach Tränengas riecht, befreit uns das vom Dogma; es lässt uns leben, wenn wir spüren, dass alles ins Wanken gerät. Die blassen Gesichter deiner Marionetten im Fernsehen, die die Worte der Machthaber nachplappern, sagen uns viel über den Verfall deiner Marionettenrepublik aus. Jetzt wissen wir, dass deine Festungen nicht uneinnehmbar sind! Und je öfter sich die Bilder wiederholen, desto mehr wird uns klar, dass wir kurz davor stehen, alles in die Luft zu jagen.

Auf der Straße lieben wir uns nicht besonders. Wir sind keine „Genossen“ oder „Brüder“ oder sonstiger linker Quatsch dieser Art, aber dieses verrottete System hat uns an denselben Ort gebracht, zu denselben Praktiken und mit einer gewissen Piraten-Komplizenschaft in deiner Welt, und wir alle teilen eine gewisse Vorliebe für Piraterie und den Wunsch nach einem Tapetenwechsel.

Es stimmt, dass wir ein paar Beutezüge nicht verschmähen, die wie eine kleine Belohnung für die Risiken sind, die wir eingehen. Aber mit drei Lacoste-Poloshirts und einem Paar TN-Schuhen werden wir noch lange nicht zur Ruhe kommen. Das macht uns nur etwas weniger nervös und gibt uns das Gefühl, ein bisschen in deiner Stadt mitgearbeitet zu haben, die uns das ganze Jahr über Waren vor Augen führt, die wir uns nicht oft leisten können.

Es ist Weihnachten! Und wie so oft nach den Feiertagen ist der Kater am nächsten Tag heftig, weil sich eigentlich nichts geändert hat. Wenn der Adrenalinschub vorbei ist, sagt man sich, dass man es besser hätte machen können und dass der nächste Aufstand der wirkliche sein wird. Man fragt sich sogar, wann man vor deinen Smith-Agenten [3] nicht mehr fliehen muss.

Live vom Ende der Welt – oder besser gesagt: von dieser Welt – werden wir weiterhin ganz gemächlich Chaos stiften und dort zuschlagen, wo ihr uns am wenigsten erwartet.

Fürchtest du immer noch um deinen Platz in diesem verrotteten System? Du glaubst noch ein bisschen daran, oder? Gib’s zu! Stellst du dir vor, wie du in 10, 20, 30 Jahren gemütlich deine Rentenbeiträge zahlst, für einen Platz an der Sonne, um Krebs oder Krieg zu entkommen? Wenn du immer noch an diesen ganzen Mist glaubst, dann haben sie dich gut reingelegt und du bist erledigt. Du bist nur eine kleine Schachfigur in der Reservearmee der bestehenden Ordnung, du bist reif für die Gaskammer der Banker à la „Soylent Green” [4], den Krematoriumsofen des Kapitals, das Lager des Konsums von Leclerc! [5] Und wir wollen nicht so enden wie du! Mit der Kraft unserer kleinen Schwärme, ohne Strategien und völlig unorganisiert, haben wir seit 2018 mit den Gelbwesten verstanden, dass wir die Oberhand gewinnen und dich destabilisieren können. Tausende von …

author: Sebastian Lotzer
title: City of Blood [Part lll]
content:
“Ein Mann, der etwas zu sagen hat und keine Zuhörer findet, ist schlimm dran. Noch schlimmer sind Zuhörer dran, die keinen finden, der ihnen etwas zu sagen hat.”


Bertolt Brecht


Ohne Zweifel ist es an der Zeit, dass der Set von “Gute Zeiten, schlechte Zeiten” endlich zurück nach Berlin verlegt wird, denn hier spottet die sogenannte Wirklichkeit – ein Konzept, über das es in Zeiten von KI und kybernetischen Allmachtskonzepten so viel zu sagen gäbe – jedem noch so faden Drehbuch der Seifenoper, die seit 1992 (!) ununterbrochen ausgestrahlt wird. Ein Bürgermeister, der Tennis spielen geht, während im Südwesten der Stadt tagelang einige zehntausend Menschen sich ohne Strom und teilweise ohne Heizung bei Dauerfrost durchschlagen müssen, weil ein paar eitle Saboteure, deren unmarterialistischer protestantischer Eifer dem der Klimakleber der “Letzten Generation” um nichts nachsteht, dem Kapitalismus ein Bein stellen wollen, indem sie die türkischen und arabischen Proleten der Thermometersiedlung zu „Kollateralschäden“ erklären. Der gleiche Sprech, der gleiche Jargon wie in den Generalstäben der Armeen dieser Welt. Der Mensch wird seiner Subjektivität beraubt, er ist nur noch ein Objekt, ein Schadensereignis, das in Kauf zu nehmen ist um der “größeren Sache” wegen. Ein Krieg auf der einen wie auf der anderen Seite, hastig bemäntelt mit moralinem Geschwätz. Und wenn sich dann Genossen erdreisten, das Gesülze der Anschlagserklärung mit seine diversen Folgetexten nicht vollumfänglich zu dokumentieren, bricht der volle narzisstische Furor der selbsternannten Klima-Avantgarde über sie herein.


Der Tennis-Bürgermeister ist Geschichte, beerbt wird er von der Spitzenkandidatin der PdL, deren historisches Verfallsdatum nur dank der “Brandmauer-Debatte” im Angesicht der dramatischen Wahlerfolge der AfD ausgesetzt wurde, zum Zeitpunkt der berühmten Bundestagsdebatte dümpelte sie in den Umfragen bundesweit knapp um die magischen 5% Marke herum. 20.000 Tiktoks später wird sie nun wohl die neue “Regierende” von Berlin stellen und kein GZSZ-Drehbuchautor hätte diese Abfolge von Klischees gewagt zu Papier zu bringen. Und ja, eine altmodische Redewendung um der alten Zeiten Willen, als die Lügen noch in dicken Lettern millionenfach unter die Leute gebracht wurden und man damit wenigstens seinen Kohleofen anfeuern konnte.


Alles so billig und durchsichtig inszeniert, aber das Publikum liebt seine seichte Unterhaltung und man will ja schließlich was geboten bekommen für seine Stimmen, also her mit den Schurken und Heldentaten. Und so wird die Handlung vorangetrieben, ab und zu ein kleiner Cliffhanger, aber im Prinzip weiß man immer, was als nächstes passieren wird, man will ja das Publikum nicht überfordern. Aus der “Enteignung” wird die “Vergesellschaftung”, meint aber eigentlich nur den Ab – und Rückkauf größerer Teile des Wohnungsmarktes zum Tageskurs, die Kohle muss dann halt an anderer Stelle gespart werden (allein die Zinsen der Kreditaufnahmen!) und Spoileralarm, es wird nicht bei den Sicherheitsbehörden sein. Während man sich auf der Eigentümerseite noch etwas ziert, um der Form halber, knallen im Stillen schon die Sektkorken und die Leerverkäufe greifen um sich. Die völlig überhitzte Immobilienblase steht eh kurz davor zu implodieren, völlig neue Verwertungsmöglichkeiten in Zeiten des KI Hypes bringen das “Betongold” zum Schmelzen und eben jene KI wird große Teile der städtischen Mittelschicht in den nächsten Jahren einfach ausradieren, sie werden als “produktive Klasse” schlicht nicht mehr existieren, mit radikalen Folgen für den Wohnungsmarkt in Berlin. Zeit also, Aktiva abzustoßen, bevor sie zu Trash-Stocks werden. Aber immer schön weiter die medialen Nebelkerzen zünden, um ein Drama zu generieren, das in Wahrheit gar nicht stattfindet. Also weiter jeden Tag das gleiche Gesülze, die Inszenierung zweier Lager, die sich angeblich bis aufs Blut bekämpfen, während die ganze Angelegenheit nur dazu dient, alles so zu belassen, wie es dem Kapital und seinen Verwertungsgesetzen dienlich ist. Hinter die Kulissen zu schauen, ja überhaupt zu begreifen, dass es sich nur um eine billige Kulissenschieberei handelt, würde zumindestens Ansätze von Interesse an den Gesetzmäßigkeiten von ökonomischen Zusammenhängen voraussetzen, aber die Linke, auch ihre radikale Fraktion, von den Anarchisten ganz zu schweigen, hat sich ja schon vor langer Zeit dem identitären Spektakel verschrieben und will von so furztrockenen Kram wie Ökonomie nichts mehr …

author: Antimilitaristisches Aktionsnetzwerk (a2n)
title: Skillshare „Bundeswehr-Werbung busten!“ 4.-6.12.2026
content:
Skillshare „Bundeswehr-Werbung busten!“ 4.-6.12.2026


Dich und Deine Gang stört Bundeswehr-Werbung? Du hast Adbusting schon mal ausprobiert oder möchtest es lernen? Herzlich willkommen beim Skillshare „Bundeswehr-Werbung busten“ des Antimilitaristischen Aktionsnetzwerkes (a2n) vom Freitag, den 4. Dezember bis Sonntag, den 6. Dezember 2026. Hier gibt’s jetzt das vorläufige Programm. Du willst mitmachen? Schreib uns bitte an antimil_aktionsnetzwerk@riseup.net


Was ist Adbusting?


Adbusting? Davor gruseln sich die Bundis landauf landab. Denn wenn Leute einfach die Werbeposter der Bundeswehr mit Farbe, Papier, Schere und Kleister bis zur Kenntlichkeit entstellen, bleibt vom Image des sicheren, actiongeladenen, guten Arbeitsplatzes nicht viel übrig. Stattdessen dominieren die veränderten Poster dann Themen wie Tod, Mord, Befehl, Gehorsam und Sexismus.


Skillshare?


Dieses Adbusting wollen wir üben. In Berlin am Skillshare-Wochenende in Theorie und dann praktisch mit einer echten Aktion in der Woche danach rund um den 10. Dezember. Das ist der Internationale Tag der Menschenrechte. Dieses Datum wollen wir nutzen, um in allen Städten, aus denen ihr zum Skillshare kommt, mit selbst gebastelten Plakaten für Asyl für Kriegsdienstverweiger*innen zu werben. Dazu haben wir mit Farbe und Papier selber Plakate erstellt. Diese sind grün wie Notausgangsschilder. Sie haben auch die typische weiße Tür, den Pfeil und das menschliche Piktogramm. Doch das Piktogramm hat einen Stahlhelm und ein Gewehr vor dem Notausgang fallen gelassen. Dazu steht auf dem Poster weiß auf Grün der Slogan „War Resisters Welcome!“ Mehr Infos dazu hier:


https://antimil-aktionsnetzwerk.site36.net/2026/10/25/war-resisters-welcome-mitmachen-bei-adbusting-aktion/


Gibt Adbusting nicht Ärger?


Doch, Adbusting gibt Ärger. Es hat sich in den letzten zehn Jahren dank wehrhafter Soli-Arbeit zwar einiges getan. Damals beschäfftigte sich das Terrorabwehrzentrum GETZ vier Mal mit Adbusting, der Bundesverfassungsschutz warnte in seinem jährlichen Bericht für 2018 vor Adbusting als Gefahr für die Republik und die Berliner Cops traten 2017 und 2018 verzweifelt allem und jedem, den sie mit Adbusting in Verbindung bringen konnten, die Tür ein. Das hat sich geändert: Das Bundesverfassungsgericht erklärte 2023 Hausdurchsuchungen wegen Adbusting für illegal. In Berlin werden Verfahren wegen Adbusting seit 2020 eingestellt, wenn beim Aufhängen eigener selbst produzierter Plakate nichts geklaut oder kaputt gemacht wurde. Das Ordnungsamt Tübingen versuchte es 2025 erfolglos mit der Behauptung einer Ordnungswidrigkeit. In Schwerin gab es 2026 sogar einen Freispruch.


Oldenburg?


Doch In Oldenburg ging die Staatsanwaltschaft gerade mit einer Hausdurchsuchung gegen selbst gedruckte Adbustings vor. Auf Urteile aus Karlsruhe scheißen sei dort „übliches Vorgehen“, sagt die Staatsanwaltschaft.


Gute Chancen


Wir denken, dass man angesichts der juristischen Lage auch in Oldenburg gute Chancen hat, aus Ärger wieder rauszukommen, wenn wir uns anschließend gemeinsam kollektiv angemessen gegen Repression wehren. Aber klar: Erfolgreicher Protest führt im demokratischen Rechtstaat erstmal zu Repression und viel Arbeit; das muss allen klar sein, die sich auf diese Weise politisch engagieren. Bitte beachtet den im Programm dazu für Samstag, den 5.12.2026, vorgesehenen Talk zu Solidarität.


Mitmachen?


Ihr seid gefragt: Macht mit, bringt euch ein! Das ist eine selbstorganisierte Veranstaltung. Auch den Rest wollen wir gerne DIY durchziehen: Aufräumen, Essen machen, Kinderbetreuung, Awareness, usw. Auch hier könnt ihr und eure Gruppen euch einbringen. Deshalb machen wir am Anfang eine Liste mit verschiedenen Aufgaben, wie kochen, abwaschen, putzen, in der sich alle eintragen können. Dann ist die Repro-Arbeit auf viele Schultern verteilt.


Geld?


Dank der DFG-VK Berlin-Brandenburg können wir ein Tagungshaus mieten und Verpflegung für alle kaufen. Wir freuen uns über Spenden.


Bitte tragt eure Fahrtkosten selber. Falls das nicht geht, schreibt bitte eine Mail an antimil_aktionsnetzwerk@riseup.net. Bitte macht das wirklich, wenn ihr ansonsten nicht teilnehmen könnt. Die Asche treiben wir auch noch auf und wir behandeln das diskret vor den anderen Teilis.


Wann und Wo?


Bitte seid wenn möglich um 17h am Veranstaltungsort. Dieser ist etwa einen Stunde vom Hauptbahnhof entfernt. Wo ihr genau hin müsst, schreiben wir euch nach eurer Anmeldung bei antimil_aktionsnetzwerk@riseup.net …

author: Munia Abu Jamal
title: USA: Mumia Abu-Jamal bekundet seine Unterstützung für die Mobilisierung der Jugend in Frankreich
content:
Das ehemalige Mitglied der Black Panthers und der afroamerikanische politische Gefangene Mumia Abu-Jamal hat eine vielbeachtete Solidaritätsbotschaft an die Schüler und die kämpfende Jugend in Frankreich gerichtet. In einer aus seinem Gefängnis in den USA aufgenommenen Botschaft würdigte der Aktivist die Lebendigkeit der aktuellen Mobilisierungen und zog eine Parallele zur Erinnerung an die Kämpfe vom Mai 1968 und zu den revolutionären Traditionen Frankreichs.


Meine lieben Brüder und Schwestern in Paris und in ganz Frankreich, insbesondere die Jugendlichen und Studierenden … Was ihr tut, ist bemerkenswert und unglaublich. Und das erinnert mich an die schönsten Zeiten: Wenn die Franzosen in die Rebellion eintreten, stehen sie in Verbindung mit ihren revolutionären Vorfahren.


Es gibt einen Unterschied zwischen den Franzosen und den Amerikanern: Die Amerikaner bewahren ihre Revolution gerne in Museen auf, hinter Glas, unantastbar, in der Kälte riesiger Gewölbe, weit weg vom Volk. Aber die Franzosen bewahren ihre revolutionären Überzeugungen und die Erinnerung an ihre Vorfahren in ihren Herzen und auf ihren Lippen, in ihren Gedanken und in ihren Taten.


Und die Jugendlichen, die Jugendlichen von heute, erinnern mich an die Jugendlichen von 1968, und das ist wunderbar. Ich liebe euch alle.


Mit Liebe, nicht mit Angst.


Mumia Abu-Jamal.

https://secoursrouge.org/usa-mumia-abu-jamal-apporte-son-soutien-a-la-mobilisation-de-la-jeunesse-en-france/

author: Vanessa Kallas
title: Israel Is Demolishing Olive Groves and Destroying Entire Villages in Lebanon
content:
Israel is uprooting and stealing ancient trees and expelling anyone who tries to reach their land in South Lebanon.

Did you know that Truthout is a nonprofit and independently funded by readers like you? If you value what we do, please support our work with a donation.

On October 15, Israeli forces expelled residents and farmers from Azariel, an olive grove on the outskirts of Kfarshouba in South Lebanon, ordering them to return the following week if they still wished to harvest their trees. The next morning, an Israeli bulldozer, flanked by two army tanks, invaded the olive grove and uprooted the trees.

A few days before the expulsion, Chebli, a farmer from Kfarshouba, had watched an Israeli bulldozer uproot 70 olive trees belonging to his neighbor.

“I went over to him and found him crying,” he told Mondoweiss. “He spent more than 20 years plowing this land and pruning the trees, and he hadn’t even harvested them yet.”

Following the partial ceasefire agreement that was signed in June of this year, Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu said the military would remain in what Israel calls its “security zone” in order to “continue to destroy terrorist infrastructure.” In addition to this, Israeli defense minister Israel Katz declared that Lebanese civilians will not be allowed to return south of the Litani River, leaving hundreds of thousands of people indefinitely waiting to return. For farmers and agricultural workers, this forced displacement means not only losing their homes, but also their livelihood.

Olive groves cover around 62,000 hectares of land in Lebanon — nearly a quarter of the country’s farmland — making it one of the most vital crops in the country. The autumn harvest, which peaks in October and November, yields around 19,000 to 20,000 tons of olive oil per year, according to the International Olive Council. One of the oldest olive trees in the world, estimated at 1,100 years old, reportedly resides in the northern part of the country. In Kfarshouba, Chebli’s village that is now occupied by the Israeli army, the olive trees range between 300 and 500 years old.

Across South Lebanon, farmers and residents describe a pattern of bulldozed groves, ancient trees uprooted and stolen, and Israeli troops expelling anyone who tries to reach their land. On October 11, the Lebanese Army said Israeli fire killed Ali Abdel Hassan Sweidan, a retired chief warrant officer, as he was inspecting his property in Yater, in Bint Jbeil district, during the olive harvest.

The war has also severed farmers from their markets. “Khiam alone used to buy half the South’s harvest,” Chebli said, by his own estimate, referring to the hilltop town on the Israeli border, which Israeli forces now occupy.

“The olive season is gold for people,” he said. “It lets you hold your head up.”

Israel continues to occupy a buffer zone behind what it calls the “yellow line,” an area that includes 55 to 62 towns and villages, totaling around 6 percent of Lebanese territory. The US-brokered ceasefire agreement was supposed to enforce an Israeli withdrawal from southern Lebanon, but has instead facilitated further land grabs and demolitions.

Israel expanded its occupation of the South during the latest military escalation of a protracted war that began three years ago. After the November 2024 ceasefire, Israel continued to strike Lebanon almost daily, killing 139 civilians during that time. On March 2, 2026, two days after a US-Israeli strike killed Iran’s Supreme Leader Ali Khamenei, Hezbollah fired rockets that the Israeli military said fell in open areas. Israel responded with a full-scale military campaign that killed at least 4,389 people in Lebanon, despite the temporary truce agreed upon in April, and the partial ceasefire agreement signed in June.

In Kfarshouba, Israeli forces have drawn a line through the farmland that no one may cross, according to Ali Salah al-Dhiyab, one of the village’s mukhtars, the elected officials who serve as village heads. Since 2024, he said, farmers have been able to reach their land only once, for a single day.

“We harvested like thieves,” he told Mondoweiss. “You don’t know how you’ll get there or how you’ll get back.”

author: Lilli Akpaleeapik
title: Qajuqturvik hopes to start country food festival with a ‘bang,’ says centre’s leader
content:
The Qajuqturvik Community Food Centre in Iqaluit is preparing to roll out its first ever Country Food Festival.


The first of six meals offered during the weeklong event will be served Sunday, with two seatings of 60 people. Laakkuluk Williamson will curate and prepare the opening-day menu, which will feature inuksiut, or traditional food, from Nunavut and Kalaallit Nunaat, or Greenland.


On Monday, Laakkuluk Williamson will serve a variety of inuksiut from Kalaallit Nunaat, or Greenland, including smoked Maktaaq and dried fish. (Photo by Lilli Akpaleeapik)


The menu was inspired by Williamson’s continuous travel back and forth between her two homelands, Greenland and Nunavut.


“I’m very passionate about making sure that country food is part of our everyday experience as Inuit,” she said Wednesday in an interview at the food centre. “It’s wonderful to be able to show solidarity, that we have one culture, one language, through the food that we are having.”


Sunday’s plates will be filled with pitsi, or dried fish; maktaaq; uujuq, or stewed meat; and roasted tukuminiq, or caribou meat with gravy. To top it off will be a dessert of baked goods, applesauce and whipping cream topped with paurngait, or crow berries, and aqpiit, or cloudberries.


“We wanted to take a full week to really put the focus on country food and start off with a bang, with a very exciting experience of a bunch of ways of doing country food in one meal,” said Joseph Murdoch-Flowers, executive director of Qajuqturvik Community Food Centre.


The food centre has operated in the city since the 1990s, providing a free lunch service on weekdays. It also hosts the weekly Quaq Corner, during which elders enjoy quaq, or frozen meat, together.


Most recently, the centre hosted a Pizza Palooza event on Oct. 3.


Qajuqturvik also encourages cultural practices such as hunting through partnerships that supply cultural foods through Qinnirvik, the centre’s country food store.


Sunday’s feast is a free event. People can visit the centre day of between 2 p.m. and 4 p.m. for their chance to get a ticket. The first seating is scheduled for 5 p.m., and the second is at 7 p.m.


The centre is providing tickets for crowd control, said Murdoch-Flowers.


“We have made it free so that it is very low-barrier, but you do have to show up to get the ticket and then come eat,” he said.


Lunches served for the rest of the festival, which ends Nov. 6, are free as well.

author: Chris Walker
title: Ramaswamy’s Poll Numbers Drop 6 Points Following Ad Featuring Amy Acton’s Mother
content:
Democratic candidate Amy Acton says her estranged mother did nothing to protect her from her late stepfather’s abuse.

Truthout is a vital news source and a living history of political struggle. If you think our work is valuable, support us with a donation of any size.

Polling indicates that Republican candidate for Ohio governor Vivek Ramaswamy has lost support from voters in the weeks since he aired a controversial campaign ad featuring his opponent’s long-estranged mother.

A survey conducted by a Republican polling firm before the airing of the ad found that Democratic nominee Amy Acton and Ramaswamy were in a statistical tie, with Acton leading slightly by a margin of 47 percent to 45 percent. Polling from that firm after the airing of the ad shows Acton leading by 50 percent to Ramaswamy’s 42 percent — a 6-point swing in favor of the Democrat.

The ad was widely criticized, not just by Democrats but also by some Republicans, because it featured Acton’s mother, Donna Arthur, accusing her daughter of having a “serious problem” and of being “a liar.” Acton and Arthur have not seen or spoken to one another since Acton was 12 years old, when she testified that Arthur’s then-husband had sexually assaulted her for years.

“Between the ages of 10 and 12, I was sexually abused by her husband, while my birth mother did nothing to protect me. … I’ve always known that she was deeply sick and unwell, and it’s sad to see Vivek Ramaswamy exploit her all for his own political gain,” Acton said in a statement earlier this month.

Despite widespread pushback, Ramaswamy continued purchasing ad time for the commercial. President Donald Trump also supported the ad, refusing to acknowledge the abuse Acton alleged against her stepfather. At a campaign rally this week in Ohio, Trump went so far as to claim that critics were being “very unfair” to Ramaswamy.

The decision to run the commercial was controversial even within the GOP candidate’s own campaign. Sources have indicated that, even with only a few days left in the race, staffers are considering quitting over Ramaswamy’s continued defense and promotion of the ad.

Given the backlash, the ad may have the potential to do greater harm than good for Republicans overall, becoming a sort of self-defeating October Surprise.

But with the president’s endorsement of the spot, GOP candidates are in a tough position, as public condemnation of the ad could alienate MAGA supporters. Within Ohio, GOP candidate for lieutenant governor Robert McColley has felt “forced to publicly defend it,” sources say, despite supposedly having reservations about the commercial early on.

Beyond the Republican firm’s polling, other recent surveys indicate that Acton is ahead of Ramaswamy, with an aggregate of data compiled by FiftyPlusOne showing her with a 3-point lead as of Thursday morning.

title: McMahon to Spend $43K of Taxpayer Money on Furniture While Gutting Ed Department
content:
This comes as the education secretary plans to remove the Federal Student Aid office from the Department of Education.

Truthout is a vital news source and a living history of political struggle. If you think our work is valuable, support us with a donation of any size.

Linda McMahon, President Donald Trump’s billionaire education secretary, faced backlash on Wednesday over her plans to spend more than $43,000 of taxpayer money on new furniture for her government office as she works to illegally dismantle the department she leads, harming students across the country.

Democratic Sens. Patty Murray (Wash.) and Tammy Baldwin (Wis.) wrote in a letter to McMahon that “it is unjustifiable to buy new furniture while students lose access to education services you are illegally dismantling and suffer from painful funding cuts that were not authorized by Congress.”

A senior official at the Education Department, whose staff has been gutted during Trump’s second term, told The New York Times that the roughly $43,000 in costs “included a new desk, conference table, chairs and other items.” The department informed lawmakers that existing furniture can’t be “aesthetically integrated into the agency’s new office space” — a privately owned building that housed the US Agency for International Development before the Trump administration shut it down.

Murray and Baldwin wrote in their letter to McMahon, a former professional wrestling executive whose net worth is estimated to be around $3 billion, that “you have asked students, families, and teachers across the country to endure extraordinarily painful cuts in the name of ‘fiscal responsibility,’ and you have pushed out nearly half of the staff at the department in a chaotic, illegal campaign to fire employees tasked with protecting students with disabilities in the classroom and going after predatory student lenders.”

“This year, you have asked Congress to slash funding for important K-12 programs and to cut funding for higher education programs by nearly $5 billion — including by destroying programs like TRIO and Federal Work Study,” the senators added. “But it is clear that you do not think that you should have to abide by the same rules you want to apply to others.”

The senators noted that as McMahon moves to spend taxpayer dollars on new furniture for her office, other department employees are working in spaces that have been deemed “unsafe and in disrepair, with water leaking from ceilings, mold in kitchens, extreme temperatures from a failing HVAC system, insect traps filled with dead bugs, and live insects in lactation rooms and work areas.”

“The American people are sick of the corruption, sick of the waste, and sick of the hypocrisy coming out of all corners of this administration,” Murray and Baldwin wrote. “They deserve a full accounting of how and why their tax dollars are being used to buy new office furniture for a secretary whose stated mission is to put themselves out of a job.”

McMahon’s office makeover plans were revealed days after reports indicated that she planned to remove the Federal Student Aid office from the Department of Education — without congressional approval — and create a new independent agency to manage roughly $1.6 trillion in debt owed by more than 40 million borrowers. The planned move marks the latest step in McMahon’s push to effectively abolish the Education Department, fulfilling a Trump campaign promise.

Mike Pierce, executive director of the advocacy group Protect Borrowers, said in response that “changing the name on the agency letterhead will do nothing to lower costs for working-class families squeezed by rising student loan bills and surging college tuition.”

“More than 3 million student loan borrowers defaulted on a loan last year, and more than 3 million more are on track to do the same this year,” said Pierce. “Due to the Trump administration’s reckless actions, millions have seen their credit scores ruined. As a result, a generation of Americans will be locked out of the mortgage market, denied a typical car loan, and pay far more for a credit card because Linda McMahon cannot be bothered to fix the broken student loan system.”

author: anred
title: ULM 5: con este juicio también Alemania está en el banquillo
content:
A más un año del encarcelamiento de los Ulm 5, el juicio que fue prolongado hasta Enero de 2027. Las audiencias fueron triplicadas por interrupciones innecesarias y medidas disciplinarias autoritarias por parte de la jueza Katrin Lauchstädt. En el juicio, se pueden visibilizar innumerables irregularidades cometidas por el Tribunal Regional de Stuttgart, en detrimentos de los derechos y garantías procesales de las y los acusados. Los llamados «Ulm5»: la argentina Leandra, Zo, Crow, Vi, y Daniel irrumpieron el 8 de Septiembre del 2025 en la compañía de producción armamentística Israelí Elbit Systems, en la ciudad de Ulm. Los Ulm 5 son activistas de Irlanda, Gran Bretaña, Argentina-España y Alemania que llevan años defendiendo los derechos de las y los palestinos por la vía legal, es decir, manifestaciones y peticiones a políticos, entre otras acciones. Su acción fue expresión de una profunda convicción: desobediencia civil dirigida exclusivamente contra bienes materiales con el fin de salvar vidas humanas. Elbit Systems Deutschland GmbH & Co KG es una filial al 100 % de la empresa israelí Elbit Systems Ltd. y suministra el 86% de las armas al ejército israelí, con las mismas que se comete el Genocidio en Gaza contra el pueblo de Palestina y contra toda la humanidad.

Por Ana Muro, corresponsal de ANRed, desde el Tribunal Superior de Stuttgart.


Desde el día de su detención e ingreso en prisión preventiva, el 8 de septiembre de 2025, la Fiscalía General solicitó penas de prisión de varios años y aboga por que se tenga en cuenta, como circunstancia agravante, una «motivación antisemita» e imputa a los acusados: Daños materiales, Allanamiento de morada, Constitución de una organización delictiva (art. 129 del Código Penal alemán) en su relación con Palestine Action Germany y Uso de símbolos de organizaciones inconstitucionales y terroristas, por el uso del lema «From the River to the Sea» Ulm 5 han pintado consignas en la fachada de la empresa como „baby killer“ y lanzado pintura roja simbolicamente como sangre. Los cinco acusados habrían accedido a través de una ventana lateral a las salas de laboratorio y oficinas de la tercera planta. Allí destruyeron de forma selectiva computadoras, teléfonos, así como equipos de laboratorio e instrumentos de medición sensibles. Los 5 activistas grabaron la acción para difundirla a través de las redes sociales y posteriormente, la policía los detuvo. La Fiscalía General estimó que los daños materiales causados por el acto ascendían a más de un millón de euros.


La defensa expuso por qué el acto imputado por los Ulm 5 está amparado por la legítima defensa frente a un genocidio. Ellos trataron de interrumpir la exportación de armamento y la transferencia de Software, desde Ulm, Alemania a Israel, elementos clave para la conducción del genocidio en Gaza.


A pesar de las peticiones de la defensa, el fiscal Stengel se negó a investigar el papel de Elbit Systems Deutschland en el genocidio de Gaza y demás crímenes de guerra perpetrados por el Ejército y gobierno israelí. El tribunal no inició el juicio hasta cuatro meses después de que concluyera la investigación.


En el juicio, se pueden visibilizar innumerables irregularidades cometidas por el Tribunal Regional de Stuttgart, en detrimentos de los derechos y garantías procesales de las y los acusados.


Desde entonces, a pesar de no exteriorizar ninguna “peligrosidad” en la sociedad, y no dar indicios de peligro de fuga, los 5 están en prisión preventiva y repartidos por diferentes cárceles de maxima seguridad en el Sur de Alemania, en condiciones de detención extremadamente duras.


Éstas, afortunadamente, se fueron flexibilizando paulatinamente, gracias a los reclamos de abogados, grupos defensores de Derechos Humanos, familiares, camaradas y amigas.


El juicio se trasladó del Tribunal Regional de Stuttgart (Landgericht) al Tribunal Regional Superior (Oberlandesgericht) de alta seguridad de Stammheim —donde tuvieron lugar los juicios del grupo RAF, Rote Armee Fraktion, un grupo de izquierda armado en la década de 1970 y donde actualmente se celebran los juicios por delitos violentos o de terrorismo—.


Este juicio, en cuanto a su dilatación, viola en derecho a la celeridad, ya que, se han triplicado el número de las audiencias por interrupciones innecesarias y medidas disciplinarias por parte de la jueza Katrin Lauchstädt.

author: Pauline Ertel
title: France Sends Arms to Israel Despite Claiming Not To, Report Finds
content:
The French government has launched an investigation after it was accused of breaching its own pledge not to sell arms to Israel.


The revelations, first reported by French leftwing news website

L’Humanitie

, call into question French President Emmanuel Macron’s

2024 claims

 that the country does not supply arms to Israel. 


Collated by Urgence Palestine and Palestinian Youth Movement

the damning report

 contains evidence of 35 new military equipment sales from French companies to Israeli arms manufacturer Elbit Systems between May and September 2026. The sales include parts likely to be used for cooling systems in tanks, helmet visors for helicopter and fighter jet pilots and components for drones.


Lawmaker Thomas Portes, from the leftwing France Unbowed party, accused the French government of failing to act and urged foreign affairs minister Jean-Noël Barrot to comment on the accusations in the report. 


During a debate in the National Assembly earlier this month, Barrot announced that “an investigation has been launched” and pledged that “precautionary measures have been taken pending the findings.” 


Thomas Nayla, a lawyer working with Urgence Palestine told Novara Media the announcement was “an admission of French complicity” and called for transparency. 


“Against whom are the investigations directed, and will the French state acknowledge that it does indeed export arms?” he added. 


During October 50 organisations have been taking part in a

month-long series of actions

 against French complicity in genocide. 


Earlier this month unions and NGOs prevented a shipment of military components being loaded onto a number of planes destined for Israel by

filing for an injunction

, citing French restrictions on arms exports to Israel. 


“This victory demonstrates one thing: when workers organise and mobilise, they can effectively prevent companies from contributing to the arming of a genocidal war,” Tayeb Khouira, National Secretary of French trade union group Union Syndicale Solidaires, told Novara Media. 


“We have shown that we are not condemned to stand by and watch what is happening in Palestine without taking action.”

author: Gustavo Faleiros
title: Será que Lula 4 nos conduzirá ao futuro ancestral?
content:
Quer receber os textos desta coluna em primeira mão no seu e-mail? Assine a newsletter Ligando os pontos, enviada toda quinta-feira. Para receber as próximas edições,

inscreva-se aqui

.


Em seu discurso de vitória na noite de 25 de outubro, Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) prometeu, em seu quarto mandato, uma nova forma de governar. Com isso, quis dizer que buscaria uma comunicação mais ativa com as ruas, prolongando o sucesso da estratégia digital e de mobilização no segundo turno. Me pergunto se o novo mandato também poderia representar uma oportunidade de inovar na economia e no meio ambiente.

Seria possível aprofundar um projeto socioambiental que proteja nossos biomas e favoreça os povos indígenas?


Na candidatura de Lula, a redução do desmatamento, o combate às mudanças climáticas e a proteção aos direitos indígenas estavam presentes. Bem ao contrário do projeto abertamente danoso do bolsonarismo, que negava o direito à demarcação dos territórios indígenas e prometia o desmonte da legislação ambiental. Os jornalistas e ativistas que analisaram os programas de governo dos candidatos do PT e do PL encontraram centenas de menções aos temas socioambientais no caso do petista e quase nenhuma nas propostas de Flávio Bolsonaro.


Por isso, julgo que, a partir de janeiro de 2027, há possibilidades de avanços nas políticas do poder executivo. A trajetória de redução do desmatamento coloca o Brasil como líder na transição ecológica. Tudo indica que será possível acabar com as derrubadas ilegais na Amazônia até 2030. O caminho pode ser um pouco mais longo no Cerrado, onde a agricultura industrial obtém maior lucro. Para estancar a destruição neste bioma, será preciso repensar incentivos financeiros, como os créditos agrícolas, ou mesmo sancionar as propriedades privadas que insistem em destruir para produzir.


Há, no entanto, um caminho mais profundo e de longo prazo. Uma articulação política e territorial que se inspira nos modelos comunitários e de manejo da natureza dos povos indígenas.


A frase “O futuro é ancestral” se popularizou a partir do pensador e escritor Ailton Krenak, o primeiro indígena a ser eleito para a Academia Brasileira de Letras. Em seu livro de mesmo nome, publicado em 2022, ele traz uma mensagem de esperança ao apontar que o futuro não precisa ser apocalíptico, já que a solução sobre como viver em harmonia neste planeta já está entre nós.

Contrário à noção de um progresso ocidental, que transforma a natureza somente em recurso, o pensamento indígena enxerga a terra, as florestas e os rios como entes vivos, nossos parentes mais antigos neste mundo.


Krenak popularizou o conceito, mas o senso de comunidade e o respeito à mãe natureza são algo que observamos em muitas culturas indígenas. Quando escutamos que grandes lideranças como o xamã Yanomami Davi Kopenawa nos alertam dos riscos de liberar os espíritos maléficos quando destruímos a floresta, é fácil entender a violência das invasões garimpeiras em seu território.


Essa visão de mundo, tão distinta da economia capitalista, tem consequências concretas para todos nós. A demarcação de terras indígenas, direito garantido aos povos originários na Constituição de 1988, permitiu que uma vasta extensão de ecossistemas nativos na Amazônia, Cerrado, Mata Atlântica e Pantanal fosse conservada até hoje. Existe uma centena de estudos científicos que demonstram que as áreas sob cuidado dos indígenas estão em melhor condição do que as terras não demarcadas.


Em complemento a estas evidências sobre a efetividade dos territórios indígenas nas estratégias de conservação, temos um estudo muito importante liderado pelos pesquisadores do grupo de ecologia tropical do Instituto Serrapilheira, que foi capaz de calcular a contribuição econômica que as terras indígenas geram ao agronegócio.


A conexão entre floresta, chuvas e lavouras


Essa conexão se dá exatamente pela relação entre a floresta e as chuvas: a umidade advinda dos chamados rios voadores alimenta as lavouras do Centro-Oeste e Sul do país. Segundo

nota técnica publicada em dezembro de 2024

, as chuvas vindas das terras indígenas da Amazônia abasteceram 80% da atividade agropecuária do país, o que gerou R$ 338 bilhões em 2021, ou 57% da receita total.


Estes mesmos pesquisadores, junto a outros nomes de peso, como José Marengo, atual diretor do Centro Nacional de Monitoramento de Desastres Naturais, publicaram também em 2024

na revista Nature um artigo

 em que mostram que as terras indígenas …

author: Derek Seidman
title: Meet the Rich and Powerful Entities Aiming to Defeat the Rising Electoral Left
content:
Billionaires, AIPAC, and corporations have spent millions trying to crush progressive candidates in the midterms.

Honest, paywall-free news is rare. Please support our boldly independent journalism with a donation of any size.

The U.S. midterm elections are rapidly approaching, and it’s no secret that the Republican Party and Donald Trump want to destroy the rising electoral left in the United States. But as democratic socialist and movement-tied candidates continue to win Democratic primaries — building momentum and distinguishing their dynamic, grassroots campaigns from consultant-molded establishment politicians — a new constellation of forces opposing left candidates is loosely coming into focus.

The efforts of mega-billionaire donors, multinational corporations, local and regional corporate elites, the Israel lobby, and centrist groups are coalescing into a network — uncoordinated, with varying motives, but de facto united by their opposition to the electoral left’s ascendency — whose parts are intervening in local and state races across the U.S. to try to defeat left candidates and also bolster establishment Democrats.

The anti-left mobilization of entrenched wealth and influence was on full display during the 2025 New York City mayoral election that pitted pro-corporate establishment Democrat Andrew Cuomo against democratic socialist Zohran Mamdani.

Billionaires poured tens of millions of dollars into super PACs in a historic — but failed — attempt to defeat Mamdani. Former Mayor and charter school backer Michael Bloomberg — the wealthiest New Yorker, worth nearly $100 billion — spent $13.3 million on pro-Andrew Cuomo super PACs. Members of the Lauder family, heirs to a cosmetics fortune worth $21.5 billion, spent a combined $2.6 million to try to elect Cuomo and defeat Mamdani.

Joe Gebbia — an Airbnb co-founder worth $9.5 billion, and a Tesla board director — split $2 million in donations between pro-Cuomo and anti-Mamdani super PACs. Hedge fund billionaires Bill Ackman and Daniel Loeb also donated big to defeat Mamdani — at least $1.75 million for Ackman and $700,000 for Loeb.

Ackman is a staunch opponent of the Palestine solidarity movement who helped lead the charge to fire university presidents he deemed too soft on campus protest. Loeb once infamously called teachers unions “the biggest single force standing in the way of quality education and an organization that has done more to perpetuate poverty and discrimination against people of color than the KKK.”

The list of billionaire donors against Mamdani goes on: Barry Diller, media baron; Steve Wynn, casino magnate; Alice Walton, member of the wealthiest U.S. family, worth over a half-trillion dollars; the Tisch family, corporate conglomerate and sports franchise owners.

But it’s not just New York City. In Florida, for example, mega-billionaires are backing GOP Sen. Ashley Moody in an effort to crush Democratic Socialists of America (DSA) member and union organizer Angie Nixon’s U.S. senate run.

Wall Street titan Ken Griffin, a Florida power broker and big Miami property owner worth around $57 billion, has thrown $2.5 million into the pro-Moody Stronger Safer Nation super PAC. Hedge fund billionaire Paul Singer donated $100,000 to Stronger Safer Nation, and other billionaires — dental conglomerate owner Rick Workman, and real estate billionaire Edward DeBartolo Jr. — have donated $100,000 each to the super PAC.

Corporations, ranging from big multinationals to local companies, are also throwing millions of dollars into trying to defeat left candidates. Some are making direct donations to the pro-Moody Stronger Safer Nation super PAC aimed at defeating Nixon.

For example, RAI Services, a subsidiary of the tobacco giant Reynolds American, has donated $400,000 to Stronger Safer Nation. A range of companies — including U.S. Sugar, Tampa-based real estate developer Eisenhower Management, and refrigerants company iGas USA — all gave $100,000 to the super PAC.

title: DEM Party: The Republic must be updated
content:
The Turkish Republic was officially proclaimed on 29 October 1923 in Ankara, the country's new capital. In a statement titled “May the Republic endure, democracy prevail, and the brotherhood of peoples remain eternal in the second century,” the co-chairs of the DEM Party, Tülay Hatimoğulları and Tuncer Bakırhan marked the 103rd anniversary saying that citizenship could only be fully realised through an understanding that guarantees equal protection for everyone’s language, identity, culture, beliefs and opinions. The statement emphasised that Turks, Kurds and other peoples, together with all religious communities, are equal owners of the country.


The message added: “A democratic future can only be built through a shared life in which we all have an equal voice and an equal say in decision-making. A Türkiye in which women live as equals, workers enjoy security, young people have hope, and the law applies equally to everyone is possible. A Democratic Republic is one in which no one is required to be like anyone else and the will of the people is respected. This is also a vision of a country where people can live together in greater peace and harmony. An independent judiciary, the rule of law, universal human rights, a free press, the separation of powers and strong local democracy are essential to achieving this.”


The statement said that the Republic’s embrace of multiple identities would not weaken shared citizenship but would instead strengthen it. It also called for a new beginning without denying the painful experiences of the past.


The message continued: “The founding idea of the Republic is valuable, and it needs to be updated so that it meets the needs of today. If we place democratic principles at the centre of every area, from legislation to institutional structures, the Republic will provide the foundation for a country associated with peace and harmony. The Republic’s embrace of multiple identities does not weaken shared citizenship or common values; it strengthens them. We have the opportunity to turn a new page by standing side by side, without denying the pain of the past but without remaining imprisoned by it.”


Tülay Hatimoğulları and Bakırhan said that freedom, equality and justice must be guaranteed for everyone. They added that creating the conditions for peace, democratic politics and social reconciliation to flourish was a shared responsibility.
