author: Julius Gavroche
title: October 17th, or the Return of Playfulness
content:
from

lundimatin

 #539, 26/10/2026


“Opportunistic delinquency,” “holiday-strike,” “lack of political maturity,” “childish cosplay,” “reckless destruction,” “acts of rage” — all these hostile terms used to discredit the ongoing uprising have given rise to their political antonyms: “material reappropriation,” “demands for better study conditions,” “political awareness,” “joyful staging,” and so on. October 17th has been the occasion for a prolific and all-encompassing production of a staggering number of counter-interpretations, theoretical texts, and hypotheses about what drives the movement. Yet, a subterranean dimension to its actions, omnipresent throughout, still seems to be ignored: playfulness [

le ludique

]. Without returning to a thorough examination of the underlying causes of the movement, nor to a prescriptive reading of its aftermath—most often guided by the intention to “manage” the movement—we wanted here to recapture the passion at work behind the riotous gestures and the high school fervour.


“Je te tiens, tu me tiens, par la barbichette, le premier de nous deux qui rira aura une tapette!”

[“I hold you, you hold me, by the goatee, the first one to laugh will get a light slap!”)

[1]


The Game Begins


Our hypothesis, which can coexist with others, posits that the “playful” comes into play as a uniquely effective concept for understanding the fundamentally joyful riotous activity around which the subjectivities of those participating in the insurrection were emotionally bound and organised.


Whether in the charivaris, carnivals, or parades of high school students dressed as comic book superheroes, the fact remains: play coupled with laughter constitutes an undeniable domain of tactics and stratagems allowing one to temporarily break free from the grip of a dominant power. But this playful aspect is neither a simple formal reversal of positions nor a powerless parody of power. It is a refutation in action of learned protest techniques and other demands. The weariness of traditional activist circles is left behind, and already a new horizon of joyful and creative acts is emerging.


The high school students’ strategic skill lies in reusing codes deemed harmless and far too childish to be repressed or even considered: superheroes, costumes, TikTok trends, and so on. Yet, each time, they repurpose these codes in a context of assault and offensives, leading to physical or non-physical confrontations with law enforcement. For example, Captain America launches an attack followed by hundreds of individuals dressed in black. These actions further expose the fundamental illegitimacy of police officers using force. And besides, what can a police officer do against a Batman who starts dancing in front of him? Get enraged, strike, or experience boredom, or endure his docility (the latter two obligations usually being reserved for high school students). How do you stop a battle of auras, the apotheosis of absurdity and humour? By no other means than as a spoilsport. One last thing: what can a police officer do when faced with a left-wing activist, some kind of proselytizer, megaphone in hand, shouting the same old slogans? Ignore them like any other piece of scenery.


Rediscovered Lucidity(ies)


One of the obvious attributes of the complicity present before and during October 17th (Gen Z, students, temporary workers, suburbanites, subordinates, Yellow Vests—in short, subjectivities in the process of proletarianisation) is their propensity for the “playful”. The innocuous act of triggering an aura battle, like smashing a shop window, even if they share no fundamental equivalence, manifests this same playful relationship to the metropolitan imposition of a commercial space. It would be wrong to oppose acts of rage and destruction to the expression of newfound joy, or in other words, acts of looting and arson to role-playing, aura battles, and dressing up as superheroes. They condense and stem from the same affects: in short, a joy in destruction or the anticipation of destroying with joy. Against the contained, regular, and monotonous movements and displacements of the urban and commercial world, always assigned to a goal, they also oppose and demonstrate the here and now possibility of free activity, of a reclaiming of space, without a stated goal or pre-established function. In

Homo Ludens

, Johan Huizinga defines play as follows:


Summing up the formal characteristics of play we might call it a free …

title: Comunicato delle cinque attiviste italiane arrestate e deportate da Israele
content:
Riceviamo e pubblichiamo il comunicato delle cinque attiviste italiane arrestate lo scorso 22 ottobre dalle forze di occupazione israeliane a Masafer Yatta, nella Cisgiordania occupata, e successivamente espulse dal Paese. Le cinque si trovavano insieme ad altre sei persone internazionali in visita a una famiglia palestinese quando sono state fermate da coloni israeliani e successivamente detenute dalla polizia. Nel comunicato denunciano le condizioni della detenzione, il ruolo delle autorità italiane e, soprattutto, la sistematica violenza dell’occupazione israeliana contro la popolazione palestinese, che continua a essere oscurata dall’attenzione mediatica riservata agli attivisti internazionali.


Di seguito il comunicato integrale.


Siamo le cinque ragazze italiane arrestate ed deportate dalle forze di occupazione israeliane.

Il 22 ottobre undici attivistə internazionali, oltre a noi una tedesca, un britannico, un irlandese, uno statunitense, un’austriaca e un’ ungherese, sono statə detenutə da coloni israeliani e poi dalla polizia israeliana mentre visitavano una famiglia palestinese a Masafer Yatta, nella West Bank occupata.

Non c’è davvero differenza tra esercito e coloni: in diversi posti viene delegato proprio a questi ultimi il controllo del territorio. E quando non è così, la comunicazione e la complicità tra esercito, polizia e coloni è più che stretta.


La stampa racconta che la Farnesina ha ottenuto il nostro rimpatrio. Ma qui non c’è proprio nulla da ottenere: noi non volevano essere espulse, volevamo restare in solidarietà con il popolo palestinese.


Quello che la Farnesina dovrebbe ottenere è, al contrario, una spiegazione delle ragioni per cui siamo state arrestate e detenute per 48 ore, rinchiuse in delle celle senza avere accesso a un processo e a contattare i nostri affetti.


Il governo dovrebbe chiedere perché nei territori palestinesi persone internazionali non possano stare accanto alle famiglie indigene mentre raccolgono le olive nella loro terra e cercano semplicemente di vivere la propria quotidianità. Come mai le loro case e le loro terre vengono arbitrariamente sottratte, occupate, dichiarate zone di addestramento militare, cacciando le famiglie che ci abitano da sempre.


Ci chiediamo inoltre come sia possibile che criminali di guerra possano godersi le vacanze in Italia, all’interno di resort privati, scortati da Digos e polizia senza subire alcuna conseguenza.


Come sempre nei media europei, fa notizia l’arresto di persone internazionali e non la violenza sistemica che i Palestinesi subiscono ogni giorno dalla Nakba del 1948 e ancora prima.


Le famiglie palestinesi vivono sotto un regime di apartheid e terrore imposto dall’occupazione israeliana e sotto la costante minaccia di espulsione e pulizia etnica. Vedono negati i permessi per costruire le proprie case o di accedere alle loro terre, dove i coloni indisturbati possono pascolare i loro greggi rubati ai palestinesi e costruire strade e colonie illegali sotto la legge internazionale. Le persone sono tagliate fuori dalle proprie fonti di acqua, i loro pozzi, le strade e le case, vengono distrutti. Una violenza costante per costringere la gente ad abbandonare la propria terra.


Non possiamo evitare di pensare alle proteste dei contadini e gli autotrasportatori del Sud Italia, che piangono vicino ai loro alberi di ulivo e al fatto che il lavoro di una vita non permetta loro di arrivare a fine mese. Non possiamo dimenticare delle migliaia di armi che escono dalle industrie della Leonardo a partecipazione statale e alle innumerevoli mobilitazioni contro il riarmo che hanno invaso le strade, le scuole, i porti e le stazioni durante questi anni. Davanti a tutto questo, il Governo è rimasto in silenzio. Al posto di ascoltare le proteste contro il carovita e dare delle risposte alle piazze, continua a finanziare la macchina di morte che porta avanti il genocidio, l’occupazione e lo sterminio in Palestina.


Quello che ci è successo è inaccettabile ma la situazione delle persone palestinesi è cento volte peggiore. Sono arrestate ogni giorno, nessun ministero degli esteri interviene per loro conto, nessun media si mobilita in loro difesa. Anche bambine e bambini sono detenuti illegalmente nelle carceri israeliane al cui interno gli vengono inflitte violenze fisiche, psicologiche e sessuali e nelle quali spesso muoiono, nel silenzio assordante del mondo.

Lo sappiamo bene, anche perchè durante la nostra detenzione abbiamo ricevuto …

title: 💾 Fighting DOGE's Data Grab | EFFector 38.19
content:
When we give our private information to the government to pay taxes, apply for a job, or vote, we should be able to trust that our data won't later be used against us. title: Brazil’s Federal Police Probe US Companies’ Collusion With Bolsonaro’s Campaign
content:
The investigation’s main focus is on dealings involving an organization founded with the involvement of JD Vance.

Truthout is an indispensable resource for activists, movement leaders and workers everywhere. Please make this work possible with a quick donation.

On Tuesday, Brazilian Supreme Court Justice Flávio Dino ordered the Federal Police to investigate suspected foreign financing of Flávio Bolsonaro’s presidential campaign. Bolsonaro lost to Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva in the runoff. The investigation will also need to determine whether any connection exists between political support for the senator and foreign interests in Brazil’s rare earth and strategic mineral resources.

Dino issued the 38 page ruling as part of ADPF 1178, a constitutional challenge originally filed by the Brazilian Mining Institute (Instituto Brasileiro de Mineração/Ibram). He ordered that an investigation be opened under the Supreme Court’s direct supervision, due to the possible involvement of members of Congress, whose parliamentary immunity can only be overridden in the nation’s highest court, in the alleged crimes under investigation.

The investigation’s main focus is on dealings involving Rockbridge Network, a U.S. organization founded with the involvement of Vice President J.D. Vance, along with Brazilian businessmen Tallis Gomes and Pedro Sang. The Federal Police must determine whether these dealings involved money, services or other economic benefits intended to help Bolsonaro’s campaign.

Investigators must also identify who was involved in the contacts between representatives of the American organization and Brazilian businessmen, and what purpose those contacts served.

Federal Police to Investigate Possible Link Between Campaign Support and Rare Earths

One of the most significant parts of the ruling is the suspicion that efforts to finance political activity may be tied to foreign economic interests in Brazilian mineral resources.

Dino explicitly ordered the Federal Police to investigate whether there is “concrete evidence linking the discussions over political financing to the reported economic interests in Brazilian rare earths and critical minerals.”

Dino also wants to determine who may have made any proposals, who they were directed to, and what might have been offered in return.

At stake are resources considered strategic for sectors including technology, energy and defense. In his ruling, Dino noted that these minerals belong to the federal government and that their extraction requires authorization or a concession from public authorities, as required by Brazil’s Constitution of 1988

If evidence emerges of negotiations involving rural land, the Federal Police must also determine whether there was an attempt to get around legal restrictions on foreign ownership of Brazilian land, including through the use of intermediaries.

Suspicions about Rockbridge first reached Brazil’s electoral courts through a complaint filed by Renan Santos, then a presidential candidate for the Missão party. The Workers’ Party later brought its own information about possible foreign financing operations to the Supreme Court.

Dino noted that the arguments presented by the two parties overlap.

Covert Advertising and Favoritism on Social Media

Another part of the investigation concerns paid promotion of content favorable to Bolsonaro by accounts based abroad, particularly posts that cited projections from Polymarket, a foreign prediction market platform barred from operating in Brazil.

According to the complaint filed by the Missão party, foreign accounts that normally didn’t cover Brazilian politics began running paid posts about Bolsonaro’s candidacy around the same time, citing estimates from that same platform.

The Federal Police must determine who paid for this content, where the money came from, and whether any Brazilian intermediaries were involved.

The ruling also addresses the role tech companies played during the campaign. Dino ordered an investigation into “intentional asymmetries and algorithmic manipulation” meant to help or hurt specific candidacies.

To support the order, Dino compiled documents from Meta’s Oversight Board, statements from United Nations experts, and a letter from U.S. lawmakers who pointed to possible inequalities in how Lula’s and Bolsonaro’s campaigns were treated.

Among the incidents cited were restrictions on boosting Lula’s posts on Instagram and improper recommendations of content linked to …

author: Administrador
title: Zapatistische Vorbereitungen für das umarmende Treffen mit den Familien Sucherinnen.  Teil III. Umsorgen. Schützen. Bewahren.
content:
Musik: Meme del Real: »El mundo en que nací – Die Welt, in die ich geboren wurde«. Aufnahmen, Bearbeitung, Produktion: Terci@s Compas Zapatistas.

Compañeras Familien Sucherinnen.

Es grüßt Euch der Subcomandante Insurgente Moisés, Hauptkoordinator der Reise für das Leben – Kapitel Mexiko.

Nun, ich erzähle Euch, dass wir weiter fortfahren, uns vorzubereiten für die Reise, die wir machen, um Euch kennenzulernen – sowie Euren Schmerzen und Eurem Widerstand zuzuhören und davon zu lernen. Und um Euer Wort in unserem Herzen und in unserer Erinnerung zu bewahren. Wir erwarten wirklich, von Euch viel zu lernen.

Hier, wo wir uns versammelt haben, regnet es plötzlich viel und es ist kalt. Das ist ok für die, die aus den kälteren Regionen kommen; diejenigen aus wärmen Regionen leiden jedoch ein wenig, weil sie es nicht gewohnt sind. Regen sind wir alle gewohnt, denn natürlich regnet es hier in den Bergen des Südosten Mexikos viel. Im Gebirge, auf den Bergen und im Urwald regnet es so lange bis es aufhört.

Aus der Kälte wie aus der Wärme haben die zapatistischen Gemeinden delegierte Frauen, delegierte Männer sowie drei delegierte Otroas-AndEre geschickt, um sich vorzubereiten. Bis jetzt sind es zusammengerechnet 1.530. Vielleicht sinkt die Anzahl noch wegen Erkrankungen oder aus familiären Gründen. Beispielsweise hatte sich eine Compañera schlecht gefühlt; sie wurde untersucht und beim Ultraschall stellte sich heraus, sie ist schwanger. Sie musste [in ihre Gemeinde] zurückkehren, damit es ihr und ihrem heranwachsenden Kind gutgeht. Schnell meinte aber ein Compañero – der Ahnung von Tacos hat (sie zu machen, nicht, sie zu essen; denn Tacos essen, darin sind wir alle* gut trainiert) – er springt ein. Und ja, die Comandantas und Comandantes haben ihn bestätigt, denn er hat natürlich den Gesprächsrunden zugehört, die gegeben werden, um uns gut vorzubereiten.

Hier im Video zeigen wir Euch einige unserer Vorbereitungen.

Sei es die vollständige Delegation, seien es die Teile, in die wir uns organisieren: Wir bereiten uns auf Demonstrationen vor, falls es sie gibt; wie auch auf die Treffen, die Ihr uns sagt. Auf diesen Demonstrationen [marchas] – falls sie gemacht werden – ist unsere Hauptsorge nicht, was wir dort sagen, sondern die Familien Sucherinnen zu umsorgen, zu schützen und zu bewahren. Das heißt, wir sind nicht auf Tumult oder Entspannen aus, sondern Euer Wort zu hören. Und nun, wir müssen danach sehen, die Familien Sucherinnen zu umsorgen: Denn in ihrem Herzen haben sie heftige, harte Worte, welche aufzeigen und im Kampf für das Leben Richtung geben.

Wir wissen, dass wir lernen werden; dazu bringen wir Notizheft und Bleistift mit, sogar Computer, Tabletts, Smartphones. Und es kommen Compañeras, zu denen wir »Tercias Compas« sagen. Sie kennen sich mit Kamera, Aufnahmen, [Video-]Bearbeitung sowie der Übertragung der Treffen aus. Das Wichtigste jedoch ist, dass wir unseren Kopf, unser Herz, unser Innerstes mitbringen, mit der Lust zu lernen.

Im Video könnt Ihr sehen: Einige Compañeras mit ihren Babies stellen sich auf, so als wären sie für Wahrheit und Gerechtigkeit demonstrierende Familien Sucherinnen; und sogleich geht unsere Delegation oder ein Teil unserer Delegation an ihre Seite und umgibt sie wie ein Schutzschild.

Selbst das Comando Popcorn [der Kinder] übt, ein Schutzschild zu bilden, welches umsorgt, schützt, bewahrt.

Denn so haben es uns unsere Vorgänger*innen gelehrt, die uns sagten: Wir sind Bewahrerinnen und Bewahrer der Erde, der allerersten Mutter.

Wie Ihr in den Aufnahmen seht: Bei so viel während den Übungen produzierten Schlamm ist es fast eher so als ob wir ausrutschen anstatt zu gehen. Nun, wir schlittern. Dabei passiert es, dass die Sandale oder der Tennisschuh steckenbleibt, und mensch kann nicht anhalten, denn hinter einem*einer kommt ja schon die Menge an Compas. Zweifellos muss bis zum Ende der Übung gewartet werden, um im Schlamm nach Sandale oder Tennisschuh zu suchen. In der Zwischenzeit bewegen wir uns wie ein hinkendes Hündchen.

Compañeras Familien Sucherinnen.

Wir kommen nicht, um spazieren zu gehen. Wir werden Euch umarmen, wenn Ihr wollt; und falls nicht, nun, wir kommen ebenso um Euer Wort zu hören.

Wir wissen, es gibt Leute, die von der Gira [der Reise für das Leben – Kapitel Mexiko] falsch reden. Sie spalten, sie möchten bestimmen, wer oder wer nicht sich mit uns treffen kann. Das heißt, sie wollen andere Gruppen draußen lassen, weil sie sich nicht vertragen; und solcherart Dinge …

title: Critical mass d'octobre - vendredi 30 à 19h place Antonin Poncet ! - & soirée à l'atelier du Chat Perché
content:
LA


CRITICAL


MASS

, C'

EST


QUOI


DEJA

 

?


La “Critical Mass” est un mouvement cycliste né en 1992 à San Francisco. C'est une coïncidence organisée chaque dernier vendredi du mois, ou chacun.e est invité.e à participer selon ses motivations, convictions, envies, afin de partager les rues à vélos de tous genres (ou autre moyen de déplacement, rollers, skateboard… hors moteurs thermiques). Le principe est, ensemble, de se sentir libre et en sécurité à vélo dans les rues, en créant une masse mouvante compacte et bienveillante, résistant à la pression du trafic environnant, prenant soin les un.es des autres afin de créer un moment de partage et de bonne humeur où le temps d'une heure chacun.e peut être à vélo sans dangers. De cette sorte, le groupe prend de manière éphémère l'espace donné aux voitures, circulant sur la chaussée, la masse peut imposer son rythme en toute tranquillité, témoignant ainsi de la place occupée par les cyclistes en ville. La Critical Mass est de toustes et pour toustes, il n'y a pas d'organisateurs.trices, pas de hiérarchie ou de leader, étant spontanée, elle est créée par le groupe qui décide de se rassembler une fois par mois à un lieu et heure fixes, elle dépend de chacun.es. Libre donc de venir et de partir à tout moment, mais aussi d'y voir un moment entre amis, en famille, pour de nouvelles rencontres… Le parcours, comme les participant.es, change chaque mois. Personne ne décide seul du chemin, chacun.e s'implique comme iel le souhaite, tu es donc libre de te fondre dans la masse et te laisser porter ou bien aussi d'imprimer des tracts et communiquer sur la Masse, te placer en tête de cortège pour proposer un parcours, assurer la sécurité aux abords des intersections ou faire le vélo-balais.


Alors, que vous soyez un habitué ou curieux de découvrir la Critical Mass de Lyon, rejoignez-nous le 30 octobre

 

!

author: Rizomatica
title: Caso Grollmus: Chile vuelve a condenar mapuche con testigos sin rostro
content:
Ochenta años de cárcel. Eso le dio el Estado de Chile a cinco hombres mapuche en Cañete el 21 de septiembre. A otros, sesenta y cinco. A otros, treinta y cuatro. Más de mil años de prisión repartidos entre dieciocho personas. Para un hombre de treinta años, ochenta años de condena no es una pena: es morir preso.


Por:

Daniela Sierra, abogada defensora penal


Los propios condenados lo dijeron con una claridad que ningún abogado podría mejorar. En un comunicado público firmado desde las cárceles donde hoy están, recordaron que su pueblo resistió casi trescientos años al imperio español, que la ocupación chilena de su territorio tiene apenas 143 años, y que hoy ese mismo Estado los condena a más de mil.


El ataque al fundo Grollmus fue grave y nadie lo niega. Hubo heridos y hubo dolor. Pero la gravedad de un hecho nunca autoriza a un Estado a condenar de cualquier manera. Al contrario: mientras más dura es la pena, más limpio debe ser el juicio. Y este juicio no lo fue.


Condenados por personas que nadie vio


Ninguna de las víctimas reconoció a los atacantes. Ninguna. La Fiscalía construyó su caso sobre testigos secretos, personas cuyo nombre y rostro la defensa nunca conoció. Once fueron anunciados; solo cuatro se sentaron frente al tribunal. Los condenados lo resumen sin rodeos:


«Solo por cuatro relatos de estos “testigos” se dictó sentencia y veredicto».


Peor aún: hubo testigos secretos que jamás declararon. La Fiscalía renunció a ellos, pero lo que supuestamente dijeron entró igual al juicio, en boca de policías que contaron lo que otros les habrían contado. Nadie pudo preguntarles nada. Nadie pudo saber si mentían, si recibieron algo a cambio, si siquiera existen.


Y la pregunta de quiénes son esos testigos no es menor. Los presos denuncian que equipos de la PDI recorren los penales buscando internos dispuestos a declarar, a quienes luego se les pone, en sus palabras, «corbata de protegido y sin rostro». Si eso es así, Chile estaría condenando a perpetuidad sobre la palabra de personas presas, anónimas, que podrían estar negociando su propia suerte. Esa denuncia exige una respuesta, no silencio.


Pregúntese usted: ¿aceptaría ser condenado a morir en la cárcel por la palabra de alguien a quien nunca vio, que nunca habló frente a un juez, y cuyas palabras solo conoce porque un policía dice que las escuchó?


Eso no es justicia. Es una sombra con toga.


No es la primera vez. Es la misma historia.


El pueblo mapuche conoce de memoria este libreto. Primero les quitaron la tierra a punta de fusil y la llamaron «pacificación». Después los encerraron en reducciones. Y cuando reclamaron lo suyo, el Estado respondió con policías, fiscales y cárceles.


Alex Lemún tenía 17 años cuando un carabinero le disparó en la cabeza, en 2002. Matías Catrileo tenía 22 cuando otro carabinero lo mató por la espalda, en 2008; su autor no pasó un día preso. Camilo Catrillanca tenía 24 cuando lo mataron, también por la espalda, en 2018, y los uniformados destruyeron las grabaciones para ocultarlo. En 2017, la Operación Huracán encarceló a dirigentes mapuche con pruebas fabricadas por la propia policía.


Y en 2014 ocurrió algo que Chile parece haber olvidado. La Corte Interamericana de Derechos Humanos declaró que el Estado chileno violó los derechos humanos de lonkos, werkén y comuneros mapuche. ¿Por qué? Por condenarlos con testigos secretos. Por juzgarlos con prejuicios contra su pueblo. Por encerrarlos antes del juicio. Por dañar a sus familias. Es el caso Norín Catrimán y otros vs. Chile.


La Corte le ordenó a Chile algo muy simple: nunca más condenar a nadie basándose de manera decisiva en testigos sin rostro. Han pasado doce años. Esa orden sigue sin cumplirse. Y en Cañete, el Estado volvió a hacer exactamente lo mismo. Por eso el grito de los presos no es una consigna vacía: «¡No más testigos protegidos!» es, palabra por palabra, lo que un tribunal internacional ya le exigió a Chile.


No es casualidad. Es un patrón. Cuando el acusado es mapuche, la etiqueta llega antes que la prueba. Basta ver que el propio tribunal descartó que existiera una asociación criminal, y aun así autoridades y prensa siguen hablando de «líderes» y «organización». La condena social se dictó mucho antes que la sentencia.


La condena que pagan los niños


Una sentencia de ochenta años no la cumple un hombre solo. La cumplen sus hijos, que crecerán conociendo a su padre entre rejas y cemento. La cumplen sus madres, que envejecerán haciendo …

title: Üsküdar'da iki İETT otobüsü çarpıştı: 4 yolcu yaralandı
content:
İstanbul — Üsküdar'da yolcu almak için bekleyen İETT otobüsüne, durağa yanaşan başka bir otobüs arkadan çarptı. Kazada 4 yolcu hafif şekilde yaralanırken otobüslerde hasar meydana geldi.

Kaza, saat 14.15 sıralarında Göztepe Köprüsü'nde meydana geldi. Edinilen bilgiye göre, Kadıköy istikametinde ilerleyen 34 HO 3349 plakalı İETT'ye bağlı özel halk otobüsü, durağa yanaştığı sırada şoförünün direksiyon hakimiyetini kaybetmesi sonucu durakta bekleyen 34 TN 1806 plakalı İETT otobüsüne çarptı.

Çarpmanın etkisiyle otobüslerde bulunan 4 yolcu hafif şekilde yaralandı. İhbar üzerine olay yerine sağlık ve polis ekipleri sevk edildi. Yaralılara olay yerinde müdahale edildi. Kazaya karışan otobüslerde hasar meydana gelirken kazayla ilgili inceleme başlatıldı.

author: Daron Letts
title: Safety a concern in Pangnirtung after increase in RCMP calls: MLA
content:
Pangnirtung MLA Johnny Mike is calling for the territorial government to help stop alcohol and drugs from entering his community after calls to Pangnirtung RCMP went up in August.


He made the comments Tuesday in the legislative assembly.


Pangnirtung MLA Johnny Mike tabled in the legislative assembly on Monday a monthly RCMP report that shows a high rate of alcohol-related calls for service. (Photo by Daron Letts)


“The safety of the people in our Nunavut communities should get more attention,” Mike said.


He had tabled the hamlet’s September RCMP detachment report, which shows 160 calls for service in August, the most for any single month this year. The number represents almost 14 per cent of the total 1,166 calls for service so far in 2026.


Mike asked Justice Minister George Hickes how the territorial government can better collaborate with RCMP and Canada Post to stem the flow of illegal substances into the hamlet.


Hickes described Mike’s comments as “very good questions at a very good time.”


The justice minister is working with federal Public Safety Minister Gary Anandasangaree about the issue and the pair spoke just last week, Hickes said.


Currently, one inspector is stationed in Montreal to identify illegal parcels destined for Nunavut, Hickes said.


“That’s not enough,” Hickes said, adding that parcels arrive through hubs in other centres.


Bootlegging remains a problem in the communities, Hickes and Mike both agreed.


Hickes suggested residents can help RCMP to shut down bootleggers by serving as the RCMP’s eyes and ears. 


He called on Nunavummiut to notify their local detachment whenever they become aware of illicit activities, including bootlegging, even when those activities involve neighbours, friends or family members.


“It takes a whole community to discourage bootlegging,” Hickes said.


Education is also key, he added.


“It’s not just the RCMP that have a role to play,” Hickes said. “It’s the community members themselves, whether it be through hamlet officials — even down to the schools.”


Mike agreed, but emphasized that authorities are the ones who can take a “proactive” approach.


“The RCMP and the government have a big role to play,” Mike said.


The force is not sure why August was so busy, said

RCMP spokesperson Sgt. George Henrie in an email Monday.


“While there has been an increase in calls for service, the RCMP is unable to identify a specific reason for the increase, as call volumes are fluid and change consistently,” he said.


The Pangnirtung detachment is currently staffed by one sergeant and four constables.


While there are vacant positions within the detachment, relief members from outside the community fill in when needed, he added.


Detachment commander Chief Supt. Kent Pike will visit the community later this month, Henrie said.

title: Antalya'da 4 işçinin öldüğü hortum felaketi: Müteahhit ve şantiye şefi tutuklandı
content:
Antalya — Antalya'nın Kepez ilçesinde 4 işçinin hayatını kaybettiği hortum felaketiyle ilgili başlatılan soruşturma kapsamında gözaltına alınan 4 kişiden müteahhit ve şantiye şefi tutuklandı, diğer 2 kişi ise adli kontrol şartıyla serbest bırakıldı.

Kepez ilçesi Fevzi Çakmak Mahallesi 6199 Sokak'taki şantiyede, 26 Ekim'de saat 23.00 sıralarında şiddetli yağışla birlikte hortum çıktı. İşçilerin bulunduğu 2 konteyneri savuran hortum, yaklaşık 40 metre yüksekliğindeki kule vincin de devrilmesine neden oldu. İhbar üzerine olay yerine sevk edilen ekiplerin çalışmasıyla konteynerlerdeki işçiler çıkarılarak hastaneye kaldırıldı.

Olayda işçiler Aycan Kılınç (30) ile Suriyeli Muhammet Mustafa el Naim, İsa Musa el Nevaf ve Selahattin Muhammed el Naim hayatını kaybetti, inşaatın bekçisi Cumali Kurak ise yaralandı. Hortumda şantiyedeki konteynerlerin parçaları etrafa savruldu, çevredeki bir sitenin güvenlik duvarı ve yakındaki bir okulun çatısı ile bazı araçlar hasar gördü.

Hayatını kaybeden 4 işçinin cansız bedenleri, olay yerindeki incelemelerin ardından Antalya Adli Tıp Kurumu morguna konuldu. Aycan Kılınç’ın cenazesi, işlemlerinin ardından dün yakınlarına teslim edilerek memleketi Niğde’ye gönderildi. Suriyeli Muhammet Mustafa el Naim, İsa Musa el Nevaf ve Selahattin Muhammed el Naim'in ise kimlik belgelerinin bulunmaması nedeniyle kimlik tespit çalışmalarının sürdüğü öğrenildi.

Antalya Cumhuriyet Başsavcılığı tarafından olayla ilgili başlatılan soruşturma kapsamında müteahhit Mevlüt Ç. ve eşi Ş.Ç. ile şantiye şefi Deniz K. ve iş güvenliği uzmanı İ.A, gözaltına alındı. 4 kişi, emniyetteki işlemlerinin ardından adliyeye getirildi. Mevlüt Ç. ve şantiye şefi Deniz K. hazırlanan bilirkişi raporu doğrultusunda 'Birden fazla kişinin taksirle ölümüne sebebiyet vermek' suçundan sevk edildikleri hakimlikçe tutuklandı. Ş.Ç. ve İ.A. ise adli kontrolle serbest bırakıldı.

31 yıldır emeğin sesi olan Evrensel, gücünü sadece okurlarından alıyor. Emeğin sesinin daha gür çıkması için sen de güç ver.

title: Students in Rojava oppose the incorporation of their universities into state institutions
content:
The planned incorporation of the universities of Rojava and Kobanê into Syria’s state higher education system has met with resistance from students in Rojava. The Union of Patriotic Students rejects the recent decisions by the Syrian Ministry of Higher Education and warns that they threaten to undermine academic self-governance and Kurdish-language higher education. At a gathering at the University of Rojava in Qamishlo, the organization declared that it would not accept any decision that jeopardizes the educational structures built up over the years or the rights of students.


The dispute stems from two decisions by the Syrian Higher Education Council, announced on October 27. Under these decisions, the University of Rojava in Qamishlo is to be incorporated into the state-run Al-Furat University, while the University of Kobanê is to be placed under the University of Aleppo. Their faculties will henceforth fall under the authority of the respective state universities. Restrictions on the admission of new students are also planned for certain degree programs.


Kurdish-language education under renewed pressure


The decision comes amid growing disputes over the future of the Kurdish-language education system in Rojava. In late August, the Syrian Ministry of Education stipulated that Kurdish would be included in the state curriculum only as a subject taught for three hours per week. Permission to teach other subjects in Kurdish was granted only as a temporary measure.


While an independent education system with Kurdish as the language of instruction has been developed in Rojava over the years, students now fear that the future of higher education in their mother tongue is also at risk. They believe that incorporation into state universities could lead to existing degree programs being restructured, merged, or abolished.


At the gathering in Qamishlo, attended by numerous students, a statement read out in Kurdish and Arabic said: “These decisions will have a serious impact on us, as we have studied in our mother tongue, Kurdish, throughout our entire school education. The right to continue higher education in the same language is a fundamental academic right. Attempts to interfere with departments and faculties where education is provided in the mother tongue are an attack on the foundations of academia and a threat to our academic future. We will never accept this decision.”


“Integration does not mean assimilation”


The Students’ Union recalled that the establishment of independent universities in Rojava around ten years ago marked a historic step forward. For the first time, thousands of young people were given the opportunity to pursue higher education in their hometowns and in their mother tongue. These achievements must not be undone by administrative decisions, the organization said, particularly rejecting potential interference with existing faculties and degree programs.


“The abolition, merger, or restructuring of academic departments in this manner constitutes a clear violation of fundamental human rights and international conventions that guarantee the right to education in one’s mother tongue and the free, independent administration of educational institutions,” the Students’ Union declared.


The union demands that changes to the higher education system not be decided without consulting those directly affected. “Any transitional phase must be organized fairly and respect the identity of each university. Integration does not mean assimilation. Throughout the integration process, educational, logistical, legal, and academic criteria must be taken into account transparently. Otherwise, we will be faced with injustice and a betrayal of students’ rights.”


Recognition instead of dismantling independent structures


The Students’ Union emphasized that it welcomes official recognition of the universities in principle. However, it said, such recognition must not come at the expense of their autonomy or Kurdish-language degree programs. “Our wish has always been, and remains, for our university, built through dedicated efforts over the past ten years, to receive full recognition and continue fulfilling its mission without its academic programs being dismantled.”

title: Kurdish athlete arrested after summons in Kermanshah, taken to undisclosed location
content:
Mohammad Nasseri, a Kurdish athlete who manages a bodybuilding gym in Harsin, Kermanshah Province, has been arrested after reporting to a prosecutor’s office in Kermanshah in response to a summons on charges of “propaganda against the state”.


The Kurdistan Human Rights Network (KHRN) has reported that Nasseri was arrested on 26 October after reporting to Branch 16 of the Investigating Office at Kermanshah’s Public and Revolutionary Prosecutor’s Office and was taken to an undisclosed location.


He had received the summons in recent days.

author: Unknown
title: YJA Star guerrillas: Martyr Bêrîtan is the torch of our struggle
content:
Every year on 25 October, fighters following in the footsteps of Martyr Bêrîtan (Gülnaz Karataş) commemorate the anniversary of her action against the line of betrayal in the free mountains. The date also marks the founding of the women's army. For this reason, guerrillas, particularly women guerrillas, mark the day with great enthusiasm. Guerrillas of the Free Women's Units (YJA Star) shared their feelings on the 34th anniversary of Bêrîtan Hêvî's martyrdom.


YJA Star guerrilla Elefterya Gabar Cizîr began by commemorating Martyr Bêrîtan with respect: “Comrade Bêrîtan became a pioneer and symbol of freedom for us. She understood the reality of Abdullah Öcalan's leadership. She became an example for us and for all women. Comrade Bêrîtan recognised the reality of free women, rebelled against the mentality of betrayal and refused to surrender. Many years may have passed, but she left us a legacy of resistance. That is why we commemorate Comrade Bêrîtan every year. She became a symbol of the will and resistance of free women. Through Martyr Bêrîtan, we came to recognise the will of free women. Through her, we came to understand our own reality. Bêrîtan's personality and action shattered the sexist mentality that underestimated women's strength. This gave us tremendous morale and spiritual strength. Thanks to those martyrs, we came to understand what real life means and the path of free women.


 


If women today have recognised their own strength and risen up, it is thanks to those pioneers. If women continue to take their place in the fields of struggle today, it is thanks to the efforts of the martyrs and Abdullah Öcalan. Abdullah Öcalan gave us strength and created the conditions for women to recognise their own will and take a leading role in society. Women have always played a pioneering role in guerrilla life and struggle as well. Great resistance has been waged in those mountains under the leadership of free women. Comrade Bêrîtan has always been an example for us. We will always struggle to develop ourselves along Bêrîtan's path, strengthen our struggle and fulfil her dreams.”


‘We will always follow Bêrîtan's path’


Guerrilla Bişeng Brûsk Vejîn also commemorated all the martyrs of the revolution through Martyr Bêrîtan and continued: “We must always commemorate Comrade Bêrîtan and introduce her to all women. When we look at the history of the freedom struggle, we see the pioneering role played by Comrade Bêrîtan. As women guerrillas in particular, we strive to follow in her footsteps. We will always take her path as our guiding principle because she is our pioneer and heroic commander. It is a great privilege for us to struggle along Bêrîtan's path and commemorate her in the free mountains today. Comrade Bêrîtan rejected surrender and carried out an action in which she put her life on the line against the path of betrayal. She is the pioneer and torch of our struggle. The existence of women who seek freedom and keep Bêrîtan's name alive today is extremely valuable to us. As those who follow in Comrade Bêrîtan's footsteps, we are striving to develop ourselves along her path and take determined steps forward.”

title: KRG Interior Ministry opposes Shengal integration, calls for implementation of 9 October Agreement
content:
On 26 October 2026, a ceremony was held in Shengal attended by YBŞ-YJŞ fighters and officials from the Iraqi Federal Government. During the ceremony, it was announced that 4,165 members of the YBŞ-YJŞ would be integrated into the federal security system.


The Yazidi community welcomed the move, expressing satisfaction that the Iraqi state had recognised Shingal’s defence forces. They also stated that Yazidi rights should be recognised in the Iraqi Constitution in the future.


On Tuesday night, the Kurdistan Region’s Ministry of Interior issued a statement calling for a return to the 9 October 2020 Agreement, which was signed in partnership between the KDP, the Turkish state and then-Prime Minister Mustafa al-Kadhimi, under the supervision of the United Nations.


The agreement stated that the Yazidi community should not have its own defence force and proposed the dissolution of the YBŞ, YJŞ and Êzidxan Asayish forces, which had been established to protect the population during the days of the

ferman

 (the term used by Yazidi to refer to genocidal persecution and massacres).


The Yazidi community rejected the agreement, describing it as a new attempt at genocide and stating that it disregarded their will.


In yesterday’s statement, the Ministry of Interior said that all agreements concerning Shengal should be made with due regard to the will and demands of its population. However, the statement overlooked the fact that the members of the YBŞ-YJŞ are Yazidis who live in Shengal.

title: History repeats itself for the Turkish state
content:
The Justice and Development Party (AKP) government has recently been forming a number of alliances. While the AKP and the Nationalist Movement Party (MHP) defend these agreements, the opposition has criticised them. Various reasons have been put forward to explain these alliances. However, given that they involve the Middle East and its surrounding region, the first question that comes to mind is their connection to war. Military historians define war as the continuation of politics by other means. From this perspective, it is clear that these alliances risk drawing Turkey into the war in the Middle East.


In fact, the alliance with Saudi Arabia and Pakistan has already drawn Turkey into the war. According to incoming reports and assessments, Turkey has become involved in the ongoing war in Yemen. The Turkish state has sent its armed drones and the specialists who operate them to Saudi Arabia, from where attacks are being carried out against the Houthis in Yemen. As is known, the Houthis are supported by Iran. Turkey has therefore effectively entered into a war with Iran. On the one hand, it claims to oppose the war being waged by the United States and Israel against Iran, while on the other, it is waging war against the Houthis in Yemen.


Turkey is trying to play every possible side to suit its own interests. By participating in the war against the Houthis, it has placed itself in an anti-Iranian position. The Houthis are also enemies of Israel. Turkey has therefore effectively adopted a position favourable to Israel. Supporting Iran while acting against it, appearing to oppose Israel while pursuing policies that favour it! Turkey is pursuing a policy riddled with such contradictions. To use a familiar expression, it has recently been pressing every button. It is well known that those facing difficulties and crises resort to trying everything. Turkey believes that it can salvage something by acting this way, but in reality, it is gambling.


Neither Iran will forget Turkey's position nor will Israel begin to view Turkey favourably simply because it has attacked Yemen. Turkey's apparent opposition to the war against Iran is entirely connected to its hostility towards the Kurds. It opposes the war because it believes the Kurds could benefit from it. Indeed, when Devlet Bahçeli calls on the Kurdistan Free Life Party (PJAK) to lay down its arms, he is expressing hostility towards the Kurds rather than concern for Iran. Iran knows very well that, despite Turkey's approach, Ankara ultimately wants Iran to be weakened. Turkey believes that a weaker Iran would allow it to become more influential in the region.


By forming an alliance with Saudi Arabia and Pakistan, Turkey is not merely positioning itself against Iran. It is also antagonising India. India, like China, is emerging as a rising power. India also maintains strong relations with Israel. There is a considerable possibility that Turkey's new alliance will leave it worse off than before, losing what it already has while pursuing something more.


It is well known that Enver, Talat and Cemal Pasha brought a devastating defeat upon the Ottoman Empire by entering the war alongside Germany, which they believed to be a powerful ally. The AKP government may be calculating that closer relations with Saudi Arabia will bring in petrodollars and enable it to overcome its economic problems. Yet the attraction of these petrodollars could drag Turkey into all kinds of disastrous situations. The alliances being formed demonstrate precisely this danger.


Every political alliance causes concern among certain states and political forces. The alliance with Qatar, Pakistan and Indonesia will unsettle not only India and Iran but also other countries. Turkey's agreement with Libya on maritime jurisdiction has already caused concern in Europe, Greece, Israel and Egypt. Antagonising Europe in this way will cost Turkey dearly. Egypt is already deeply dissatisfied with Turkey's policy towards Libya, and this dissatisfaction will now increase. Turkey has already antagonised Israel, Southern Cyprus and Greece. It has thus created further opposition on another front.


If war is the continuation of politics by other means, then the alliances Turkey is forming indicate that it is moving towards war.

title: Türkoğlu: We want to speak with disabled women, not for them
content:
The Women's Council and Disability Commission of the Peoples' Equality and Democracy Party (DEM Party), together with Bismil Municipality's Women's Policies Directorate and Disability and Elderly Services Unit, held a meeting with women in Bismil district of Diyarbakır (Amed) under the slogan "Disabled Women Exist Too".


The meeting was attended by DEM Party Women's Council Spokesperson Halide Türkoğlu, Disability Commission Co-Spokesperson Hatice Betül Çelebi and numerous women.


‘Ableist ideology deepens discrimination’


Halide Türkoğlu said at the meeting that disabled women faced inequality and discrimination due to both the male-dominated mentality and ableist ideology. She said that disabled women were being denied the right to make decisions about their own lives and participate in decision-making and governance processes, stressing that their problems and demands must be addressed directly with them.


Türkoğlu said: "We want to speak with disabled women, not on behalf of disabled women," and added that disabled women must be involved in decision-making processes and have control over their own lives. She said that genuine equality could only be achieved by recognising differences, bringing experiences together and leaving no woman behind.


‘Services are a responsibility, not a favour’


Türkoğlu said that disabled women faced the risk of violence and abuse and criticised the lack of inclusive policies concerning disability. She pointed out that responsibility for caring for disabled people was placed on women and that the financial support provided for care was inadequate.


Türkoğlu said that the state and local authorities were responsible for addressing the difficulties disabled people faced in education, healthcare, employment, transport, social life and political participation. She stressed that disabled people must be recognised as individuals with rights.


Türkoğlu said that the DEM Party would continue developing policies together with disabled women and other disabled people and would also push Bismil Municipality to develop policies on disability. She called for stronger collective struggle and organised solidarity to ensure that disabled women could lead equal, free and accessible lives.

title: Fîlmê nû yê Behmen Qubadî li Festîvala Tokyoyê hate nîşandan
content:
Fîlma nû yê sînemagerê Kurd Behmen Qubadî yê bi navê "Trees Are Watching" li Festîvala Fîlman a Navneteweyî ya Tokyoyê hat nişandan. Piştî nîşandanê, derhêner Behmen Qubadî beşdarî rûniştineke pirs û bersivan bû û bersiva pirsên rexnegir û hezkirên sînemayê da.


Qubadî di rûniştinê de behsa sedemên têkçûna ekolojîk û bandora wê ya li ser derûniya mirovan kir.


Fîlma "Trees Are Watching" ku stêrka navdar a Hollywoodê Eva Green û lîstikvanê naskirî yê Tirkiyeyê Murat Yildirim tê de rolên sereke dilîzin, wekî fîlmekî "tirsa psîkolojîk" û wekî alegoriyeke ekolojîk balê dikişîne.


Bûyerên fîlmê Dar Dinêrin li bajarê Mêrdînê diqewimin. Çîroka nivîskarekê (Eva Green) û keça wê ya kerr vedibêje ku vegeriyane axa bav û kalan.


Li wir, ew rastî rûdanên seyr û bîranînên berê tên. Li herêmê, ji ber birîna daran xweza hatiye wêrankirin û tenê du dar wekî şahid mane.


Derhêner Behmen Qubadî di civînê de anî ziman ku dar û xweza ne tenê hûrgiliyên dîmenê ne lê di heman demê de ew şahidên zindî û bêdeng ên kiryar û trajediyên mirovahiyê ne jî.


Qubadî bal kişand ser metirsiya mezin a jinavbirina xwezayê û got ku sînemaya wî vê carê bi şêwazeke nû û bi hêmanên sosret peyameke tund dide kesên ku zererê didin jîngehê.


Piştgiriya Martin Scorsese ya ji bo projeyê


Yek ji xalên herî girîng ên ku di rûniştinê û medya navneteweyî de deng veda, piştgiriya derhênerê xwedî xelata Oscarê Martin Scorsese ya ji bo vî fîlmî bû.


Beşdariya Scorsese ya di projeyê de kelecaneke mezin di nav derdorên sînemayê yên cîhanî de çêkiriye û giraniya hunerî ya fîlmê Qubadî zêdetir kiriye.


Fîlmê ku beriya niha li Festîvala Fîlman a Navneteweyî ya Torontoyê (TIFF) cara yekem hatibû nîşandan, niha li Tokyoyê di beşa sereke de ji bo xelata herî mezin ketiye pêşbaziyê.


Festîvala Tokyoyê ya îsal dê heta 4ê Çiriya Paşîn a 2026an berdewam bike û sînemagerên herî navdar ên cîhanê bîne cem hev.


*Çavkanî: Rûdaw


(AY)

title: Žižek’in “İmkansız Özne: Kürtler, Rojava ve Günümüz Komünizmi” isimli kitabı okurla buluştu
content:
Dünyaca ünlü kamusal entelektüel Slavoj Žižek’in 18 Nisan 2021’de Kobanê Üniversitesi’nin açılışı kapsamında düzenlenen “Demokrasi Hâlâ Bir Seçenektir” başlıklı konferansının deşifresi ve Türkçe çevirisi, Luvi Yayınları tarafından “İmkansız Özne: Kürtler, Rojava ve Günümüz Komünizmi” adıyla kitaplaştırıldı.


Binevş Güney’in deşifre ederek Türkçeye çevirdiği, gazeteci Osman Damla’nın da editörlüğünü yaptığı çalışma, Türkçe ve İngilizce edisyonlarıyla yayımlandı. 


Luvi Yayınları, kitabın sunuş kısmında çalışma hakkında şu bilgilere yer verdi. 


‘Kobanê yalnızca direniş değil, geleceğin de inşa pratiği’


Konferansın Kobanê’de yapılması, metne yalnızca Žižek’in katılımının ötesinde bir anlam kazandırıyor. Elektrik ve internet kesintileri, bağlantı sorunları gibi teknik aksaklıklar, düşüncenin; savaşın, yıkımın ve maddi imkânsızlıkların tam ortasında üretildiğini gösteriyor. Kobanê Üniversitesi’nin varlığı, yalnızca akademik bir kurumun açılışı değil; yıkımın ardından hayatı yeniden kurma iradesinin ifadesi olarak öne çıkıyor.


Žižek, Kürt meselesine yaklaşımında Kürtleri jeopolitik rekabetlerin edilgen kurbanları olarak görmek yerine, sınırlı da olsa kendi alanlarını açtıkları koşullarda toplumsal yaşamı yeniden örgütleme iradelerine odaklanıyor.


Rojava deneyiminin önemini, yalnızca direnişte değil, “nasıl bir gelecek inşa edileceği” sorusunu somut bir gerçekliğe dönüştürme biçiminde görüyor. Direnmek ile kurmak arasındaki ayrım vurgulanırken; insanların nasıl yaşayacağı, farklı kimliklerin nasıl bir arada bulunacağı gibi sorular gündeme getiriliyor.


Seçim sistemleri, liberal demokrasi krizi


Kitabın temel izleklerinden biri de Demokratik Konfederalizm olurken, Žižek, liberal demokrasinin krizini de tartışıyor. Sorunu yalnızca seçim sistemlerine veya parlamentoların işleyişine indirgemeyen düşünür, mevcut siyasi kurumların toplumsal hoşnutsuzluğu dile getirmekte yetersiz kaldığını belirtiyor. Bu krizin yalnızca “demokrasisi gelişmemiş” ülkelerde değil, Batı’nın yerleşik demokrasilerinde de yaşandığını vurguluyor. Parlamenter sistemi eleştirirken doğrudan demokrasiyi de romantize etmekten kaçınıyor; halkı tek ve homojen bir özne olarak görmüyor. Siyasetin, hazır bir halk iradesinin temsilinden ziyade ortak bir siyasi ufkun aktif biçimde inşa edilmesini gerektirdiğini savunuyor.


‘İyi yabancılaşma’


Liderlik tartışmasında Žižek, insanlara ne yapmaları gerektiğini buyuran otoriter bir figür yerine, kendi imkânlarını gösterebilen ve ortak bir gelecek fikrini görünür kılabilen bir liderlik anlayışını öne çıkarıyor. Abdullah Öcalan’ın rolü de bu çerçevede, emretmekten çok umut yaratma ve siyasal imkânı temsil etme kapasitesi üzerinden ele alınıyor. “İyi yabancılaşma” kavramıyla, özgürlüğün her karara sürekli katılım anlamına gelmediğini; su, elektrik, sağlık gibi kamusal hizmetlerin güvenilir işlemesinin de bir özgürlük alanı yarattığını belirtiyor.


Oryantalizm eleştirisi


Žižek, Batı popüler kültüründe Ortadoğu’yu ve Rojava’yı sürekli bir çılgınlık ve kaotik coğrafya olarak sunan oryantalist kalıpları da eleştiriyor. Kürtlerin şiddet ve kuşatma ortamında rasyonel, katılımcı ve kurucu bir toplumsal aklı hayata geçirdiğini savunuyor. Kapitalizm ile demokrasi arasındaki zorunlu birlik düşüncesini sorgulayan Žižek, kapitalizmin otoriter siyasal biçimlerle birlikte işleyebildiğini belirterek “otoriter kapitalizm” kavramını tartışmanın merkezine yerleştiriyor.


Komünizm tartışması: Yerel ve özgün bir deneyim olarak Rojava


“Komünizm” tartışması ise geçmişin devletçi modellerine dönüş çağrısı değil; su, enerji, sağlık, salgınlar ve küresel ısınma gibi ortak sorunların piyasa ilişkilerine bırakılamayacağını, ulusal sınırları aşan bir koordinasyona ihtiyaç duyulduğunu vurguluyor. Rojava’nın yerel ve özgül bir deneyim olmasının ötesinde daha geniş bir siyasal öneri üretip üretemeyeceği sorusu da gündeme geliyor. Devletsizlik meselesi ve Demokratik Konfederalizm’in felsefi önemi bu bağlamda öne çıkıyor.


‘Özgürlükten sonra ne yapacağız?’


Metin romantik bir ütopya anlatısı değil; jeopolitik dengeler, geçici ittifaklar ve siyasal pragmatizm gibi gerçekliklerin de altını çiziyor. Kobanê deneyiminin asıl anlamı, salt bir direniş sembolü olmanın ötesinde “sonrasının” sorgulanışı olarak belirginleşiyor. Demokrasi, liderlik, kadın özgürleşmesi, ekoloji, kapitalizm, devletsizlik ve toplumsal örgütlenme gibi meseleler bugün de yakıcı güncelliğini koruyor.

author: Unknown
title: Groupe de parole MeToo inceste et pédocriminalité Lyon
content:
Dans chaque groupe, deux personnes du collectif s'occupent de la modération et du soutien émotionnel individuel (si besoin, si une personne s'extrait du groupe). Ces personnes sont elles-mêmes concernées et prennent part aux échanges.


Le groupe est consacré aux personnes victimes d'inceste et de pédocriminalité, non aux personnes autrices de ces actes, même si elles ont elles-mêmes été victimes.


Le groupe de parole commence par une explication du déroulé. Ensuite, un tour de parole sert à se présenter (prénom, pronoms), à dire comment on se sent en ce moment et le sujet que l'on veut amener. Après, ça reste libre et d'autres sujets de la thématique peuvent être abordés.


Une vigilance à la répartition de la parole est faite mais il n'est pas obligatoire de s'exprimer.


Groupe sur inscription car limité à 10 personnes. Anonymat garanti, possibilité de se présenter sous pseudo dès l'inscription.


En partageant nos expériences et nos sentiments par la parole et par l'écoute, nous cherchons avant tout à rompre notre isolement, et à trouver une aide et un réconfort moral mutuel. Nous souhaitons également susciter notre capacité à demander de l'aide, c'est pourquoi il est complémentaire et ne se substitue pas à une thérapie souvent nécessaire (bien que coûteuse...).


Prochain groupe de parole :


Lundi 9 novembre 2026 à 19h au Jusqu'ici.

author: webdev@democracynow.org (Democracy Now!)
title: Israeli Elections to Global Movements: Tariq Ali, Rashid Khalidi on New Book "The Neck and the Sword"
content:
We get analysis of the Israeli elections, the upcoming U.S. midterms, the pro-Palestine movement and more from Palestinian American scholar Rashid Khalidi and Pakistani British writer Tariq Ali. They are co-authors of the new book

The Neck and the Sword: Palestine’s Unfinished Struggle

. The book, an extended conversation between Khalidi and Ali over two years, offers an overview of Palestinian intellectual and political history, drawing its title from a famous phrase used by the renowned Palestinian writer Ghassan Kanafani to describe the futility of “peace talks” between occupier and occupied, saying it was akin to a “conversation between the sword and the neck.”


Kanafani was assassinated by Israel in 1972, “murdered simply because his words were too dangerous for Israel to tolerate,” says Khalidi.


Public opinion about Israel has grown increasingly negative in the United States and across much of the world in the wake of the genocide in Gaza, and it’s “not going to shift back,” says Khalidi. “People have seen something that cannot be unseen. They’ve seen genocide. They’ve seen slaughter. And Israel has no defense.”


“Even in countries with no history of a Palestine solidarity movement, suddenly the Palestine flag emerges,” says Ali. “Why? Because their governments are trying to stop dissent on this issue, so they are defying their governments.”

author: CNT Valladolid
title: Invertidxs y maleantes de ayer y de hoy
content:
EL lunes 19 de octubre, como parte de las jornadas de inauguración del nuevo local de CNT, tuvimos la mesa redonda

Invertidxs y maleantes de ayer y de hoy

.  El punto de partida de la mesa está en el que durante décadas hubo en España una ley de peligrosidad social que se aplicaba con dureza a quienes no se ajustaban a la idea de «la España viril y trabajadora»: homosexuales y disidencias de género, vagabundes, bohemios, extravagantes… Quisimos plantear el debate sobre si esa idea es cosa del pasado y si ha desaparecido de las instituciones y de las mentes. Y no lo preguntamos por preguntar, sino porque la experiencia de muches de nuestres afiliades muestra que si eso es cosa del pasado, segumos viviendo en el pasado.


La mesa estuvo acompañada de una exposición de fanzines y publicaciones sobre su tema, incluyendo varios números históricos del

Canijín

, la revista que desde 1992 lleva alzando la voz contra los maltratos y cerrazones institucionales hacia la infancia; el colectivo editor de esta última publicación no pudo estar presente en la mesa por circunstancias ajenas a su querer. A pesar de esa ausencia, fue inevitable recordar durante el debate las distintas campañas y movilizaciones que han denunciado que el centro Zambrana es una cárcel de niños. Distribuimos el espacio en círculos, dando espalda a la mesa que presidía la sala y poniéndonos todas en el mismo nivel, también las personas que tuvieron a bien dar pie al debate compartiendo sus reflexiones y conocimientos:


Miguel Fernández Turuelo, investigador y autor de 

I

nvertidos,


provincianos


y maleantes, la ley de peligrosidad social bajo el franquismo


Piro Subrat, autor de

Invertidos y rompepatrias: marxismo, anarquismo y desobediencia sexual

 (editorial Imperdible)


Lourdes, trabajadora social, participante en los colectivos de Valladolid

Marabunta

 y Radio Kuko


Miguel y Piro hicieron un recorrido por el ámbito al que han dedicado sus obras, pero sin que faltase la alusión al presente al que nos enfrentamos. En la exposición de Miguel jugaron un importante papel expedientes de la policía franquista contra personas de Valladolid,

rescatados por él de archivos oficiales

. Quedó constancia en ellos, en los documentos de la persecución policial de a quienes el poder definía entonces como «invertidos», de cómo el principal objetivo -dentro de la arbitrariedad- de ese acoso y de las medidas represivas aparejadas no era la presunta «curación» de conductas e identidades que rompian con la norma heterosexual o el trabajo asalariado; el principal objetivo era que no contagiasen la desobediencia contra esa norma, que no hicieran pública y visible la posibilidad de otras formas de vivir. La represión iba destinada al ocultamiento de esas existencias, y estaba mediada por un componente de clase o de complicidad tolerante de clase.


Se recordó en las preguntas el caso de los Patronatos tutelados por la Iglesia contra las mujeres desobedientes, instituciones protegidas, según confirmó Miguel, por lo opaco de los archivos que recogen su funcionamiento.


Piro nos compartió cómo reaccionaron partidos y organizaciones marxistas y anarquistas a la lucha de esxs invertidxs en los años setenta y ochenta por hacerse visibles y acabar con la marginación -las conocidas manifestaciones de liberación gay en ciudades como Barcelona u otras recientemente recuperadas en publlicaciones como

Lunática

 de Andrea Momoitio

; reacción de esas organizaciones que fue siempre a rebufo de las vistosas y combativas manifestaciones de las personas disidentes de género, y con niveles de sinceridad variables. El activismo queer fue lo bastante combativo y visible -y arriesgado- como para hacer ineludible el posicionamiento o la maduración -para el caso, el periódico CNT, que si en algún momento dio difusión a humores dudosos, como el de que es lo mismo orgullo gay y orgullo tuberculoso, paso en los ochenta y noventa a ser un potente altavoz de la disidencia de género.


Si

Invertidos y rompepatrias

 -del que se vendieron veinte ejemplares en la charla- recuerda cuantos melones abrió el activismo de disidencia sexual en los setenta y ochenta, la intervención de Piro y el debate posterior pusieron sobre la mesa que muchos de esos melones, si alguna vez se abrieron, se han vuelto a cerrar e incluso aspiran a petrificarse -vanamente-.  Inevitable recomendar la lectura de

Invertidos y rompepatrias

, tanto por conocimiento como para estimular la reflexión sobre la …

title: Rettungsdienst: Befragung zeigt massiv gestiegene Arbeitsbelastung – ver.di fordert kürzere Höchstarbeitszeit
content:
Dossier


„

Die heute vorgestellten

Ergebnisse der ver.di-Befragung „Gute Arbeit im Rettungsdienst“


 zeigen eine massive Zunahme der Arbeitsbelastung. „Die ohnehin hohe Belastung von Beschäftigten im Rettungsdienst hat sich seit Beginn der Corona-Krise nochmals deutlich verschärft“ (…) Die Befragung, an der sich rund 7.000 Beschäftigte beteiligt haben, belegt gravierende Probleme bei Arbeitszeiten, Arbeitsintensität, körperlichen sowie psychischen Belastungen. Fast alle Befragten berichten von Problemen, Beruf und Privatleben unter einen Hut zu bekommen. (…) Laut Befragung können 61 Prozent der Beschäftigten im Rettungsdienst ihre gesetzlich vorgeschriebenen Pausen (sehr) häufig nicht oder nicht vollständig nehmen. Von den über 55-Jährigen geht fast die Hälfte auch krank zur Arbeit. 84 Prozent gehen davon aus, unter den derzeitigen Bedingungen nicht bis zum Rentenalter durchzuhalten

…“

ver.di-Pressemitteilung vom 04.10.2022

 

 und dazu:


Keine Notfallreform ohne die Rettungskräfte: Die Sparpolitik hat Folgen, die auch in den Rettungsstellen ausgebadet werden


[Barmer-Krankenhausreport 2026] Drohende Überlastung der Notaufnahmen – Notfallreform benötigt mehr Verbindlichkeit – auch bei Personalbesetzung


Mehr Aufklärung soll Notfallreform retten


„

Barmer-Krankenhausreport zeigt Mängel der Reform. Die Belastung der Notaufnahmen kommt demnach auch von schlechter Patientensteuerung.


Die Notfallreform wurde zwar schon Mitte Oktober vom Bundestag verabschiedet und soll ab Januar in Kraft treten. Letzteres aber nur in Teilen: Die neuen integrierten Notfallzentren (INZ) und die digitale Zusammenlegung der Rufnummer 112 und 116 117 brauchen etliches an Vorbereitung, und das wird dauern. Zumal außerdem auch noch die Zustimmung der Länderkammer zwingend ist, die für den 20. November vorgesehen ist.


Obwohl einerseits alles schon recht fortgeschritten ist, reisst die Kritik an der Reform nicht ab. Bei den Skeptikern reihte sich jetzt auch die Krankenversicherung Barmer ein, die Argumente aus ihrem neuesten »Krankenhausreport« einbringt. Demnach ist unter anderem die Zahl der ambulanten Notfallbehandlungen in Deutschland innerhalb von zehn Jahren um 8,7 Prozent gestiegen. In jedem zehnten Krankenhaus hat sich die Anzahl dieser Behandlungen sogar mehr als verdoppelt.


Nun setzt auch Barmer-Chef Christoph Straub darauf, dass die telefonische Ersteinschätzung, digital unterstützt, zur Entlastung der Notaufnahmen (von fehlgesteuerten Patienten) sehr sinnvoll wäre, einschließlich einer inklusiven Terminvergabe. Allerdings: Verbindlich ist das im Rahmen der Reform nicht festgelegt worden. Patienten können zwar telefonieren, bevor sie selbst zur Rettungsstelle fahren, aber sie müssen es nicht. Ohne eine klare Vorgabe sei der Erfolg der Reform fraglich, meint der Kassenchef. Derartige Mängel im Gesetz gibt es einige. Offensichtlich hat auch Straub wenig Hoffnung, dass hier schnell nachgebessert wird – aber er stellt die Forderung trotzdem. (…) Grundsätzlicher fällt die Reform-Kritik von Stella Merendino aus, Sprecherin für Krankenhaus- und Notfallversorgung der Linke-Fraktion im Bundestag. Das Versagen der Versorgungsstrukturen dürfe nicht zum Fehlverhalten von Patienten umgedeutet werden: »Es bringt nichts, Patienten an eine Arztpraxis zu verweisen, die keine Termine hat. Und eine Notaufnahme kann nicht entlastet werden, wenn Patienten mangels freier Betten nicht auf Station verlegt werden. Notaufnahmen müssen endlich bedarfsgerecht finanziert und ausreichend Stellen geschaffen werden

.«“

Artikel von Ulrike Henning vom 27.10.2026 in ND online

content:
Wezareta Perwerdeyê ya Sûriyeyê biryar daye ku xweseriya Zanîngeha Rojava û Zanîngeha Kobanî betal bike û wan bi zanîngehên din ve girê bide.


Li Rojavayê çalakiyên ji bo zimanê kurdî didomin


16 Îlon 2026


Li gorî biryarên Desteya Xwendina Bilind a Sûriyeyê, hemû fakulte, kolêj û saziyên girêdayî van her du zanîngehan dê bikevin bin banê zanîngehên fermî yên dewleta Sûriyeyê.


Desteyê di vê çarçoveyê de du biryarên fermî belav kirin:


Biryara Bi Hejmar 69: Fakulteyên Zanîngeha Rojava bi Zanîngeha Firatê re dibin yek.


Biryara Bi Hejmar 71: Fakulteyên Zanîngeha Kobaniyê bi Zanîngeha Helebê re dibin yek.


Beriya niha biryar ew bû ku Zanîngeha Rojava û şaxa Zanîngeha Feratê ya li Hisîçayê bibin yek û navê zanîngehê bibe Zanîngeha Hisîçayê (Hesekê).


Li Rojavayê çalakiyên xwendekaran ên ji bo zimanê kurdî berdewam dikin


28 Îlon 2026


Lê bi vê biryara nû re Zanîngeha Rojava rasterast bi Zanîngeha Feratê ve hat girêdan ku navenda wê li parêzgeha Dêrezorê ye.


Hat diyarkirin ku ev gav di çarçoveya "yekkirina saziyên xwendina bilind ên dewletê" de û di bin çavdêriya Wezareta Xwendina Bilind a Sûriyeyê de hatiye avêtin.


Şaxên zanîngehên Tirkiyeyê jî tên girêdan

Wezareta Perwerdehiyê ya Sûriyeyê di 27ê Tebaxa 2026an de ji bo rewşa

zimanê Kurdî

Li gorî biryara navborî, xwendekar dê di hefteyê de 3 saetan bi Kurdî bixwînin. Ev biryar derfetê dide ku zimanê kurdî wekî zimanekî niştimanî li dibistanên fermî û taybet ên li deverên Kurdan bibe beşeke bernameya dersan.


Di çarçoveya ve biryarê de, xwendekar dikarin dersên zanistên civakî yên weke dîrok, cografya û felsefe bi erebî an jî kurdî bixwînin. Lêbelê dersên zanistî yên wekî bîrkarî/matematîk, fîzîk, kîmya û biyolojî dê bi zimanê Erebî bin.

author: Julius Gavroche
title: Open letter from the prisoners of October 17, 2026
content:
from

lundimatin

 #539, 28/10/2026


For weeks, the repression against the ongoing movement has intensified. In the aftermath of October 17th, Justice Minister Gérald Darmanin, flouting all separation of powers, ordered the judiciary to hand down the harshest possible sentences to arrested and prosecuted protesters. Many of them are now in prison. Some of the prisoners from October 17th managed to send us this open letter, which serves as both a confession and a call to continue the struggle.


We are writing to you from a prison in the Île-de-France region, the name of which we will not disclose, in order to protect ourselves from the risk of reprisals and, above all, from the judicial and prison authorities.


We are students, high school students, teachers, the unemployed, restaurant owners, small business owners, delivery drivers, gangsters, from every neighborhood and every city in the region: Créteil, Bobigny, Belleville, Montreuil, Bagnolet, Noisy-le-Sec, Seine-et-Marne, Seine-Saint-Denis, and Paris. We are of all ages, all skin colors, and all nationalities; we are Arabs, Whites, Blacks, Roma, Turks, Germans, and French.


We have been accused, rightly or wrongly, of looting, of committing violence against law enforcement, of assembling illegally, of concealing our faces. Ultimately, our situations and the accusations against us are irrelevant, because the courts have bowed to Macron’s orders and sent us all to jail. Even though each prison is all the more the unsanitary and overcrowded as a consequence, next, as long as they fit!


This reminds us how what we call Justice is in no way an independent institution, especially when the State and the bourgeoisie feel threatened.


In prison, we have the privilege of being able to numb ourselves all day in front of BFMTV, CNEWS, and the channels of the regime’s other watchdogs. The ideological offensive on these TV stations supports the repressive policies of those who think they govern us. This offensive is commensurate with the fear that has gripped them since last Saturday. It was a true revolutionary warning. Everywhere, they are now trying to make us regret it, to break us, to dissuade us from returning to future Saturdays. They are silencing the support, the pride, and all those little words we have read and heard in recent days, such as “I wish I had been there” or “you made them pay.” They want us to believe that our violence is comparable to the thousands of lives crushed by capitalism every day.


If the media mouthpieces of the powerful can’t define the “typical profile” of the insurgents, it’s because we are the people who have risen up. The people who suffer and who are now fighting to end their suffering. They try to divide us, to categorise us as protesters, vandals, looters, thugs, or far-left extremists. But they haven’t understood that we are all of these things at once! We are united by our anger and our desire for revolution. A revolution that gives us back the possibility to breathe and hope, to share and to work together. To finally allow us to decide how we want to live. A revolution that puts an end to this humiliation that oozes luxury.


This social rage drove us into the streets last Saturday; it’s the same rage that simmers in the corridors and cells of the prison where we are locked up. This rage also explains the support and respect other prisoners have for the October 17th uprising. Nor will we accept being separated into political prisoners and common criminals, because we were all driven into the prisons of this regime by this unjust world.


For all these reasons, we tell you emphatically, we regret nothing! Nothing except not having adequately protected ourselves against the repressive violence that was about to be unleashed upon us.


We therefore call on all those who are outside to continue standing up to the State and to return to the streets every Saturday, until the fall of Macron and his entire corrupt world.


We call on you to organise yourselves between each Saturday, to meet with one another, to prepare yourselves, and to take control of your lives now.


We call on you to support all prisoners like us and all uprisings, both here and elsewhere.


We urge you to avoid small shops as much as possible, to remind everyone that our people’s justice only targets the biggest, the richest, the multinationals—those who have been robbing, crushing, and despising us for far too long.


We urge you to reject any division among …

title: Tarifrunde Metall und Elektro 2026 für  5% mehr Geld, Jobsicherung und Gewinnbeteiligung für (Rüstungs)Boom-Unternehmen
content:
Dossier


„

Die Tarifbewegung in der Metall- und Elektroindustrie ist gestartet. Die Tarifkommissionen der IG Metall haben sich zusammengeschaltet, um die Lage und erste Forderungen zu diskutieren. Die Lage ist extrem differenziert: Viele Betriebe stecken in der Krise, andere wiederum machen gute Gewinne. Ab Oktober verhandelt die IG Metall wieder über höhere Entgelte für 3,8 Millionen Beschäftigte der Metall- und Elektroindustrie. Zum Auftakt zur Tarifbewegung haben die Tarifkommissionen der IG Metall am Mittwoch die Kündigung der derzeitigen Entgelttarifverträge in der Metall- und Elektroindustrie beschlossen – die Voraussetzung für Tarifverhandlungen – und die Diskussion über die wirtschaftliche Lage und mögliche Forderungen für die Tarifverhandlungen gestartet

…“

Meldung der IG Metall vom 25. Juni 2026

 

, die

Aktionsseite


 und erste Beiträge dazu:


Metalltarifrunde: Südwestmetall („Fairer Vorschlag“) bietet 1,3 Prozent ab Juli 2028 – IG Metall („deutlich unter der Inflation“) kündigt Warnstreiks nach dem 31.10. an


Tarifrunde der Metaller: Arbeitgeber bieten 1,3 Prozent mehr – IG Metall reagiert mit Streiks


„

Die Tarifrunde der Metall- und Elektroindustrie spitzt sich mit ersten Warnstreiks nächste Woche zu. Südwestmetall legt beim zweiten Treffen ein differenziertes Angebot vor.


Eine nüchterne Arbeitsatmosphäre dominiert das zweite Treffen in der Tarifrunde der Metall- und Elektroindustrie in Kornwestheim – jetzt geht es darum, wie man sich in den Verhandlungen annähern kann. Doch weitere emotionale Auftritte werden nicht lange auf sich warten lassen: Die IG Metall plant nach dem Ende der Friedenspflicht am 31. Oktober für die nächste Woche Warnstreiks in Baden-Württemberg.


„Fairer und sehr fein austarierter Vorschlag“


Mit den ohnehin vorgesehenen Aktionen reagiert die Gewerkschaft nun auch auf das Angebot des Arbeitgeberverbandes. Südwestmetall hat jetzt einen, wie betont wird, „fairen und sehr fein austarierten Vorschlag, der den Interessen beider Seiten gerecht wird“ vorgelegt. Es beinhaltet eine Einmalzahlung in Höhe von einem Prozent des durchschnittlichen tariflichen Jahresbruttoentgelts im Juli 2027. Dies entspricht 700 Euro. Die Zahlung kann von Firmen, die nicht wenigstens eine Nettoumsatzrendite von 2,3 Prozent erwirtschaften, verschoben oder gestrichen werden

…“

Artikel von Matthias Schiermeyer vom 27.10.2026 in stuttgarter-zeitung.de

 


„Angebot“ der Arbeitgeber deutlich unter der Inflation


„

In der zweiten Runde der Tarifverhandlungen für die Metall- und Elektroindustrie legen die Arbeitgeber ein „Angebot“ vor, das einen Reallohnverlust bedeuten würde: eine Einmalzahlung im Juli 2027, aber nur wenn der Betrieb gut läuft. Und erst ab Juli 2028 dauerhaft 1,3 Prozent mehr Geld.


Die zweite Runde der Tarifverhandlungen für die Metall- und Elektroindustrie 2026 ist am Dienstag in sechs regionalen Verhandlungen angelaufen. Erstmals in dieser Tarifbewegung legten die Arbeitgeber nun ein Angebot vor: Die Arbeitgeber bieten eine einmalige Zahlung in Höhe von 1 Prozent des durchschnittlichen, tariflichen Jahresbrutto in der Branche zum Juli 2027, eine tabellenwirksame Entgelterhöhung von lediglich 1,3 Prozent ab Juli 2028 sowie eine Laufzeit bis Ende 2028 an. Gleichzeitig verbinden sie ihr Angebot mit weiteren Forderungen nach einer Ausweitung der Differenzierung und Debatten über Krankenstände. Zur Kostensenkung wollen sie ein betriebliches Instrument zur Sicherung von Investitionen, Innovationen, Standorten und Beschäftigung einführen.  (…)Noch diese Woche, am 31. Oktober, läuft die Friedenspflicht aus. Die IG Metall kündigt an, mit Ablauf der Friedenspflicht durch Warnstreiks den Druck in den Betrieben zu erhöhen, damit die Arbeitgeber ein verhandlungsfähiges Angebot vorlegen, das den Forderungen gerecht wird

…“

Meldung der IG Metall vom 27. Oktober 2026
