title: Rising from the Ashes
content:
from the

CrimethInc.

 collective, 27/10/2026


The Yellow Vests Return as France Burns


Over the past month, France has erupted in a nationwide rebellion that has shaken the ruling order to its core. As politicians of all stripes focus on polishing their brand image for the next

presidential election

 in May 2027, high school students have

organized

 on a grassroots level. Through occupations, blockades, and street protests, they have taken a stand against both the deplorable conditions of their schools today and the

menacing future

 that looms ahead of them. They took France and the entire world by surprise with their determined mass resistance and their courage in confronting the police forces sent to repress them.


After weeks of daily actions and nationwide demonstrations, leading to an unprecedented wave of arrests targeting rebellious youth, the Macron government was reaching a political impasse. It desperately tried to buy time by opening dialogue with some student organizations, in hopes of blunting the force of the movement until the upcoming school break slowed its momentum.


However, the authorities had not anticipated several developments. First, the students multiplied their force by joining the national call to take the streets on Saturday, October 17 to reignite the

Yellow Vests movement

, the popular mobilization against high gas prices and government austerity policies that emerged in 2018. Second, anger over the intense police violence of the previous weeks drew even more people in the streets. Third and most dramatically, the day’s protests snowballed into an insurrectionary situation that

surpassed

 what we experienced eight years ago during the height of the Yellow Vests struggle.


This new wave of collective rage that swept over the cities of France last week has plunged the current government into a deeper crisis. Politicians scrambled to capitalize on the upheavals, while authorities responded by implementing more authoritarian policies on a national scale. In the following article, we describe how the dramatic events around October 17 unfolded, analyzing their significance and reflecting on what is at stake.


Burning barricades blocking a narrow street in the historical part of downtown Bordeaux (October 17.)


Glowing Embers of Discontent


In 2018, the Yellow Vest movement emerged into the French political landscape seemingly out of nowhere. This grassroots wave of protests formed a reaction against rising gas prices and worsening living conditions among the country’s lower and middle classes. After decades of economic crises, inflation, and harsh neoliberal austerity policies, a portion of the population was feeling isolated, disenfranchised, and abandoned. The capitalist dream of ease and opulence that successive governments had promoted was turning into a living nightmare for a growing number of individuals. The politically diverse movement, named after the fluorescent emergency vests drivers were required to carry in their vehicles, made visible the ongoing economic emergency that gripped more and more people across France.


Due to its open-ended form, the Yellow Vests initially attracted populists from the left and the right and autonomous participants with a range of grievances against the ruling order. From the beginning, an internal struggle unfolded within the movement as radical participants

confronted

 far-right and fascist factions and attempted to prevent cooptation by reactionaries. Over time, the Yellow Vest movement gradually shifted to embrace more anti-capitalist and anti-state perspectives.


Since the initial wave of Yellow Vest protests died down in 2020, the economic situation in France has worsened. The gap between rich and poor has continued to

widen

, while the Macron government accelerated its dismantling of public services. International conflicts from Ukraine to Iran have further impacted the French economy, worsening inflation and driving up prices on essential goods, energy, and gas.


It is no surprise that people facing such economic pressure would take to the streets to express their discontent. And what better way to threaten the current ruling order than to bring the Yellow Vest movement back from the dead?

title: unter_bau: Alternative Hochschulgewerkschaft an der Goethe-Universität Frankfurt
content:
Dossier


„

Heute geht die Gewerkschaftsinitiative unter_bau erstmals an die Öffentlichkeit. Dabei handelt es sich um einen Zusammenschluss rund 50 Hochschulangehöriger aus unterschiedlichen Statusgruppen, die seit knapp einem Jahr den Aufbau einer alternativen Gewerkschaft für den Frankfurter Hochschulbereich vorbereiten. Die angestrebte Gewerkschaft soll alle Angestellten- und Statusgruppen der Universität umfassen und nach partizipatorischen und föderalen Prinzipien funktionieren. Insbesondere will die Initiative die Organisation nicht auf die klassischen Gewerkschaftsfelder beschränken, sondern darüber hinaus (hochschul-)politisch auf die allgemeine Verfasstheit der Universität Einfluss nehmen. Als perspektivisches Ziel benennt die Initiative eine grundlegende Transformation der Hochschule in eine basisdemokratische Selbstverwaltung

…“

Pressemitteilung vom 20. April 2016 auf der Homepage der Initiative unter_bau


 und alle Informationen bis zur nun vollendeten Gründung und den Aktivitäten danach:


Goethe-Universität streicht Hunderte Hilfskraftstellen – unter_bau kündigt Widerstand gegen Kürzungspolitik an


„

An der Goethe-Universität Frankfurt droht ein massiver Stellenabbau unter studentischen Beschäftigten. Im Rahmen des sogenannten „Stellenumbaus“ sollten die bisherigen Hilfskraftstellen in den Bibliotheken, im Hochschulrechenzentrum (HRZ) und in der Verwaltung ursprünglich in reguläre, tariflich bezahlte Beschäftigungsverhältnisse überführt werden. Doch statt besserer Arbeitsbedingungen und tariflicher Absicherung droht nun die Streichung von rund 300 bis 400 Stellen. Ab Januar 2027 sollen in den Bibliotheken keine neuen Hilfskraftverträge mehr vergeben werden. Auch in der zentralen Verwaltung sollen künftig kaum Studierende mehr beschäftigt werden. Für die Hochschulgewerkschaft unter_bau ist klar: Die Beschäftigten dürfen nicht die Rechnung für die Kürzungspolitik der Landesregierung und des Universitätspräsidiums bezahlen.


„Die Universitätsleitung verspricht tarifliche Beschäftigung und streicht gleichzeitig Hunderte Stellen. Das ist ein Schlag ins Gesicht der Kolleg_innen, die seit Jahren die Bibliotheken, die Verwaltung und andere zentrale Einrichtungen am Laufen halten. Wir werden nicht zulassen, dass die versprochene Überführung in den Tarifvertrag als Vorwand für einen massiven Personalabbau genutzt wird. Wir werden gemeinsam mit unseren Mitgliedern alle uns zur Verfügung stehenden gewerkschaftlichen Aktionsmittel ausschöpfen, um diese Stellenstreichungen zu verhindern“, erklärt Daniel Katzenmaier, Pressesprecher der Hochschulgewerkschaft unter_bau.


Der geplante Abbau trifft nicht nur die unmittelbar betroffenen Hilfskräfte. Die Aufgaben in Bibliotheken, Verwaltung und Hochschulrechenzentrum verschwinden nicht einfach mit den gestrichenen Stellen. Vielmehr drohen eine massive Arbeitsverdichtung für die verbleibenden Beschäftigten und weitere Einschränkungen für Studierende.


„Seit Jahren wird an den Hochschulen gespart, während die Arbeitsbelastung steigt. Jetzt sollen ausgerechnet diejenigen ihren Arbeitsplatz verlieren, die ohnehin häufig unter prekären Bedingungen beschäftigt sind. Statt die Arbeitsverhältnisse endlich tariflich abzusichern, will die Universität einen Großteil der Stellen beseitigen. Wir brauchen mehr Personal, bessere Arbeitsbedingungen und eine vollständige Überführung der betroffenen Beschäftigten in den Tarifvertrag – keine Entlassungswelle!“, erklärt Katzenmaier abschließend.


Die Hochschulgewerkschaft unter_bau fordert einen sofortigen Stopp des geplanten Stellenabbaus. Die ursprünglich angekündigte Überführung in tariflich abgesicherte Beschäftigungsverhältnisse muss umgesetzt werden, ohne dass dabei Arbeitsplätze verloren gehen. Die Gewerkschaft unterstützt die heutige Hilfskräftevollversammlung des Hilfskräfterates um 14 Uhr am Campus Westend und wird sich in den kommenden Wochen an den Protestaktionen der Hilfskräfte beteiligen

author: Leonard Wanyama
title: Misuse of the Tax Commissioner General’s Powers is Hurting Kenyans
content:
As I sat there listening to a friend who owns a small business, I wondered whether there are different tax regimes in Kenya depending on what form of commercial activity one undertakes.


Despite working in tax advocacy for the past nine years, this was the first time I was coming across a VAT Withholding Tax (henceforth referred to as VWT). 


Indeed, this is something different from what is generally understood as Value-Added Tax (VAT) and the fact that many small businesses are finding themselves being ambushed by it goes to show how much Kenyan taxation requires a lot more democracy.


VAT is the standard rate of 16 per cent tax that is charged on the consumption of goods and services supplied or purchased. Businesses charge it as part of the cost, then remit the difference between the price and the tariff to the government. Every good or service, from fuel to bread, usually has a 16 per cent cost added to it.


The VWT, on the other hand, is a mechanism to collect VAT at the point of supplies provision. This means that for selected businesses, there is a tax within a tax for every purchase they make. In this case, the Kenya Revenue Authority (KRA) appoints selected businesses or individual entities as their agents to deduct this tax at a fixed rate of 2 per cent on the advance payment to their suppliers.


Essentially, once the supplier gives you the price of a good or service inclusive of 16 per cent VAT, if you are appointed a KRA agent to implement VWT, you would hold on to 2 per cent of that payment for remittance to the tax collector. 


This must then be reconciled through the electronic Tax Invoice Management System (eTIMS). The system has unfortunately been experiencing frequent partial or full downtimes in recent months, preventing transaction matching between sellers and buyers for accurate KRA determination of tax demands or claims.

 


My friend had no idea how his business had been selected to become a KRA implementing agent. Moreover, even when he could not reconcile the taxes using eTIMS due to frequent system downtimes, his business was still automatically liable for penalties due to noncompliance. 


This happened because even as the eTIMS system was partially shut down, other functioning segments of the tax software platform continued accumulating taxes from other regular purchases he transacted, and recorded them onto the eTIMS portal as he carried out other business. 


This revelation by my friend was to me mind-boggling because I could immediately see the tense and awkward haggling that could harm a business relationship given the current difficult commercial environment. 


Such are the tribulations small businesses are facing on top of tax contestations around cash flow mismatches, informal supply chain problems, eTIMS-related costs due to system glitches, invoicing evidence rules, and digital literacy demands for revenue compliance.


Looking at

Section 42 of the Tax Procedures Act of 2015

, it emerges that the application of the law in this instance is vague, thereby conferring unfettered discretionary powers on public officials under the authority of the KRA Commissioner General.


There are no objective criteria as to how VWT agents are determined and these appointments then come across as arbitrary decisions that not only confuse taxpayers but also leave them paralytically unable to predict the legal consequences of their actions.


It came as no surprise a few weeks later that traders had become angry over another tax that consolidated cargo clearance charges. Though separate from the VWT issue, the manner of application of this tax is annoyingly similar.


This has resulted in

protests by traders

 that have forced President William Ruto to order a

review of customs costs

 and differentiated implementation in the handling of ordinary consignments compared to high-value cargo. 


This means that containers carrying commercial merchandise, everyday consumer items, bulk or general cargo of low value will continue to pay KSh 2 million for clearance. 


Meanwhile, shipments of luxury goods, specialized electronics, high-end motor vehicles, and industrial machinery will undergo further assessment based on the value of the goods in the container, which is likely to raise costs.


The two examples above are a stark reminder of Professor Migai Akech’s treatise on the

undemocratic application of administrative law

 in taxation, where power is abused and not practised based on the …

title: 29 de octubre y 4 de noviembre. La Sección Sindical de CNT en la UNED instalará mesas informativas sobre la Huelga General del 11N
content:
Desde la Sección Sindical en la UNED informamos de que instalaremos puestos para informar a los trabajadores y las trabajadoras sobre la huelga general del 11 de noviembre. Los próximos días

29 de octubre, en el Campus Norte (Calle Juan del Rosal)

4 de noviembre en el Campus de Paseo de la Senda del Rey

mesas informativas desde las 12:00

Con el problema de fondo de la vivienda, el precio de los alquileres y el poder adquirido por el rentismo y los intereses especuladores, desde CNT-UNED hacemos

author: Thiago Domenici
title: Em fuga, Flávio Bolsonaro embarcou da Argentina rumo ao Equador e ainda não chegou aos EUA
content:
Durante a maior parte da terça-feira (27), circulou na imprensa brasileira, argentina e dos Estados Unidos a versão de que o senador Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ), derrotado por Lula no segundo turno no domingo (25), já estaria no ar, a caminho dos Estados Unidos. O registro oficial divulgado pelo governo argentino na madrugada desta quarta-feira (28) desmente essa cronologia.

Segundo a Dirección Nacional de Migraciones, o senador só cruzou a fronteira às 22h50 de terça, e o jato que o levou decolou com destino declarado para Guayaquil, no Equador. Ainda não se sabe qual é o destino final a partir de Guayaquil

 – mas veículos têm noticiado que Flávio irá para os Estados Unidos, onde também vive o seu irmão, Eduardo.


A Direção Nacional de Migrações informa que, às 22h50 do dia 27/10, ingressaram pelo posto de fronteira da Ponte Internacional Tancredo Neves, na província de Misiones, Flavio Nantes Bolsonaro e família


Em comunicado publicado no X, a Migraciones, que na terça de manhã havia afirmado não ter registro de entrada de Flávio na Argentina, divulgou a informação às 2h01. Segundo o órgão, o senador entrou pela Ponte Internacional Tancredo Neves, que liga Foz do Iguaçu (PR) a Puerto Iguazú, na província de Misiones. Ele estava com a mulher, Fernanda Antunes Figueira Bolsonaro, e as duas filhas do casal, o que

confirma

 a informação divulgada pela

Agência Pública

 sobre a ausência das filhas na escola em Brasília. 


De acordo com a publicação, todos apresentaram documentação de viagem válida, sem impedimentos legais, e a entrada na Argentina foi registrada sem incidentes. Quarenta minutos depois, às 23h30, o grupo embarcou em um voo privado da empresa Baires Fly S.A. com destino a Guayaquil, conforme o plano de voo.

 Sites que monitoram voos registraram a aeronave sobrevoando a cidade equatoriana por volta das 5h40. Depois, por volta das 6h20, a aeronave decolou novamente com direção ao Norte – aparentemente indo para os Estados Unidos. 


A saída de Flávio ocorre depois que o ministro Alexandre de Moraes, do Supremo Tribunal Federal, determinou que Flávio entregasse seus passaportes à Polícia Federal e que ele fosse incluído no Sonar, o sistema de monitoramento migratório. O senador não cumpriu o prazo, que se encerrou às 11h da terça-feira, e a PF cancelou os passaportes emitidos em seu nome. Ele é investigado no STF por suspeitas de lavagem de dinheiro e evasão de divisas.


Entre os países do Mercosul, a carteira de identidade é aceita como documento de viagem, o que explica a menção da Migraciones a “documentação hábil”. Ainda não está esclarecido como o senador atravessou a Ponte Tancredo Neves sem ser detido do lado brasileiro, já que constava no Sonar.


A aeronave pertence à empresa usada por Javier Milei, presidente argentino, para ir aos EUA após sua eleição. Segundo a imprensa argentina, a empresa teria vínculos com o empresário Maurício Macri, e à época, em 2023, o custo do voo de Milei foi alvo de questionamento. A viagem teria custado entre R$ 1,2 milhão e R$ 1,35 milhão. Milei, até o momento, não reconheceu a vitória de Lula nas eleições. 


Imagens do jato da empresa Baires Fly onde Flávio e família teriam embarcado rumo aos EUA


Notícia de que já estava nos EUA não se confirmou


O horário oficial contradiz, por ora, o que vinha sendo noticiado pela imprensa, segundo pessoas próximas à família e o entorno político de Flávio, de que o senador teria partido para os Estados Unidos e que o avião já estaria em rota. O portal argentino Infobae relatou que ele teria cruzado a fronteira com a carteira de identidade rumo a Puerto Iguazú, de onde seguiria em voo privado para os EUA.


Pela cronologia oficial, quando essas versões circulavam, Flávio ainda não havia passado por nenhum posto de controle migratório argentino. O avião também não tinha decolado. O jato é um Gulfstream G400 de matrícula argentina LV-JQW. 


Aeronave onde estaria Flávio decolou de Gayaquil por volta de 6h20 rumo aos Estados Unidos


Segundo o jornal Clarín, a decolagem foi retida durante a tarde devido a pendências na documentação de um dos passageiros. O portal Misiones Online havia noticiado que a aeronave estava no aeroporto de Puerto Iguazú e que partiria para Guayaquil.


As negativas oficiais da terça-feira (27), que pareciam contradizer as notícias sobre a fuga, eram compatíveis com o registro divulgado depois. Pela manhã, a Migraciones disse que não tinha registro do ingresso do senador. Mais tarde, o porta-voz do …

author: CNT Santander
title: Vivienda digna y asequible para todas las personas
content:
El acceso a la vivienda no es un lujo, es un derecho innegociable protegido por la Constitución y que ha de prevalecer sobre cualquier negocio privado. A las instituciones se les olvida rápido.


En muchas comunidades autónomas, incluida la nuestra, no protegen a la población y venden su futuro a fondos buitre. No declaran zonas tensionadas, no intervienen el mercado ni regulan los precios. No les importa lo que supone cada día para todas las personas que vivimos en Cantabria.


Cada día, la clase trabajadora sufre por la actual situación del acceso a vivienda, con la especulación por las nubes, el aumento de los precios de alquileres e hipotecas totalmente abusivos e inasumibles, y el problema de los arrendamientos temporales que provocan más desconcierto e incertidumbre por un futuro digno.


Según el INE, el salario más frecuente en Cantabria es de 1.495 euros netos al mes. Dependiendo del sector productivo, ese salario varia considerablemente, en aumento si se trata de la industria o incluso en algunos casos, como en el sector servicios, puede incluso bajar. Ya que el salario modal en hostelería en Cantabria roza los 16.000€/18000€ brutos al año, traducido en unos 1.142€/1.285,7€ brutos al mes, sin retenciones.


La realidad nos muestra también que el 12,4% de las mujeres cántabras y el 6,3% de los hombres están por debajo del SMI. Por lo que, si con el sueldo más frecuente en la comunidad ya se hace difícil acceder a la vivienda tal y como están los precios de alquileres e hipotecas, en su mayoría variables y pendientes del Euribor, ¿qué sucede cuando la clase trabajadora no llega ni al SMI sin contar las retenciones?


La respuesta es trágica.


No se puede acceder a la vivienda ni obtener las necesidades más básicas al mismo tiempo, si vives sola y sin ayuda familiar.


Recordemos que el precio del alquiler medio en ciudades como Santander ronda los 889€ por un piso de dos habitaciones en zonas residenciales normales, mientras que en Torrelavega cuesta unos 750€, hay muy pocas ofertas por debajo de ese precio.


En zonas como Noja o Laredo, mucho más turísticas y de segundas viviendas, son 1.073€ por un piso de las mismas características.


En algunos pueblos más pequeños como Polanco, en zonas residenciales a las afueras de Torrelavega y de las industrias, ya se ha subido tanto que salta de los 1.000, a los 1.200€ al mes en Cartes, 1.000€ en Renedo de Piélagos y en la costera Suances incluso llega a los 2.000€.


Dicen los economistas que cuando una persona tiene que destinar

más del 30%

 de su salario al alquiler, la economía familiar se derrumba. En Cantabria

, la clase trabajadora destina incluso más del 50%.


¿Qué sucede entonces con la economía de las personas cántabras?


Nos ponemos en el supuesto:


Si una persona gana 1.495€ y paga unos 889€ de alquiler, le quedan 600€ para todo lo demás: comida, higiene, facturas de servicios, transporte público, coche y gasolina, seguros, estacionamiento regulado. Todo ello contando que no tenga que preocuparse de más personas, que no tenga hijas e hijos a su cargo.


Respuesta: Algunas personas conseguirán llegar a fin de mes sin poder ahorrar, otras lo harán en números rojos.


¿Qué sucede cuando solo entra un salario en casa, no hay más prestaciones y son familias con hijas e hijos?


¿Qué sucede cuando se es madre divorciada, soltera, con hijos? ¿Padre soltero con hijas e hijos?


¿Y cuándo se cobra menos del SMI y es una persona que vive sola y no tienes más ayudas?


Llega la imposibilidad de vivir de un salario, de acceder a un hogar en condiciones salubres y dignas, de pagar las facturas pendientes de servicios e incluso de hacer frente a las necesidades más básicas como la comida y la higiene, ya que la inflación ha encarecido los precios de la cesta de la compra de tal manera que apenas se pueden pagar los productos del día a día.


Y llegará el invierno y muchas familias tendrán que decidir entre pagar el alquiler, comer y encender la calefacción.


El 11 de noviembre saldremos a la calle para reivindicar nuestro derecho a una vivienda digna, junto con un incremento salarial para poder vivir sin dificultades.


¡Porque la situación es insostenible!


Porque mientras los negocios privados inmobiliarios, las rentistas y los fondos buitre se hacen ricas a costa de la clase trabajadora y productiva, la realidad de muchas personas en Cantabria, ya no es solo que sean expulsadas de sus barrios por la gentrificación, que no puedan habitar y ocupar …

title: Hozat: Turkish authorities increase pressure on opposition to prevent broader support to process
content:
KCK Executive Council Co-Chair Besê Hozat spoke to Medya Haber TV about the current stage of the process, the women’s freedom struggle, practices in prisons, and regional developments.


Part one of the interview can be read

here

. 


The government’s operations against municipalities continue. New trustees are being appointed. Most recently, a trustee was appointed to Halk TV. Many digital media accounts have been shut down, and some are being blocked. Attacks on newspapers are rampant, and arrests are on the rise. Overall, there are intense attacks directed at the press and media workers. It is as if the government is carrying out purges against those who do not align with it. What do these attacks signify at a time when the democratization of the republic is being debated?


That’s a good question. What is this state doing to prevent the process from becoming a societal movement? It is implementing a policy of oppression and hostility in the prisons. There has been no change in Rêber Apo’s [President Abdullah Öcalan] conditions to date. Isolation continues. While Rêber Apo took the initiative in this process, drove it forward, and brought it to this level, there is still no change in his conditions. Journalists were supposed to visit him, but it was prevented. The committee was supposed to go, convene, and work; that did not happen. His status was supposed to be formalized, but it didn’t happen. He was supposed to freely lead this process. There were supposed to be advisors, academics, and politicians visiting him. None of the things our leader demanded have happened. It’s a similar situation in prisons.


In order to prevent this process from gaining broader societal support in Turkey, the Turkish authorities are intensifying pressure on the opposition. They are attacking the press. There are particularly intense attacks on the opposition media. Dozens of journalists are being detained, arrested, and threatened. Yesterday, they held a very impressive march. I believe journalists marched in ten cities to voice their protests. I salute them. It’s truly very meaningful. These efforts need to develop further. There is intense pressure on the opposition press, on the opposition itself, and on workers. There is extremely intense pressure on all segments of society in Turkey that criticize this government or express dissatisfaction with it. This also prevents the process from becoming a social movement on the Turkish front. To prevent this process from becoming a societal movement – to prevent society from taking ownership of it – they are doing nearly everything in their power.


Like I said, there is currently intense pressure and oppression on the Turkish front as well. There is a policy of intense pressure targeting all opposition democratic, opposition liberal, and opposition groups. They do not want the truth to reach the public. That is why they’ve intensified the pressure on the opposition media so much. They don’t want the public to know the truth. Especially now that this funding crisis has come to the fore. The opposition media covered it extensively. A fierce wave of attacks has been launched. They also don’t want the government to be criticized for this process or for the truth to come to light.


And as a result of this intense attack, the process is not gaining traction among the Turkish public. It is blocking progress, and concerns regarding the state and the government on this issue are deepening even further. What kind of process is this? Can this process develop without democratization? That is the fundamental principle and philosophy of this process. It is the democratization of Turkey. Turkey cannot resolve the Kurdish issue without democratization. And Turkey cannot democratize without resolving the Kurdish issue. Turkey must embark on a democratic process. In this sense, the current government must take democratic steps. It must pursue very serious democratization in every legal, political, and social sphere. The opposite is happening. Increasing authoritarianism and an even more intense policy of repression and oppression are running rampant across all segments of society that oppose the government. Anti-democratic policies are intensifying and deepening. This process will neither become part of the social fabric nor develop in this manner. The development of this process depends on Turkey’s democratization. Currently, there are no signs of this.

title: DBP and DEM Party: We will be in Varto on 2 November
content:
The Varto (Gimgim) district organizations of the DBP and DEM Party set up a stand in Kox Square as part of the legal proceedings against the geothermal power plant project.


Speaking in a press conference, DBP District Co-Chair Aziz Oral said that the project threatens not only the natural environment but also the living spaces and cultural existence of the local population.


Oral pointed out that potential water pollution could affect agriculture and livestock farming, as well as a wider area of the Euphrates basin via the Murat River. He emphasized the need to protect nature, water resources, and the right of future generations to life.


The DBP and DEM Party called on residents to gather in the village of Xwarik on 2 November for an expert inspection related to the planned geothermal power plant (JES) project in Varto.

title: Iranian director Jafar Panahi sentenced to 5 years and 1 month in prison
content:
Iranian director and screenwriter Jafar Panahi was sentenced to 5 years and 1 month in prison in a case heard by Branch 26 of the Tehran Revolutionary Court. The court ordered the confiscation of all his movable and immovable assets, banned him from social media activities for two years, and prohibited him from leaving the country.


According to a report by HRANA, citing Emtedad, Panahi’s lawyer, Mostafa Nili, stated that the verdict had been issued in his client’s absence. Nili said Panahi learned of the ruling after his bank accounts were frozen.


Lawyer Nili said that although his client returned to Iran on March 30, 2026, the case file listed him as being outside the country, and he had not been notified of the hearing date. Nili also stated that an arrest warrant had been issued for Panahi on May 20, 2026, and that the director currently faces three separate legal cases.


Panahi had previously been sentenced to one year in prison in a separate case on charges of “propaganda against the regime.” He was also given a two-year travel ban and prohibited from joining political and social organizations. His request for a retrial was rejected in June 2026.

title: Dayîka Îpek Erê: Heta Mûsa O. bê girtin, ez ê dengê xwe bilind bikim
content:
Çawişê pispor ê berê Mûsa O. êrişa zayendî li Îpek Era 18 salî kiribû û bûbû sedem ku Er xwe bikuje. Her weha 10 sal cezayê girtîgehê lê hatibû birîn. Mûsa O. bi tohmeta ku “bûye sedema xwekuştinê” dihat darizandin.


1emîn Dadgeha Cezê û Esliyê ya Êlihê di 22ê Cotmeha 2026an de biryar dabû ku tu delîlek şênber nîne ku Mûsa O. bûye sedem ku

Îpek Er

 xwe bikuje. Her weha dadgehê biryara beraeta Mûsa O. dabû.


Dayika Îpek Erê, Hikmet Kilinçê derbarê beraetkirina sûcdar Mûsa O. de ji JînNewsê re axiviye û bertek nîşanî biryarê daye.


Mûsa O., di doza Îpek Erê de beraet kir


26 Cotmeh 2026


"Ez nahêlim mafên keça min werin binpêkirin"


Hikmet Kilinçê berteka xwe ya li hember beraetê bi van gotinan anî ziman:


"Piştî veşartina keça min, mafê wî tune ku bi azadî bigere. Wî û hevalê wî keça min xapandin, derman dan wê, ew birin Îzmîrê û birin otêlan. Kesên din keça min hişyar kirin û gotin, 'Ji vir derkeve, ew ê te bifroşin.'  Dewletê ji min re got, 'Em nahêlin mafên keça te werin binpêkirin,' lê ev çênebû. Ez ê her tiştê ku ji destê min tê bikim. Divê dewlet teqez wî bigire. Ez dixwazim ew qatil were girtin ji ber ku ew qatilê min e. Gotinên dawî yên keça min ev bûn; 'Divê hûn nehêlin mafên min werin binpêkirin.' Min baweriya xwe bi dewletê anî, lê dewletê biryara beraeta Mûsa O. da. Ji bo lêgerîna edaletê ya ji bo keça min, çi ji destên min bê ez ê bikim. Divê dewlet teqez wî ceza bike."


"Ew ê sibehê tecawizî kesekî din bike"


Hikmet Kilinç, diyar kir ku ew ê bêdeng nemînin û wiha berdewam kir, "Divê dewletê ew girtiba. Ez nizanim çima ew nayê girtin. Mûsa O. zilamê dewletê bû û hîn jî wisa ye, ji ber vê yekê wî beraet kir. Mûsa Orhan dê sibehê yan roja din biçe û tecawizî jineke din bike. Ma ne şerm e? "


Parêzerên Îpek Erê: Mûsa O. ji hêza dewletê sûd wergirtiye


6 Kanûn 2021


Hikmet Kilinç bal bir ser gotinên Suleyman Soylu û wiha domand:


"Dema keça min hat kuştin, Suleyman Soylu ji Sêrt, Amed, Stenbol û Misircê 20 parêzvan şandin Hamdûnayê. Ew bi xwe hat Hamdûnayê û got, 'Di tu şert û mercan de bi Kurdî neaxive, navûdengê xwe di çavên dewletê de xera neke. Ez nahêlim ku mafên keça te werin binpêkirin.' Suleyman Soylu ev yek bi xwe ji min re got. Min baweriya xwe pê anî û wekî ku wî got kir. Min got, 'Tekane tiştê ku ez dixwazim ew e ku kujer bê girtin.' Piştî şeş salan, beraeta Mûsa O. hat. Ji niha û pê ve, ez ê her tiştê ku divê bê gotin bibêjim."


"Ez ê heta ku Mûsa Orhan bê girtin têbikoşim"


Hikmet Kilinç da zanîn heta Mûsa O. bê girtin ew ê têbikoşe û wiha got, "Heta Mûsa O. bê girtin, ez ê dengê xwe bilind bikim. Ger dewlet Mûsa O. negire, ez ê her tiştê ku di hişê min de ye bibêjim. Ez dixwazim her kes rabe ser piyan, ez dixwazim her kes ji bo Îpek li edaletê bigere. Ez ê heta dawiya jiyana xwe ji bo keça xwe têbikoşim."


Malbata Îpek Erê giliyê parêzerên Mûsa O.yî kiriye


6 Tîrmeh 2021


Çi bûbû?


Li navçeya Qubînê ya Êlihê, Î. E.ya 18 salî ya di 16ê Tîrmeha 2020an de hewl dabû xwe bikuje. Î. E. yê paşê aşkere kiribû ku Mûsa O. çawişê pispor tecawiz li wê kiriye. Î. E. ya ku li nexweşxaneyê dihate dermankirin, îro can daye.


Î. E. piştî ku xwestibû xwe bikuje û ew li nexweşxaneyê dihate dermankirin, malbata wê nameya wê dîtibû. Î. E. yê di nameya xwe de gotibû ku çawişê pispor Mûsa O.yî tecawiz lê kiriye.


Malbata Î. E. yê giliyê çawişê pispor kiribû û Mûsa O. heman rojê hatibû desteserkirin. Çawişê pispor di îfadeya xwe de ew tohmet qebûl nekiribûn.


Li gorî nûçeya Ajansa Mezopotamyayê Rapora Tipa Edlî aşkere kiribû ku Mûsa O. yî tecawizî Î. E. yê kiriye. Di encama vê rewşê de Mûsa O. yî îdia kiribû ku dema ew û Î. E. li Sêrtê hatine ba hev ew serxweş bûye.


Biryara “nepenîtiyê” ji bo dosyaya lêpirsînê hatibû dayîn. Çawişê pispor bi tohmeta ku “istismara zayendî ya xurt” kiriye şandibûn ber destê heyeda Dadweriya Silh û Cezayan a Nobedar a Sêrtê lê li vir bi şertê kontrola edlî serbest bûbû.


Malbata Î. E. yê ji bo alîkariya hiqûqî serî li Komeleya Mafên Mirovan a Êlihê dabûn.


Di 22ê Cotmeha 2026an de 1emîn Dadgeha Cezê û Esliyê ya Êlihê biryar dabû ku tu delîlek şênber nîne ku Mûsa O. bûye sedem ku

Îpek Er

 xwe bikuje. Her weha dadgehê biryara beraeta Mûsa O. dabû.


(EMK/AY)

title: Du moment et de la violence
content:
Un constat et une analyse sur le mouvement commencé en octobre 2026. Le rôle de la défaite et de la violence et ses possibles perspectives de victoires ou de défaites.


Article publié initialement dans


International Society of Historical Defeat


Le siècle dernier a été celui des défaites de tout mouvement cherchant à renverser ce monde. Le siècle qui commence attend une victoire.


ISHD

 a été fondé en 2016 en partant du constat de l'échec de toutes les précédentes tentatives de suppression de l'économie marchande, comme illusion et comme réalité, ainsi que des formes de domination nécessaires à son maintien et à son apparence. Cet outil a pour but l'analyse des défaites précédentes et la pratique de cette critique dans le moment présent.


Dans la manière dont le phénomène apparaît, son apparence produit aussi son négatif. Le positif chemine toujours avec lui. Qu'y a-t-il derrière le phénomène

 

? Rien : l'économie n'a pas de réalité propre dans le monde, et son apparence est ce qui la constitue. C'est ce qui rend la critique si difficile, car il n'y a pas d'essence cachée à dévoiler, seulement un système de croyances à défaire. De là vient le piège de la positivité immédiate. L'idée d'une positivité qui apparaîtrait d'elle-même et qui se donnerait les moyens de renverser ce monde est précisément l'apparence et la négation de ce renversement. On ne peut créer une positivité qu'à partir du négatif.


Les relents de l'histoire sont partout, et tout mouvement qui se donne pour but la suppression de cette société y est soumis. La première nécessité de ce siècle est la victoire.


Il existe une notion ancienne dans l'alchimie arabe, le Mizân : la balance, le mouvement qui penche d'un côté puis de l'autre, entre les lettres de l'ombre et de la lumière. Le poids de l'un dans l'autre. C'est toujours un moment délicat, un jeu entre l'événement, la liberté de ce qui arrive, la conscience et l'absence de conscience : un moment particulier où tout peut se jouer. C'est le moment où la guerre des pauvres contre les pauvres fait basculer l'émeute en insurrection. C'est la différence, avant tout, entre ceux qui croient et ceux qui n'ont plus rien à croire, entre ceux qui regardent, ceux qui font et ceux qui conservent. Dans l'affrontement présent, il y a donc, comme toujours, les acteurs, ceux qui brûlent les poubelles et ceux qui les protègent, et les spectateurs, ceux qui regardent.


L'organisation de la violence urbaine n'est pas la guérilla, contrairement aux mots mythiques accolés à la «

 

guérilla urbaine

 

». Ce n'est ni une guerre ni une guérilla : il faudrait qu'il existe une équivalence minimale entre les participants. Or il n'en existe aucune. Dans une guérilla, les partisans connaissent leur territoire, ils en maîtrisent les possibilités, ce qui peut parfois leur permettre de compenser la disparité entre leurs moyens et ceux de l'adversaire. Ce n'est absolument pas le cas dans les villes modernes : le parti adverse a lui-même organisé le territoire de l'affrontement, il le contrôle absolument, à la fois concrètement et abstraitement. C'est donc ailleurs que se situent les moyens à employer.


Il faut tout de même rappeler quelques principes tactiques légués par l'histoire de l'affrontement urbain.


Rappelons-en quelques-unes, très spécifiques, tirées du mouvement étudiant japonais de la fin des années 1960 :


La charge en «

 

serpent

 

» (snake dance)

. Les étudiants se tenaient fermement par le bras, en lignes larges de plusieurs dizaines de personnes, et chargeaient en courant selon un mouvement ondulatoire de gauche à droite. Ce balancier rendait la ligne très difficile à rompre pour la police, la force d'impact étant répartie sur toute la chaîne humaine.


Les gebabō (bâtons de combat)

. Contrairement aux émeutiers, qui usaient de projectiles de fortune, les militants employaient de longues pièces de bois carrées ou des tuyaux d'échafaudage. Ils s'en servaient de manière coordonnée pour tenir la police à distance, en piquant vers l'avant comme des phalanges antiques plutôt qu'en frappant en désordre.


Les barricades modulaires

. Dans la rue, ils utilisaient le mobilier urbain ou des rails arrachés. Sur les campus, ils ont théorisé la construction de barricades intérieures massives, destinées à transformer les bâtiments en forteresses autonomes capables de tenir des semaines. Les derniers affrontements parisiens et dans d'autres villes ont commencé à essayer de supprimer tout centre de …

author: dev
title: Les Voyageurs et le chtar
content:
Dans cette nouvelle lettre que Ritchy Thibault est parvenu à nous faire parvenir depuis la prison de Fleury-Mérogis, il revient sur le rapport que les voyageurs entretiennent avec la prison. Depuis son expérience personnelle et familiale, il raconte un « art de la carcérologie » qui est aussi une manière de ne jamais céder sur la dignité et la liberté

 [

1

]

.


« Nos ancêtres, nos vieux ont vécu pire, donc on garde la tête haute. »


Mickaël Gilgenmann dans une lettre du 5 octobre 2026 depuis la centrale de Lannemezan où il est incarcéré non loin du site d'un ancien camp de concentration pour Nomades.


Mickaël c'est mon

pral

 [frère]. Ça fait maintenant quelques mois que l'on correspond. Il est rentré au

chtar

 [prison] à 22 ans avec une peine de 5 ans pour un

tchore

 [vol]. Il en a aujourd'hui 37 et est encore retenu derrière les barreaux suite à une série de « peines internes » prononcées contre lui du fait qu'il a toujours refusé de baisser la tête. La semaine juste avant d'être écroué, j'ai pris un café avec un autre de mes

pral

voyageurs dans le 95. Je lui ai dit : « T'as un beau tatouage sur la main. » Il a en effet trois points en triangle (mort aux vaches), signe et affirmation d'un profond rejet et mépris de l'autorité – que l'on est si nombreux à arborer sur nos corps chez nous. Mon

papou

 [grand-père] l'avait sur sa main, lui qui a aussi connu le

chtar

 en région parisienne avant de venir s'installer en Dordogne et de fonder sa famille. Après ma remarque, cet homme m'a répondu : « Je l'avais fait quand j'étais tombé au chtar à 22 ans pour un

tchore

. » Quelques semaines avant de me faire ramasser par les

klisté

 [arrêté par la police] et de finir entre ces vilains murs, j'ai mangé avec un copain voyageur avec qui je milite et son père. Le sien était sous le coup d'un mandat de recherche pour une peine de 10 mois de

chtar

 et le mien y était déjà depuis presque 4 ans dans un centre de détention. Alors maintenant que je suis ici privé de ma liberté sous le régime de l'isolement, je suis dans l'obligation de me poser la question : sommes-nous condamnés à finir en prison lorsque l'on naît gitan ?


Des destins déjà écrits ?


Quand j'étais petit, je me souviens que les gens de ma famille me disaient souvent : « Toi tu n'iras pas au

chtar

, tu

rakav

 [parles] bien. » Et bien force est de constater qu'ils se sont trompés. Comme mes deux frères, déscolarisés en primaire et au collège, je viens moi aussi d'y tomber alors pourtant qu'il est vrai que je suis dans une école qui se veut « grande ».


Dans une lettre du 12 octobre 2026, voilà ce que m'a dit Aurélie Garand, la sœur d'Angelo abattu de cinq balles en 2017 par le GIGN : « Mine de rien le destin des Voyageurs est quasi écrit d'avance par l'État. De Angelo à toi, d'une conduite sans permis à un étudiant de 22 ans avec des mots : les pieds dans le système carcéral. Au final c'est leur case. » Au fond si je me refais la trame il y a effectivement quelque chose de logique. Toutes les heures de route, les allers-retours dès mon plus jeune âge avec mes frères et ma mère pour aller voir mon père au parloir. Les moments où les enseignants nous interrogeaient sur les activités de nos parents et où je déclarais au sujet de mon père : « Il est en déplacement professionnel. » L'hiver dernier, je suis descendu lui apporter un « colis de Noël » auquel ont droit les détenus en fin d'année. Cet été, où une agente pénitentiaire est venue chez mes parents installer un bracelet électronique à mon grand-frère, handicapé et en proie à de graves crises d'angoisse – pour le châtier suite à une simple bagarre. J'ai enragé et il y avait de quoi puisque quelques jours après la pose de cet affreux appareil il a fait une tentative de suicide. Ma colère était telle que pendant qu'elle installait ce sinistre machin, j'ai coupé au couteau le câble d'alimentation d'un de ces boitiers en me disant que ça permettrait sûrement au prochain de gagner quelques jours en liberté. J'étais en compagnie de mon pote rom Spartacus qui a aussi connu l'enfer du

chtar

. C'est lui qui m'a expliqué l'origine sémantique de ce mot. En effet, en romanès et en manouche, ça signifie littéralement « quatre », le nombre – comme les quatre murs qui te coupent du monde.


Dans une lettre du 7 octobre 2026, une Voyageuse m'a livré le témoignage suivant : « Mon arrière-grand-mère Aimée Leguenée a fait deux séjours (18 mois) à la prison de Tours pour vagabondage alors qu'elle avait 12 …

author: cnt.es
title: Manifiesto 11N: La huelga es el único camino
content:
Leer en

Castellano

Galego


Castellano

La huelga es el único camino


No valen ya las negociaciones que no llevan a ningún sitio, porque el poder no nos toma en serio. No basta con mirar hacia otro lado mientras la vida se nos va en trabajar para pagar un alquiler. No podemos conformarnos pensando que esto no va con nosotros, porque sabemos que, tarde o temprano, también nos tocará.


Las condiciones laborales que tenemos no nos las han regalado. Se han conquistado con conciencia de clase, organización y lucha colectiva. La jornada de ocho horas se consiguió después de la huelga de La Canadiense de 1919. Las vacaciones pagadas, la protección frente al despido o la asistencia médica llegaron después de décadas de reivindicaciones. Los derechos laborales se conquistaron enfrentándose a quienes siempre han querido sacar el máximo beneficio de nuestro trabajo.


Los derechos dependen de la capacidad de defenderlos.

 Hoy, mientras nos piden paciencia y moderación, vemos cómo se incumplen derechos, se precariza el empleo y se pretende que aceptemos como inevitable perder lo que tanto costó conseguir. La jornada de ocho horas sigue siendo una conquista fundamental, pero la jornada de 40 horas continúa estancada desde hace décadas. ¿Cuánto tiempo más vamos a aceptar que nuestras vidas giren en torno al trabajo?


Los salarios en España apenas han ganado poder adquisitivo en las últimas décadas, mientras el coste de la vivienda se dispara. Nos piden que nos apretemos el cinturón, pero cada vez tenemos menos cintura. Trabajamos para vivir y acabamos viviendo para trabajar. Y cuando llega el momento de jubilarnos, también quieren que asumamos más años de trabajo y que desconfiemos de unas pensiones públicas que deberían garantizarnos una vida digna.


La patronal se ha venido arriba hasta el punto de anunciar que pretende impugnar la huelga general del 11N. Como si no tuviéramos derecho a parar, a organizarnos y a plantar cara. Como si pudieran decidir hasta dónde llega nuestra capacidad de defendernos. Mientras tanto, el fascismo recibe apoyos, financiación y espacios de promoción, dispuesto a señalar y amenazar a quienes alzan la voz. Quieren que tengamos miedo, que nos callemos y que cada cual se busque la vida como pueda.


Pero a toda injusticia puede oponerse una respuesta solidaria. Y esa respuesta ya está aquí. El pueblo está hablando y organizándose desde abajo. Esa juventud a la que tantos daban por perdida, a la que se daba por derechizada y desmovilizada, estamos en las calles, luchando por la justicia social y construyendo espacios de apoyo mutuo. Vecinas y vencinos nos encontramos en los barrios y en las plazas, organizamos grupos de trabajo, compartimos experiencias, nos formamos y nos cuidamos. Nos resguardamos de la lluvia en comunidad. Descubrimos que no estamos solas y que, cuando nos organizamos, podemos dejar de aceptar lo que parecía inevitable.


Porque los problemas que sufrimos individualmente tienen causas comunes y necesitan respuestas colectivas. Porque no podemos permitir que el salario se esfume en el alquiler, que la jornada laboral nos robe la vida o que la jubilación se convierta en una nueva incertidumbre. Queremos salarios dignos, una jornada laboral que nos permita vivir, pensiones públicas suficientes y una vivienda estable y asequible. Queremos que la vivienda cumpla una función social y que nadie pierda su hogar por no poder pagar. Que no sea un negocio. Queremos que nuestras vidas valgan más que los beneficios de unos pocos.


No esperamos que nadie nos regale nada. Sabemos que los derechos se conquistan y se defienden luchando. Y sabemos también que ninguna negociación será suficiente si detrás no hay una clase trabajadora organizada, dispuesta a defender sus derechos y a conquistar los que todavía le niegan.


La huelga es nuestra herramienta. La solidaridad, nuestra fuerza. La organización, nuestro camino.


El 11 de noviembre tenemos una oportunidad para demostrarlo. Para parar, encontrarnos y hacer visible que sin nosotras nada funciona. Para defender nuestras condiciones de vida y demostrar que no estamos dispuestas a seguir pagando una crisis que no hemos provocado.


No hace falta que pensemos igual en todo. Hace falta que entendamos que compartimos mucho más de lo que nos separa. Que la precariedad de una trabajadora, el alquiler imposible de una familia y la incertidumbre de quien se acerca a la jubilación forman parte de una misma realidad. Y que, frente a ella, tenemos …

title: Hrant Dink’e selam: “Özgürlüğü Kanadında”
content:
Hrant Dink cinayetinin ardından oluşan ortak hafızayı konu edinen “Özgürlüğü Kanadında: Hrant Dink İçin Öyküler” kitabı 31 Ekim’de yayımlanacak.


İletişim Yayınları etiketli ile okurla buluşacak kitabın kapak çizimini Kemal Gökhan Gürses’in hazırladı. Esere aralarında Selahattin Demirtaş’ın da bulunduğu 20 yazar öyküleriyle katkı sundu.


20 edebiyatçı aynı vicdan atlasında buluştu


Agos'un haberne göre, kitapta; Karin Karakaşlı, Murathan Mungan, Rıdvan Hatun, Sema Kaygusuz, Sevim Çiçek, Ayfer Tunç, Irmak Zileli,Murat Gülsoy, Melisa Kesmez, Murat Uyurkulak, Selahattin Demirtaş, Behçet Çelik, Kerem Bakıcı, Polat Özlüoğlu,Kâmil Erdem, Fethiye Çetin, Şebnem İşigüzel, Figen Alkaç, Ayşegül Devecioğlu ve Eylem Ata’nın özel olarak kaleme aldığı öyküler bulunuyor.


“Buradayız Ahparig”


Gaye Boralıoğlu, kitabın

“İnattan Umuda, Umuttan Hakikate”

 başlıklı sunuş yazısında, cinayetin ardından oluşan toplumsal acının kişisel hikâyelerle nasıl birleştiğine dikkat çekiyor. Oluşan bu ortak hafızanın, farklılıkların bir arada kardeşçe yaşayabildiği adil bir geleceğin temelini oluşturduğunu belirten Boralıoğlu, edebiyatçıların bu derlemeyle Hrant’a yeniden seslendiğini ifade ediyor:


"Şimdi bu kitapta bu kez edebiyatçılar ‘Buradayız Ahparig’ diye sesleniyorlar. Onun sözünden, sesinden, yok edilememiş varlığından ilham alarak kendi edebî dünyalarını yeniden kuruyorlar. Yazdıkları öykülerle Hrant’ın sözünü genişletirken, bir yandan da o büyük vicdan atlasının parçası oluyorlar."


Sunuş yazısında Hrant Dink’in yüz binlerin katıldığı cenaze törenindeki o unutulmaz simgeye değinen Boralıoğlu; siyahlar içindeki Ermeni gençlerin taşıdığı tabuta cenaze boyunca eşlik eden beyaz güvercinleri hatırlatıyor. Boralıoğlu,kaleme alınan öyküler ile bu simge arasındaki bağı şu dokunaklı sözlerle özetliyor:


"Bugün o güvercinler bu öykülerin arasında dolaşıyor; Hrant’ın ruhuna, o güzel ruha bizden de bir selam götürmek için."

author: cnt.es
title: ¡Guerra a la Guerra!
content:
Días de movilización en todo el globo. Trabajadores y trabajadoras de todo el mundo no ocultan su descontento con la situación. Salarios que no se mantienen a la par que los precios. Servicios públicos degradados por falta de inversión. Estudiantes, trabajadores y trabajadoras o pensionistas han salido a las calles en Italia, Francia, España… La respuesta de políticos y gobiernos ha sido la misma en todos los casos: no hay dinero para pagar las pensiones, la educación, la sanidad, etc. Sin embargo, en muchas ocasiones han acordado hace poco aumentar la parte del presupuesto destinada a gastos militares. Parece que es una cuestión de prioridades. Prefieren comprar otro misil, antes que una cama de hospital.


Esto por sí solo bastaría para oponerse a la guerra y al gasto militar, pero hay muchas más razones. En primer lugar, no es cierto que estemos en el mismo barco en un país cualquiera contra un enemigo común, sea cual sea este. Los y las jóvenes de clase trabajadora servirán de carne de cañón en todos los conflictos, mientras que los ricos encontrarán la manera de mantenerse al margen o incluso de sacar provecho de ello. Sin embargo, la difícil situación de la clase trabajadora es muy similar en cualquier lado de una frontera. Algunos políticos no dejan de hablar de la patria y nación, pero guardan un conveniente silencio sobre el hecho de que los empresarios y la clase obrera pueden proceder del mismo país, pero sus objetivos son opuestos. Como dice el lema: «Ni guerra entre pueblos ni paz entre clases».


En segundo lugar, no prestes atención a nadie que se llene la boca con la defensa del interés de un país a costa de otro o mediante el poderío de su ejército. La historia nos enseña que, en la mayoría de los casos, esta retórica solo conduce al conflicto armado y al desastre. Incluso para el bando vencedor. ¿De qué sirve ganar una guerra a costa de la muerte de millones de jóvenes? Suele ser la extrema derecha la que incide en este tipo de discurso, pero hay que tener en cuenta que, si estalla una guerra, nadie gana y el discurso de la disuasión y el gasto militar solo conduce al desastre.


Por último, la guerra es un infierno. Punto. Debe evitarse a toda costa.


Como organización internacional, que promueve el anarcosindicalismo y el sindicalismo revolucionario, CIT busca fomentar la organización de la clase trabajadora de todo el mundo y la defensa de sus derechos e intereses, en lugar de la lucha fratricida entre iguales. Por eso, CIT acordó y ratificó en su último congreso una jornada de acción contra la guerra el 30 de octubre, y por eso nuestras secciones llevan ya bastante tiempo planificando huelgas, manifestaciones y piquetes para ese día, cada una según sus posibilidades. Estas acciones van desde una huelga general en Italia (más información en el siguiente enlace, en italiano:

https://usi-cit.org/

) hasta una serie de concentraciones y actos en otros lugares. Ahora más que nunca: ¡guerra a la guerra!


La entrada

¡Guerra a la Guerra!

 se publicó primero en

Confederación Nacional del Trabajo

.

A contemporary study of Proudhonian ideas might have one of two objectives. Either we will strive to retrace Proudhon’s historical physiognomy,{1} discover the guiding principles of his thought, and explain them by his heredity and temperament, the social circles he lived in, and the events he witnessed. Or else, concerned more with utility than with reconstruction, we will retain from Proudhonism only what may be used by scholars to understand today’s world and foresee tomorrow’s, and by reformers to build an effective, fruitful doctrine for action. Both methods are equally legitimate. The first is necessary for historians of ideas, for whoever wishes to restore Proudhon to us as he was. The second should be preferred if we seek less to describe the past than to shed light on the present and prepare for the future.

Depending on which of these two angles we approach it from, the relationship between Proudhonism and Marxism appears very different.

Historically, Proudhon and Marx are adversaries and constitute an antithesis.[1] After having maintained friendly and sustained relations in 1844 during Marx’s stay in France, and having spent whole nights discussing philosophy and political economy, they fell out irremediably when Marx replied to Economic Contradictions with The Poverty of Philosophy and disdainfully dismissed Proudhon as petty-bourgeois. The years passed without softening this animosity. In 1865, in his famous letter to the Sozial-Demokrat, Marx did not hesitate to judge Proudhon’s memoir in these terms, forgetting his past praise: ‘What Is Property? In a rigorously scientific history of political economy this work would scarcely be worthy of mention’, and he protested against Proudhon’s ‘scientific charlatanism’, ‘unbearable chatter’, and ‘imbecile cynicism’.[2]

In fact, between Proudhon and Marx the contrast of spirit and tendency is obvious. Whereas Marxist thought arose from the development of industrial life, from large-scale production concentrated and socialised in its technical forms if not in its legal regime, Proudhonian thought is fundamentally rural in origin and orientation: the social cell of the future society that Proudhon envisages is neither the factory nor the workers’ group, but the peasant family with austere morals and an individualistic life, whose property, founded on possession, takes on an absolute and sacred character. If Marx holds that the fundamental explanation of world history lies in variations of economic technique, according to Proudhon the guiding thread that enables us to find our way in the chaos of historical events is philosophical in nature: history is a long process of reasoning and society a metaphysics in action. And while for Marx only a change in the mode of production is capable of putting an end to economic instability and class struggle, Proudhon seeks the solution of the social problem in a reform of circulation and exchange, leading gradually to the disappearance of all usurious levies.

title: Bir ayda ikinci emekli polis intiharı: Ekonomik koşullar karşısında hayatlar sönüyor
content:
Zonguldak'ta 2023 yılında emekliye ayrılan 51 yaşındaki polis memuru Baskın Pekmen, 21 Ekim'de babasının mezarı başında ölü bulundu. Üç çocuk babası Pekmen'in, yaşamını yitirmeden önce evinden ayrılırken bir not bıraktığı, borçlarının bulunduğu ve ailesine "Size iyi bakamadım" yazılı bir mektup yazdığı öğrenildi.

Sözcü'den Cengiz Karagöz'ün haberine göre, Yeni Parti Zonguldak Milletvekili Deniz Yavuzyılmaz, Baskın Pekmen'in ölümüne ilişkin yaptığı açıklamada, emeklilerin yaşadığı ekonomik sorunlara dikkat çekti. Yavuzyılmaz, "Emeklileri yoksulluğa, aileleri çaresizliğe mahkum eden ekonomik koşullar karşısında hayatlar sönmeye devam ediyor. Çok üzgünüm" dedi.

Birleşik Emekliler Sendikası da yaptığı açıklamada, emeklilerin yaşadığı geçim sıkıntısına tepki gösterdi. İktidarın seçim dönemlerinde emeklilere yönelik sınırlı düzenlemelerle oy desteği sağlamaya çalıştığı ifade edilen açıklamada, "Ama biz emekliler yapılanı unutmayacağız, sandıkta hesabını soracağız. Bizler oy deposu değiliz" denildi.

Emekli dernekleri ve sendikaların zam talebiyle Ankara'da AYM önünde yaptığı eylem sırasında "Geçinemiyorum" diyerek kendisini vuran emekli polis Ali Şekeroğlu hayatını kaybetmişti.

31 yıldır emeğin sesi olan Evrensel, gücünü sadece okurlarından alıyor. Emeğin sesinin daha gür çıkması için sen de güç ver.

author: Shannia Cabuello
title: Proposed foreign-funded wind projects threaten Bicol fishers
content:
Photo frrom Province of Camarines Sur

“If they say this project is for development, development for whom? This is not for us fisherfolk.”

Norberto Tobias of Tanggol San Miguel Bay (SMB) Network stressed this point as he and other fisherfolk from Bicol expressed opposition to the planned 1,000-megawatt San Miguel Bay Offshore Wind Farm.

They joined the Kampuhang Magbubukid (peasant camp) in front of the Department of Agrarian Reform from October 15 to 20.

The proposed wind farm covers 23,307 hectares of coastal waters across municipalities in Camarines Sur and Camarines Norte, including the fishing communities in Calabanga, Cabusao, Tinambac, Siruma, Sipocot, Basud, and Mercedes. This affects at least 6,000 small-scale fisherfolk.

Tobias said in a statement that the planned wind project is only for the profit of foreign companies and its local partner.

The project reportedly started its pre-development phase in 2023 but the fisherfolk communities countered that they only learned about it in 2025.

It is just one of the three Offshore Wind Projects of the Copenhagen Infrastructure New Market Fund Corp. (CINMF), the first 100% foreign-owned company to be granted a wind energy service contract (WESC) by the Department of Energy (DOE). It acquired exclusive rights to explore and develop SMB for wind energy in electricity generation.

The wind farm was developed under the partnership of CINMF-affiliated and Denmark-based Copenhagen Infrastructure Partners (CIP) and local tycoon Ayala group’s ACEN Corp which has a 25% stake.

In 2024, the project was also granted Green Lane status by Philippine Board of Investments (BOI), a Certificate of Energy Project of National Significance (CEPNS), and pre-development Environmental Compliance Certificate (ECC) which expedited the project’s necessary licenses and permits processes.

The Kilusang Magbubukid ng Pilipinas (KMP) described the Marcos Jr. administrations’ promotion of large-scale renewable energy investments as aggressive, citing its insufficient protection for coastal resources-dependent communities.

The group condemned how the government opened the renewable energy sector in 2022 to 100% foreign ownership, streamlining approvals for strategic investments.

Since August 2024, a total of 91 offshore wind contracts nationwide has been approved by the Department of Energy.

Along the same coastline, six other planned offshore wind projects also raised concerns on combined impacts on marine resources and fisherfolk way of living.

Calabanga fisherfolk leader Norberto Harukhok said in an interview with Climate Change Network for Community-based Initiatives (CCNCI) that fisherfolk in coastal areas are united to stop the power plant from pushing through as they do not want the future generation to suffer.

“We don’t have a problem if they put it there as long as they follow our request to build it 15 kilometers away. Not by the shore,” Harukhok said.

“This is where we catch fish, earn a living, and get food for our families. If they prohibit us from fishing, where would we go?” Tobias asked, stressing that they may suffer from fishing access restrictions, marine habitat damage, and declining catches.

The CCNCI interview also highlighted that effects on ecosystems may result from the project’s regular operations. Coastal families may also face much lower incomes and worsen hunger.

“Once it is placed there, the fishes would not come closer because of the loud vibrations. Muds would go on the shore. Once they dug it up, the fishes would die from toxicity,” Harukhok said, adding that small-scale fishers with no motorized boats would struggle more as it would be difficult to go far to fish.

Harukhok said that only the government and capitalists would benefit from the project, leaving the fisherfolk without any benefits.

“So-called solutions to the climate crisis must not create another crisis for fishing communities already struggling with poverty, rising costs and impacts of climate change,” KMP Secretary-General Ronnie Manalo said in a statement. (DAA)

author: Publicación Abierta
title: La impunidad de Machado
content:
Diez meses fuera y vuelve en caravana


El 25 de octubre, María Corina Machado regresó a Venezuela. Recorrió el país, de Barquisimeto a Caracas, entre banderas y vítores, como quien vuelve de unas vacaciones. Y, sin embargo, desde el propio Gobierno venezolano se la había calificado de prófuga de la justicia y se había advertido de que «tendrá que rendir cuentas» si pisaba el país. No ha rendido ninguna. Se pasea libremente, aclamada y sin que nadie le pida explicaciones.


El historial de la que vuelve


Conviene recordar quién es. La que llamó a las guarimbas. La que incitó a la violencia y al enfrentamiento entre venezolanos. La que pidió, una y otra vez, la intervención militar de los Estados Unidos de Trump y del Israel de Netanyahu contra su propio país. La que reclamó sanciones contra su pueblo y apoyó el sabotaje para rendir a Venezuela por hambre, sin medicinas, sin comida, sin lo más básico para la vida. Una venepatria de manual, que nunca dudó en poner su tierra en bandeja a las potencias extranjeras.


Su amo la despacha con un «muy agradable»


Y mírese cómo recibe su amo el regreso de su sierva. Preguntado por los periodistas, Trump respondió: «Es una mujer muy agradable. Me dio su Premio Nobel, así que ¿cómo puedo decir otra cosa? Y espero que esté a salvo». Ni una palabra más. Enseguida, a lo suyo: a Estados Unidos, dijo, le va «realmente bien en Venezuela». Ese es todo el pago por años de servicio y por regalarle hasta el Nobel. El 3 de enero, el día de la captura de Maduro, ya la había descartado para dirigir el país con la misma fórmula: muy agradable, pero sin el respeto necesario. Así pagan los imperios a quienes les sirven: los usan mientras son útiles y les dan una palmadita cuando estorban.


Una justicia para cada clase


Que nadie se engañe: esta impunidad no es un accidente; es justicia de clase. A quien se juega el sueldo defendiendo a sus compañeros en un centro de trabajo le piden cuentas por mucho menos. A quien trabajó para que el sufrimiento llegase a miles de familias venezolanas la recibe una multitud, con las cámaras de medio mundo apuntando hacia ella. Hay una vara de medir para el pueblo trabajador y otra muy distinta para quienes sirven a los poderosos.


No hay redención para quien traiciona a su pueblo


No hay perdón para quien ayudó a traer tanto dolor a Venezuela. Nunca pensé que llegaría a ver cómo quienes empujaron a la guerra, a la necesidad y a la muerte caminan tranquilos por la calle, sin pagar por sus actos. Con el Nobel de la Paz colgado, además: un premio concedido a quien se ha pasado la vida pidiendo la invasión de su propio país, convertido así en el Nobel de la vergüenza. Pero esa vergüenza palidece ante lo que hoy vemos en Venezuela. El pueblo venezolano sabe quién le hizo daño, y la historia no suele ser tan indulgente como un presidente con quien le hace un regalo.


¡Até á vitoria sempre!


André Abeledo Fernández

author: Jeff Rickertt
title: Phil Monsour’s ‘Time of Monsters’ is a call to action against Israel’s genocide
content:
Time of Monsters Phil Monsour October 2026 Pre-order the album and lyric book at: pozible.com/profile/phil-monsour. Listen now on Bandcamp.

In the mythical Anglo-Saxon poem Beowulf, an entire population is subjugated by a bloodthirsty and seemingly invincible monster, Grendel. He “ruled in defiance of right, one against all”. “Malignant by nature, he never showed remorse.” (Seamus Heaney, Beowulf: A New Verse Translation, New York, WW Norton & Co, 2000, p11.)

With the genocide in Gaza now into its fourth year, and with Israel extending its military savagery to Lebanon, Syria and Iran, and tightening its bloody grip on the West Bank and East Jerusalem, it is clear the peoples of the Middle East are also living under the sway of a monster, malignant by nature, never showing remorse.

Unable to resolve the crisis of legitimacy generated by its founding act of land theft and dispossession, unable to quell the desire of the land’s indigenous people for liberation, the Israeli state, like Grendel, lashes out in rage, resorting to ever-increasing violence to sustain its power.

Halfway across the planet, in Magan-djin/Brisbane, Australia, a new album by Phil Monsour foregrounds the trauma, resilience, courage, fears and hopes of those resisting this evil; first and foremost the Palestinians themselves, but also the millions who have mobilised globally in solidarity with them over the past three years.

This album, Time of Monsters, adds to Monsour’s already impressive body of music about colonisation and war in the Middle East. It comprises 12 songs written over the past three years, each a response to Israel’s latest genocidal escalation of its never-ending war of subjugation.

One track is a rousing cover of Macklemore’s “Hind’s Hall 2”, the only song on the album not by Monsour. Another track, “Song for Fatima Hassouna”, honours the Palestinian photojournalist murdered by the Israel Defense Forces, alongside six members of her family, in April last year. The other songs respond to the genocide and Western complicity thematically. They invoke the visceral monstrousness of it, framing their narratives around recurring motifs: barbarism, loss, grief, survival, love and hope. The style is acoustic rock, although closer to Bruce Springsteen than Billy Bragg.

Monsour’s music is inscribed with activism. He is a founder and coordinator of Justice for Palestine Magan-djin, the Palestinian solidarity organisation that, since October 2023, has spearheaded the movement in Magan-djin, organising hundreds of rallies, pickets, vigils and public meetings. The size and intensity of this mobilisation has surpassed anything before it in the city’s history, including the struggle against the United States war in Vietnam.

Monsour composes and sings as a partisan of this uprising, a musician-activist, rather than a musician-ally. Without ever assuming to speak for Palestinians, some of his songs on Time of Monsters adopt a Palestinian first-person perspective. “Free Me from the Dust”, for example, addresses the horror in Gaza from the viewpoint of a Palestinian survivor: “In this shroud I bury soon something inside of me, flesh that binds me.” In “One Day in the Sun”, Monsour describes a Gazan’s daily struggle for survival: “All I can do is breathe, all I can do is wait, wait for tomorrow, and one day in the sun.” In another track, “I Am Not a Number”, the narrator tells us, “I live beyond your pictures; this land and I, we are the same.”

The Palestinian persona of these songs, however, is not ubiquitous across the album. The lens of the title song cuts away to an ally watching the genocide in livestream: “I am staring at something, can’t look away, the past the future is haunting me this day, crimes that echo on a million screens.”

The effect of this shifting perspective from song to song is a reframing of the Palestinian “I” as a “we” of the global liberation movement, positioning the Palestinians as a universal subject and Monsour himself (and us) as part of that multitude. “Our world is in pieces,” he declares in “Long List of Lost Things”, speaking for all of us. Monsour’s own place in the struggle — his own authorial “I” — is never far from the surface: “I can’t say if I’m broken, I can’t say if I’m whole, I just keep walking, nowhere else to go.”

This positioning gives the lyrical content of Time of Monsters urgency and emotional immediacy that sets Monsour’s songwriting apart in the genre of protest music. Woody Guthrie, Pete …

title: Ephéméride des luttes : 28 octobre
content:
L'éphéméride des luttes du 28 octobre abhorre les fascistes, comme toujours, ainsi que les armées et les patrons. Elle se méfie toujours autant des faux alliés autoritaires et pose de nouvelles bases pour un mouvement féministe, tout en ne reniant pas sa culture émeutière.


1791 :

 Olympe de Gouges, militante "proto-féministe", présente la

Déclaration des Droits de la Femme et de la Citoyenne

 à l'Assemblée nationale.


1893 :

 A Chicago (Etats-Unis), "

un individu qu'on dit être un anarchiste pénétra dans la résidence du maire de Chicago Mr. Carter Harrison et le tua de plusieurs coups de révolver. Mr. Harrison avait été plusieurs fois menacé par les anarchistes et un attentat avait été commis contre lui, sans succès, quelques semaines auparavant

".


Repris de l'éphéméride anarchiste.


1904 :

 La police apprend à utiliser les dépôts gras laissés par les doigts : c'est le début de l'utilisation des empreintes digitales à des fins policières.


1919 :

 Au Japon, sortie du premier numéro du journal "Rôdô Undô - The Labor Movement" (Le Mouvement Ouvrier), d'inspiration anarchiste.


1922 :

 En Italie, les fasciste commencent leur marche sur Rome. C'est de lébut de 22 ans de dictature.


1937 :

 Au cours de la guerre d'Espagne, le gouvernement républicain est transféré à Barcelone.


1938 :

 En Espagne, les Brigades Internationales sont démobilisées du front.


1938 :

 A Marseille, pendant un congrès radical-socialiste, un incendie accidentel ravage les Nouvelles Galeries sur la Canebière, gagnant l'hôtel de Noailles, le Grand-Hôtel et l'hôtel Astoria. Plusieurs dizaines de personnes y ont trouvé la mort. Le Grand-Hôtel abrite aujourd'hui le commissariat de Noailles.


1956 :

 A Budapest, on est toujours en plein dans l'insurrection Hongroise.


1968 :

 A Paris, des militants maoïstes et anarchistes attaquent au molotov le bar Relais-Odéon, qui accueille les meetings de l'organisation néofasciste Occident.


1974 :

 A Ballynkilar en Irlande du Nord, l'IRA fait sauter des explosifs contre une caserne de l'armée Britannique. Deux soldats trouvent la mort dans l'explosion.


1979 :

 - En Irlande du Nord, deux soldats sont abattus par l'IRA près de Belfast.


 Aux Etats-Unis, les Hopis et Big Mountain Dine déclarent leur indépendance vis-à-vis des gouvernements tribaux et du pays.


1986 :

 A Berlin, les Cellules Révolutionnaires (RZ) tirent dans les jambes du chef de la police des étrangers.


1988 :

 A Las Queñes, dans la cordillère chilienne, deux commandants du FPMR-Autonome, Cecilia Magni ("comandante Tamara") et Raúl Pellegrín ("comandante Rodrigo") sont abattus par les carabiniers de Pinochet après une attaque à l'explosif et à la mitrailleuse contre la caserne du village. Rodrigo et Tamara faisaient partie des principaux responsables de cette organisation de lutte armée contre la dictature.


1998 :

 A Vitrolles, destruction à l'explosif du transformateur du stade qui devait accueillir un concert de Rock Identitaire organisé par la mairie FN.


2001 :

 De grosses émeutes ont lieu à Belfast, des bombes artisanales sont lancées sur les officers du Royal Ulster Constabulary par les émeutiers. De nombreuses voitures sont incendiées et deux autres charges explosifs dans d'autres zones de la ville.


2011 :

 A Thessalonique, des manifestant-e-s parviennent à faire annuler un défilé militaire en bloquant les voies de chemin de fer et en attaquant la tribune officielle.


2013 :

 A Berlin, un véhicule de l'entreprise Sodexo est incendié pour protester contre la cogestion des prisons et des centres de rétention par l'entreprise d'alimentation de masse.

title: Censorship in the Education Department at FCI Allenwood Medium
content:
Casey Goonan

10/26/26


Casey offers here their reflections on the recent book drive they organized for the prison library, its popularity with everyone locked up, as well as how it has since been blocked and how Casey subsequently was fired from their library job.

Please share and repost.

– Casey Support Committee


AFFIRMATION

Thank you to everyone out in the so-called “free world” for contributing to our Summer Book Drive. On behalf of the Support Committee and every convict at FCI Allenwood Medium involved in this autonomous initiative, we send our revolutionary love and profound gratitude. From this self-organized prisoner initiative, we introduced a wide range of new, interesting, and relevant books into the prison’s official library collection. During my time as a library worker, many significant changes were made to the form and content of the library here at Allenwood Medium. Unfortunately, because of the Book Drive’s budding success and overwhelming popularity among the captives, i was fired from my job as librarian last week.

TERMINATION

On Thursday, October 1, i was fired as a library worker at FCI Allenwood Medium prison for no reason other than “ordering too many books” and “donating them directly into the library catalog” without the approval of the Education Department Supervisor, Mr. Williams. Although my boss, Ms. Ashton, knew about the plans for a mass donation and granted permission to do so, i was thrown under the bus once she learned her boss found out, and especially once she learned i was adding certain books into the catalog without her approval. There is nothing against policy within the books that were donated, even the ones i donated without Ms. Ashton’s knowledge. The Book Drive was successful in adding around one hundred brand new books to the library catalog, which transformed the library space from a realm of entertainment and distraction into one of pedagogy and critical study. By the first week of September, around seventy more books were delivered to the mailroom, yet staff deliberately let them pile up, before complaining to admin about the quantity of donations and returning them all back to sender. A few days later i learned of my termination.

It’s the overwhelming pettiness of the reaction that bothers me. There is no BOP policy that states we as prisoners cannot donate books into the library collection. There is an official process to do so however and i bypassed some of the red tape. Yet the only violation of policy i am “guilty” of is not showing my boss, Ms. Ashton, every single book that i was donating. My decision to not report donations wasn’t at all due to any intentional plot of deception. It was simply because whenever i gave my donations to Ms. Ashton, she would “never get around” to adding them into the catalog. They would just sit around and often disappear. I was frustrated by Ashton’s lack of enthusiasm regarding this rare opportunity to enhance the library collection, so i decided to just start marking, labeling, and cataloging the books myself. Basic direct action.

ACTION/REACTION

All who were involved in the Summer Book Drive (not only me as an individual) took direct action both to remedy the negligence of the correctional officers who oversee “education” operations at Allenwood Medium and to counter fascist anti-intellectualism, of which the official indifference to our depraved learning conditions is symptomatic. I am not exactly sure how the process occurred behind the scenes, but apparently a mailroom officer (who does not like me) contacted S.I.S. (the surveillance and investigative wing of the prison administration), who then contacted Mr. Williams, who in turn emailed Ms. Ashton ordering my termination as a library employee. I believe that the primary reason i was fired was politically motivated censorship, coupled with the fact that some of the COs already had an issue with me working in the library.

My termination as a library worker demonstrates how the administration at FCI Allenwood Medium will attempt to stifle any act of autonomous sufficiency and self-organization among us convicts, especially if activities aim to improve the conditions of life. The Summer Book Drive initiative was not only an attempt to counter the dehumanizing conditions of a neglectful Education Department but a demonstration of collective action to provide and (re)distribute resources in the face of (or rather in spite of) organized abandonment.
